Title: International Analytics Manager
Description:
Overview:

As International Analytics Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our client’s global presence. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, analyze market dynamics, and interact with marketing and business stakeholders to drive growth and engagement across international markets. If you’re passionate about sports, have a knack for strategic thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, this role is tailor-made for you

**Primary Location:** Across Canada

**Work Model:** Fully Remote

**Employment Type:** Contractor

**Vacancy Status:** New

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Hands-on Analytics**
* + Query and analyze data using SQL
  + Identify a problem or question and develop an analysis plan that adequately answers the question
  + Summarize data insights in a business-friendly way that is easy for stakeholders and executives to understand
  + Summarize large data outputs into key takeaways
  + Assist with user acceptance testing of database changes and updates
  + Enable data teams in the root cause analysis of issues and bugs
* **Activation and Enablement**
* + Evaluate one-to-one marketing campaign data needs and own data enablement for seamless campaign execution, including defined test and control groups and success criteria
  + Evaluate one-to-one audience needs and identify segmentation opportunities to drive and deepen fan engagement
* **Performance Tracking and Optimization**
* + Monitor the effectiveness of go-to-market strategies using relevant KPIs and attribution frameworks
  + Periodically assess performance against fanbase growth goals
  + Provide regular reports to senior leadership on international market performance
  + Regularly attend and provide input during strategy discussions with stakeholders
  + Work closely with stakeholders at the VP level
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* + Work closely with marketing, international, legal, and other stakeholders to align strategies and execution
  + Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and innovation
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams on business requirements
  + Interact with third parties regarding data needs and definitions
* **Market Growth and Strategy Support**
* + Collaborate with regional teams to create data analytics and segmentation plans that support growth strategies for specific markets
  + Define clear objectives, KPIs, and success metrics for each market
  + Develop audience segments and marketing initiatives tailored to local nuances

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, or a related field
* At least 3 years of experience using SQL, Python, or other relevant coding languages
* At least 5 years of stakeholder management experience
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to develop structured analytical approaches to business questions
* Ability to translate complex data outputs into clear, business-friendly insights
* Experience collaborating with senior stakeholders, including those at the VP level
* Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, data engineering, legal, regional, and business teams

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience in fan, consumer, or marketing analytics
* Knowledge of consent management and/or identity resolution
* Passion for sports and an understanding of global fan cultures
* Experience with audience segmentation and one-to-one marketing campaigns
* Experience working with attribution frameworks, test and control groups, and campaign success criteria

Title: Project Manager
Description:
Job Description

Project Manager, Infrastructure (UAE)

Role overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead the delivery of infrastructure projects across the UAE, from design coordination through construction handover, on time, within budget and to specification.

**Job title**

Project Manager, Infrastructure

**Department**

Projects / Engineering and Delivery

**Location**

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah, with regular site visits)

**Reports to**

Projects Director

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Project types**

Roads and bridges, utilities (water, power, drainage), district infrastructure, marine or rail works

Key responsibilitiesPlanning and delivery

* Own the full project lifecycle: scope, programme, budget, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.

* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, baseline programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) and work breakdown structure.

* Track progress against milestones, forecast delays early and agree recovery plans.

Cost and commercial control

* Manage the project budget, cash flow, variation orders, claims and final accounts.

* Review and approve contractor and consultant payment applications.

* Report cost forecasts and risks to senior management on a monthly basis.

Stakeholder and contractor management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, main contractors and subcontractors.

* Secure permits and no-objection certificates (NOCs) from UAE authorities such as RTA, DEWA, ADDC, Dubai Municipality, Department of Municipalities and Transport, Etisalat and du.

* Lead progress, design and coordination meetings; resolve interface issues across disciplines.

Quality, health, safety and environment

* Enforce HSE standards in line with UAE regulations, client requirements and ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.

* Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and quality plans, including inspection and test plans.

* Investigate incidents and non-conformances and close out corrective actions.

Risk and reporting

* Maintain the risk register and run regular risk reviews.

* Issue weekly and monthly progress reports covering programme, cost, quality, safety and risks.

* Lead, mentor and review the performance of the project team.

Qualifications and experienceRequired

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* 10+ years of experience in infrastructure project delivery, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

* 5+ years of experience on projects in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of local authority approval processes.

* Proven record of delivering projects above AED 100 million, on time and within budget.

* Experience with FIDIC contracts and claims management.

* Valid UAE driving licence (preferred at hire, required within the probation period).

Preferred

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification.

* Master's degree in Engineering or Project Management.

* Experience with PPP, design-and-build or EPC delivery models.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

* Strong command of civil and infrastructure construction methods, specifications and UAE standards.

* Advanced programming and cost control using Primavera P6, MS Project and Excel.

* Contract administration: extensions of time, variations, claims and dispute avoidance.

* Familiarity with BIM coordination tools and document platforms such as Aconex or Procore.

Leadership and behavioural

* Decisive leader who builds accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

* Negotiation and conflict resolution with clients, authorities and contractors.

* Sound judgement under pressure, with a strong safety-first mindset.

* Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and on site in UAE summer conditions.

What we offer and how to apply

* Competitive tax-free salary, with the package to be confirmed by the hiring team.

* UAE employment visa, Emirates ID and medical insurance for you and eligible dependants.

* Housing or transport allowance, annual flight ticket and end-of-service gratuity under UAE labour law.

* 30 calendar days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

* Training, certification support and a clear path to Senior Project Manager or Programme Manager.

To apply, send your CV and a cover letter to **admin@adcondxb.ae**

Pay: AED15,000.00 - AED20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Project Manager
Description:

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. The person in this role will report to a single agency manager and own projects from start to finish with minimal supervision. * Experience managing vendors and working with cross-functional teams

Title: Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalization & Process Improvement
Description:
Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement will be responsible for driving digital transformation initiatives across the procurement function through system enhancements, ERP optimisation, process automation, data analytics, and reporting improvements. The role will serve as the focal point between Procurement, IT, Digital Transformation, and business stakeholders to improve procurement efficiency, data visibility, system integration, and user adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Procurement Systems & ERP Enhancement

+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives for procurement-related systems and processes.
+ Manage procurement system integrations with ERP platforms such as SAP.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance system functionality, workflows, and user experience.
+ Coordinate with IT and business stakeholders to implement system upgrades and enhancements.
+ Support procurement digitisation projects and technology deployment initiatives.
+ Ensure data integrity, standardisation, and governance across procurement systems.

* Business Intelligence & Analytics

+ Develop and maintain procurement dashboards and performance reports using Power BI.
+ Utilise Power Query and advanced Excel tools for data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis.
+ Analyse procurement performance metrics, spend data, supplier performance, and operational KPIs.
+ Generate meaningful insights and recommendations through data analytics and visualisation.
+ Design executive-level reports and presentations to support management decision-making.

* Automation & Process Improvement

+ Develop automated workflows using Power Automate.
+ Create business applications and workflow solutions using Power Apps.
+ Identify manual activities that can be automated to improve efficiency and reduce processing time.
+ Map existing procurement processes and develop future-state workflows using Visio.
+ Lead continuous improvement programmes focused on digitalisation and process optimisation.

* SharePoint & Collaboration Solutions

+ Develop and manage SharePoint-based procurement repositories, dashboards, and collaboration platforms.
+ Improve document management, workflow tracking, and information accessibility.
+ Support knowledge management and digital workplace initiatives within procurement.

* Reporting & Presentation Development

+ Develop professional procurement presentations and executive reports using PowerPoint.
+ Create infographics and visual communication materials for management reporting.
+ Translate complex data into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the interface between procurement, supply chain, IT, digital transformation, and business units.
+ Gather business requirements and convert them into technical and system improvement initiatives.
+ Conduct user training and support change management activities during system implementations.
+ Provide technical guidance to procurement users on digital tools and reporting solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a Related Field.
* Professional certifications in SAP, Microsoft Power Platform, data analytics, or project management are advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Typically 6-8+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain systems, business analytics, digital transformation, ERP implementation, or process improvement.
* Proven experience in procurement system implementation, enhancement, or integration projects.
* Experience working with procurement modules within ERP environments such as SAP.
* Demonstrated experience in business intelligence, reporting, process automation, and workflow optimisation.
* Experience interfacing with both business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent understanding of procurement processes and system-driven improvements.
* Highly proficient in data management, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions.
* Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading digitalisation, automation, or procurement transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable efficiency improvements through technology and process optimisation.

Title: Business Division Manager
Description:
***BUSINESS DIVISION MANAGER***
**Job Purpose**

* Lead and manage the business functions for the Beach Valves Project from concept development through project execution, ensuring effective project governance, planning and reporting, risk and change management, cost and schedule oversight, contracting and procurement support, and organisational readiness to enable safe, timely and effective delivery of the Project.
* The Business Division Manager is responsible for managing and integrating the business requirements of the Beach Valves Project throughout all project phases, from concept development through execution. The role requires close coordination across Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Finance, Legal, P&D and other supporting organisations.
* Establishing and maintaining fit-for-purpose project governance, controls, reporting, risk, change, planning and business processes appropriate to the maturity and execution phase of the project.
* Supporting Project Management in managing interfaces, priorities, emerging risks and decisions within a brownfield operating environment involving multiple stakeholders and existing facilities.
* Maintaining alignment between the company, contractors and key stakeholders to support timely decisions and achievement of safety, quality, cost and schedule objectives.

**REPORTING & RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Project Manager

+ Direct Reports: 4.

* Internal Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with Project PMT.
+ Frequent contact within the Major Projects group and other departments such as Execution Planning and Services (EP&S), Legal, Supply, Operations, Finance, Other MP PMTs, and Shared Services.

* External Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with the EPC contractor, their sub-contractors, vendors and other third parties during the execution of the project.
+ Frequent contact with Beach Valves project shareholders.

**KEY JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Project Business Management: Lead and manage the project business functions and associated activities, including project governance, reporting, risk, change management, planning, cost, contracting and procurement support to enable achievement of project objectives.
* Governance & Business Framework: Establish and maintain the project business management framework from concept development through execution, ensuring appropriate processes, controls and governance arrangements are implemented in accordance with company requirements.
* Performance Management: Drive project performance through the review and coordination of schedule, cost, risk, change, KPIs, management reporting and other performance indicators, escalating areas requiring management intervention.
* Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Manage the preparation and coordination of project management reports, presentations, decision papers, committee submissions and approval documentation to meet governance requirements and enable timely, informed management decisions.
* Project Management System Compliance: Manage compliance with the company Project Management System (PMS) through coordination of applicable gate requirements, deliverables, reviews, findings and close-out actions to demonstrate project readiness for progression through the applicable lifecycle gates.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management: Lead project risk, issue and change management processes, ensuring risks and changes are identified, assessed, communicated, tracked and appropriately escalated to support informed project decisions.
* Organisational & Resource Planning: Coordinate project organisational and resource requirements, including recruitment, manpower planning, organisation charts, facilities and support services to maintain appropriate project capability through the different phases of execution.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate business interfaces with Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Legal, Finance, P&D and other Company organisations to facilitate timely decisions and resolution of Project issues.
* Contracting, Procurement & Commercial Support: Support project contracting, procurement and commercial activities through coordination of business requirements, change orders, management recommendations and interfaces with contractors, vendors and service providers to enable timely contractual and commercial decisions in support of project delivery.
* Compliance, Audits & Continuous Improvement: Monitor project business processes and procedural compliance, supporting internal and external reviews, audits, lessons learned and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in: Business / Accounting / Commercial / Marketing / Sciences / Engineering / Project Management / Supply Chain Management / Law / Communication / Technologies / Mathematics / Statistics
* Knowledge & Experience

+ 12 years experience in a business-related function or discipline.
+ Including 8 years in the Oil & Gas Industry.
+ Including 3 years experience in a supervisory or acting role or oversight of contractor/subcontractor/service/vendor personnel.

* Technical & Business Skills

+ Strong knowledge in project business-related functions/disciplines such as planning, scheduling, cost control, estimating, claim management, risk management, change management, procurement, pre- and post-award contract management, actionable and informative reporting, support services, lessons learned, etc.
+ Extensive knowledge in international standards, best practices and methodologies as it relates to business disciplines.
+ Broad experience and demonstrated competence in managing a business function and disciplines, including contractors, cost and tenders.
+ Strong experience with risk assessment approach in decision-making.
+ Strong knowledge of relevant software and computer skills, e.g., dashboards, data analytics, SAP, etc.
+ Experience working in large-scale operating organisations in operations, projects, subsurface, etc.

Title: Senior Service Delivery Manager, IT
Description:
Founded in 1999,
**Audax Group**
is a leading alternative investment manager with offices in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London and Hong Kong. With approximately $42 billion of assets under management and more than 475 employees, Audax is a leading capital partner for middle market companies, operating through three business lines: Audax Private Equity, Audax Private Debt, and Audax Strategic Capital.
  
  
For more information, visit www.audaxgroup.com or follow Audax Group on LinkedIn.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery is responsible for leading and continuously improving the firm's IT service delivery and end-user support function. This process-driven, customer-focused leader will oversee day-to-day support operations, establish consistent service-management practices, manage service levels and performance, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role serves as the operational owner of Freshservice and uses service data, automation, knowledge, self-service, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational performance and the employee experience. The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery will partner closely with Cloud & Endpoint, Security Operations, and Asset & Vendor Management on complex escalations and shared processes while remaining primarily focused on service leadership, process discipline, and service transformation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery**

* Lead end-user support operations across Audax offices, providing a consistent, high-quality service experience for executives, investment professionals, and firmwide staff.
* Oversee ticket queues, workloads, escalations, staffing, schedules, coverage, and service risks to ensure work is appropriately prioritized and completed.
* Identify capacity, coverage, or service-delivery gaps and implement or recommend corrective action.

**IT Service Management / Freshservice**

* Own Freshservice as the firm's service-management platform and system of record, including platform adoption, data quality, reporting, workflows, and automation. Govern platform configuration and administration, directing a designated administrator within the IT Operations team for hands-on changes.
* Establish and continuously improve standards for ticket lifecycle management, incidents, requests, problems, approvals, escalations, and service levels.
* Govern the service catalog, self-service experience, knowledge management, and repeatable workflows such as onboarding, offboarding, access, hardware, and software requests.
* Ensure Freshservice change, access, onboarding, and offboarding records are complete and audit-ready in partnership with Information Security Risk (SOC 1 IT controls).

**Reporting, SLAs and Service Quality**

* Establish and manage SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, experience measures, and service-performance standards aligned with business expectations.
* Develop dashboards and analyze service data to identify trends, recurring issues, resource constraints, employee friction, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead recurring service reviews that translate operational data into corrective actions and measurable improvement initiatives.

**Process Improvement, Automation and AI**

* Standardize and continuously improve IT Operations processes, workflows, documentation, self-service, and knowledge practices.
* Maintain a prioritized service-improvement and automation roadmap based on service volume, employee experience, cycle time, operational risk, and business value.
* Evaluate, pilot, and operate practical uses of automation and AI that improve service quality, employee experience, technician productivity, and operational efficiency.

**Incident and Problem Management**

* Lead operational coordination of major incidents and significant service disruptions, engaging the appropriate technical teams while maintaining ownership of service restoration and stakeholder coordination. Security incidents are led by Security Operations, with Service Delivery coordinating restoration and communications.
* Develop timely firmwide service communications and concise status updates for IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Lead post-incident reviews and problem-management activities to identify root causes, recurring issues, and corrective actions.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead and manage IT Operations staff, including engineers and co-ops, setting clear performance expectations, and coach and develop them through regular feedback, performance management, training, mentoring, and professional development.
* Strengthen team capabilities through cross-training, knowledge sharing, skills development, and succession planning.

**Competencies**

* IT Service Management and enterprise ITSM platforms, preferably Freshservice.
* People leadership, coaching, and performance management.
* Service analytics, SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Process improvement, workflow automation, self-service, knowledge management, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Executive-level communication and customer service in a high-expectation environment.
* Technical fluency sufficient to manage enterprise support operations and coordinate complex technical escalations.

**Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT Operations, IT Service Management, end-user support, or a related discipline, preferably within a high-touch professional services environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing an IT support or service-delivery team across multiple locations.
* Experience owning or administering an enterprise ITSM platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar.
* Experience developing service levels, operational reporting, process improvements, workflow automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, communication, change-management, and customer-service skills.
* Availability outside normal business hours for significant incidents or escalations may be required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent service management credential.
* Hands-on Freshservice administration experience.
* Experience in financial services, private equity, or another regulated, high-touch professional services environment.

Title: Corporate Services Manager
Description:
**Job description:**

Location: Dubai, UAE

Working hours: Monday to Friday 11.00 am to 8.00 pm.

**About Harrisons Sauces:**

Harrisons Sauces is a UK manufacturer of ambient sauces and condiments, based in Loughborough. We are BRC Higher Level and Halal certified, produce around 50,000 litres a day across 48 flavours, and supply leading UK foodservice businesses and 22 brand partners. We sell direct to consumers and trade through our Shopify Plus store and Amazon, and we are building a manufacturing site in the UAE to serve the GCC. Quality comes first in everything we do.

**The role: Corporate Services Manager (Dubai Based):**

We're looking for a hands-on finance professional to run finance and payroll across our UK and UAE businesses, build our UAE HR and recruitment function from the ground up, and support hiring in the UK. It's a rare chance to shape the back office of a growing two-country business, working directly with the Directors.

The role at a glance

· **Reports to:** The Directors

· **Manages:** Our bookkeeper, with room to grow a team

· **Based:** Dubai office, with UK and UAE site visits

· **Covers:** Finance, payroll, HR and recruitment

What you'll do

**Finance (UK and UAE)**

- Month-end close and management accounts

- Group consolidation and intercompany reconciliation

- 13-week cash forecast, credit control, payment runs

- Budgets, reforecasts and margin analysis

- VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, e-invoicing and filings.

**Payroll (UK and UAE)**

- Weekly UK payroll for c.100 staff

- PAYE, NI, RTI, pensions and statutory payments

- Monthly UAE payroll through WPS

- Leave pay, gratuity and final settlements

- Payroll reconciled and reported to the Directors.

**HR and recruitment (UAE**)

* Plan UAE headcount with the Directors

* Hire end to end, in-house: advert to offer

* Visas, Emirates ID, medicals and renewals

* Contracts, onboarding, probation and reviews

* UAE HR policies, handbook and secure records

**Recruitment support (UK)**

- Write and post adverts; manage job boards

- Screen CVs and schedule interviews

- Right-to-work checks, references and offers

- Hand new starters to payroll and onboarding

- Report time to hire and agency spend

DISCOVER WHO WE ARE
  
  
At LiceDoctors, we are passionate about providing families with safe, effective, and natural lice treatment in the comfort of their homes. Founded by a medical professional with decades of experience, our approach guarantees results. We are more than just a lice removal service-we bring peace of mind and relief to families during stressful times, and our caring, professional technicians are at the heart of that mission. As a company, we're also deeply rooted in giving back to the community through volunteering, supporting domestic violence shelters, and staying active in local outreach. But it's not just about the clients-we're committed to creating a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. We offer flexibility, great pay, and a team that values your contribution!

As our Head Lice Removal Technician, you'll be trained in our 100% all-natural lice removal process, which works every time! A typical appointment lasts about 2 - 2 ½ hours, during which you'll:
  
  

* Remove all lice and nits from your client's hair with precision and care.
* Educate the family on lice prevention and treatment techniques so they feel confident moving forward.
* Be a calming presence in an anxious household, turning what feels like a nightmare into a stress-free experience.

As our part-time Head Lice Removal Technician, you control your availability. You can choose how many appointments you take, anytime between 7 AM and midnight. We only ask that you commit to working a minimum of 2 shifts or 8 hours a week, making this an ideal opportunity for those seeking flexibility! (The number of jobs you receive during your provided availability will vary based on market demand).
  
  
DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES?
  
  

* 18+ years old
* Ability to perform hands-on, repetitive tasks
* Reliable transportation
* Sufficient command of the English language needed for this client facing role
* Pleasant, articulate, patient, and confident

Bonus points if you've worked in the hair or medical fields, but it's not required. What's most important is that you have a positive attitude and enjoy working with families! This job requires similar physical motions to that of a hairstylist. You'll often be working with moms, dads, and caregivers, guiding them through the process like a professional assistant. Many of our technicians actually say that this job is used as a “relaxing stress reliever” for them. We provide paid training to ensure you're fully prepared, so no experience is necessary to become our part-time Head Lice Removal Technician!
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  

* With children (School Nurse, Teacher, teacher aide, school aide, Pre-school, childcare, babysitter, au pair)
* As a Domestic Engineer (stay at home parent, home school, housekeeping)
* In the beauty/hair/spa industry (cosmetics, hairdresser, hair stylist, cosmetologist, barber, colorist, beautician, manicurist/pedicurist, esthetician, braider, salon attendant)
* In healthcare (nurse, school nurse, visiting nurse, HHA, CNA, EMT, PRN, phlebotomist, CMA, RN, CHHA, LPN, Homecare, Medical Lab Tech, Care Coordinator, health clinician, physician assistant, health practitioner, massage/occupation/physical therapist)

**(Note:** You will be paid at our Apprentice Level training pay of $18 per hour before becoming a technician, which may last up to approximately 2 weeks)

Our initial application process is quick, easy, and mobile-friendly. Apply now to be on your way to a rewarding, flexible role that fits your life and brings relief to those in need!

Title: Director of Operations homecare

Title: Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager, you will help deliver the core infrastructure behind Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Azure. Our infrastructure spans over 200 datacenters and 1 million servers, supporting more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. With a focus on environmental sustainability, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands, maintaining Microsoft's position as a world-class cloud provider.

Data Center Operations Construction (DCOC) delivers complex construction and retrofit programs inside live, operational datacenters. The work spans capacity additions, mechanical and electrical equipment replacement, end-of-life remediation, network and deployment enablement, and first-of-kind retrofits, all executed without interrupting the customer availability the sites exist to provide.

The Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager owns the Operations Construction portfolio across a group of assigned metros. Where metro program managers deliver the projects in front of them, this role decides what that portfolio contains: which work advances, which is deferred, which is stopped, and in what order, across metros competing for the same capital, outage windows, vendor capacity, and site operations bandwidth. Accountability sits with the health of the multi-metro portfolio as a whole rather than with any single project inside it.

The role leads the program managers and contract construction and safety managers working across those metros, and is measured on their capability and consistency as much as on delivered projects. It carries the most complex work in its portfolio, including first-of-kind retrofits in live space where no established execution method exists, and converts that work into standards and practice the wider program adopts. Reporting to the Director of Operations Construction, this position represents DCOC to site leadership, engineering, commissioning, and enterprise customer programs.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead portfolio strategy and prioritization across assigned metros, translating capacity, availability, sustainability, and business objectives into executable construction plans while balancing capital, resources, outage windows, vendor capacity, and operational constraints.
* Own portfolio delivery and governance across safety, scope, schedule, budget, commercial performance, and risk, including forecasting, change management, project controls, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, and closeout.
* Exercise independent judgment on complex, high-impact programs, assessing project viability, investment trade-offs, emerging risks, and delivery confidence, and personally leading the most complex, first-of-kind, or highest-risk initiatives when warranted.
* Lead and develop program capability across the portfolio, providing direction, coaching, and technical leadership to program managers and contract construction and safety teams while building workforce capacity, bench strength, and consistent execution practices.
* Develop and scale construction standards and program practices, establishing execution methods for first-of-kind work and translating lessons learned, root cause findings, project controls, and performance data into repeatable standards and playbooks adopted across metros and regions.
* Influence senior stakeholders and delivery partners across site operations, engineering, commissioning, supply chain, security, legal, and enterprise programs, presenting portfolio performance, investment needs, forecasts, and risk in terms that enable clear business decisions and resolve competing priorities.
* Model and champion a safety-first, accountable culture while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values, holding internal teams and external partners to high standards for safety, security, availability, operational excellence, and responsible delivery.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 15+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 17+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
* Applicable certifications: Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.
* 12+ years of experience in construction management, datacenter operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or program management
* 6+ years of experience managing complex project or program portfolios across multiple sites, metros, or regions
* Experience delivering construction in live, mission-critical environments while maintaining operational availability
* Experience leading first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects with accountability for safety, cost, schedule, and risk
* Experience leading and developing teams, including employees, contractors, and cross-functional resources
* Experience managing portfolio governance, commercial performance, vendors, project controls, KPIs, and executive reporting
* PE, PMP, CCM, DBIA, LEED, CQM, ITIL, or equivalent certification preferred

Description:

In 1996, Farmers Depot was established and has grown to be the complete animal health and equipment supplier for livestock producers across Canada providing thousands of quality animal health products at a competitive price with next day delivery, and product support. Farmers Depot is under the GVF Group umbrella and operates in close affiliation with Grand Valley Fortifiers and Fortified Nutrition Limited. Both brands manufacture and sell high-quality, leading-edge vitamin and mineral premixes and supplements for swine, dairy, beef and poultry producers.

  

Today, the GVF Group is comprised of seven divisions: Grand Valley Fortifiers, Fortified Nutrition, Farmers Depot, Direct Source Commodities, Livestack, True Foods, and Kindred Farmers. Across all divisions, we are united by a common purpose – helping our customers achieve better results through innovation, partnership, and trusted advice.

  

Ours is a family business that cares about its employees and its community. We make sure that all our staff get what the best-in-class team members deserve: benefits, good wages, and respect. Whether through our charitable work, or our dedication to staff, GVF is committed to living out our principles and values.

  

**Why we have this role:**

  

At Farmers Depot, providing an exceptional customer experience is at the heart of what we do. We're looking for a **Customer Service Manager** who is passionate about building strong customer relationships, developing people and finding better ways to work.

  

In this role, you'll lead and support our Customer Service team, ensuring our customers receive timely, knowledgeable and reliable service. You'll play an important role in shaping the department's processes, setting performance expectations and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.

  

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who is comfortable leading from the front, coaching their team while also stepping into day-to-day customer service activities when needed. You'll take the time to understand our customers, systems and processes firsthand so you can effectively support the team and lead continuous improvement.

**Working with us:**

This is a permanent, full-time position based out of the Farmers Depot Head Office at 455 Dobbie Drive in Cambridge, Ontario.

Our Customer Service team serves customers Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:30pm. Your regular working hours will be Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

  

As the Customer Service Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the department is appropriately staffed and equipped to serve customers throughout core business hours. Occasional work outside standard hours, including weekends, may be required to meet business needs.

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

**Customer Service Leadership**

  

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and support to the Farmers Depot Customer Service team.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance expectations and accountability.
* Assess team structure, responsibilities, workflows and operational challenges to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build employee capabilities through coaching, training, ongoing feedback and development.
* Address performance concerns and support individual and team development.
* Establish consistent communication practices and team routines that encourage collaboration and accountability.
* Lead the implementation of new and revised processes, ensuring employees are trained and accountable for following established procedures.
* Take a hands-on, player-coach approach by actively supporting day-to-day Customer Service activities, including processing customer orders, responding to inquiries, resolving customer concerns and providing coverage during busy periods.
* Develop a strong understanding of departmental systems, processes and workflows to effectively support the team and identify opportunities to improve operations.

  

**Customer Experience & Performance**

  

* Champion an exceptional customer experience by ensuring customer inquiries and concerns are handled promptly and effectively.
* Identify recurring customer issues and implement corrective actions to prevent them from happening again.
* Establish and support consistent processes for managing escalated customer concerns.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to improve communication, coordination and the overall customer experience.
* Use operational data, KPIs and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service levels.
* Establish and monitor the administration of phone-based marketing and sales campaigns.
* Support cross-departmental managers and product teams in representing products and providing support to producers.

  

**Team Development & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Assess the current capabilities, responsibilities and development needs of the Customer Service team.
* Establish clear role expectations and responsibilities across the department.
* Identify training requirements and implement appropriate development plans.

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Title: Food Hall General Manager

**Reporting to:** Onset Hospitality Executive Team

**Employer:** Onset Fareground LLC

**Location:** Fareground Food Hall, 111 Congress Avenue, Austin, TX

Full-time, salaried, exempt, on-site

**Date:** November 2026

Fareground is downtown Austin’s food hall at 111 Congress Avenue, with local food vendors, two bars and an outdoor courtyard. Onset Hospitality is leading its next chapter.

The General Manager is the senior leader on site, accountable for the guest experience, the team, the vendors and the financial results. The General Manager leads Fareground’s management team, approves all purchasing, manages the budget and P&L with Onset Hospitality, and represents Fareground to the property’s ownership. We are looking for a hands-on leader who builds on what works and raises the standard where needed.

If this describes you, contact us today to join us on this unforgettable journey!

**Culture**

Our team is focused on creating magical guest experiences in an environment of positivity, equity, responsibility and fun. We share ideas openly, experiment without fear of failure, and welcome everyone to be exactly who they are.

Onset Fareground LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state or local law. We believe diversity makes us better.

**Compensation & Benefits**

● Competitive base salary

● Eligible for Onset Fareground LLC’s employee benefits program

**Key Responsibilities**

**Leadership & Transition**

● Lead Fareground’s management team and, through them, all food hall, bar, event and support staff

● Set clear goals for each manager, hold the management team accountable for results, and develop managers and line staff in line with Onset’s succession planning goals

● Act as the on-site ambassador for Onset Hospitality and Fareground with guests, vendors, the 111 Congress community and the wider Austin market

**Guest Experience**

● Set and uphold Fareground’s hospitality standard: including guest interaction standards, vendor operating standards, cleanliness, efficiencies, and community engagement.

● Be visible and engaged on the floor during peak periods, working a schedule that covers opening and closing shifts, as needed.

● Monitor guest satisfaction across all channels, and make sure every online review and guest comment receives a response within 48 hours

● Set the direction for Fareground’s beverage program with the Assistant General Manager – Beverage, and approve bar menus and pricing for the Oak Deck bar and the lower-level bar

● Make sure music, lighting, A/V and live entertainment create the right atmosphere for each daypart and event

**Vendor Performance & Engagement**

● Serve as the primary point of contact for Fareground’s food vendors, building positive, constructive relationships with a steady flow of feedback in both directions

● Check in regularly with each vendor lead to resolve issues and coordinate shared spaces, equipment and deliveries

● Meet with each vendor monthly to review sales, operations, quality and guest feedback, and hold a monthly all-vendor meeting on marketing, events and operations

● Review all vendor food and beverage offerings to make sure quality, price point and style meet Fareground’s standards and the expectations of Austin’s food-savvy guests

● Review the vendor mix and occupancy regularly with Onset Hospitality, and recommend changes that maximize Fareground’s revenue and guest appeal

● Track vendor sales and reporting, and enforce vendor agreements and operating standards, including health permits, certificates of insurance, cleanliness and shared-space rules, with support from the Finance & Admin Coordinator

**Finance & Administration**

● Own Fareground’s annual budget and monthly P&L with Onset Hospitality’s finance team, and make sure managers explain all variances on time

● Approve all purchase orders before they are placed, and obtain Onset Hospitality approval for any spending above approved limits

● Forecast labor and third-party staffing against sales each week, and manage labor cost to budget

● Enforce strict receiving, inventory and cash-handling controls, and take part in monthly inventory counts with the Assistant General Manager – Beverage and the Finance & Admin Coordinator

● Approve payroll and gratuity distributions each pay period before they are released by Onset Hospitality’s finance team

● Support an accurate, on-time month-end close and all period-end financial reports

**Operating Rhythm**

● Weekly: post staff schedules by Wednesday for the following week; lead the management meeting; attend the BEO meeting led by the Director of Catering & Private Events; complete a full weekly walk-through of the food hall, including back of house, storage and restrooms

● Monthly: review the P&L with Onset Hospitality; deliver the ownership report; hold the all-vendor meeting and an all-team meeting; complete inventory

● Quarterly: lead a business review with Onset Hospitality and ownership, and complete a performance review with each vendor

**Ownership & Property Relationship**

● Prepare a monthly ownership report covering sales, P&L, guest feedback, vendor performance, events, and maintenance and capital needs, as directed by Onset Hospitality

● Notify Onset Hospitality immediately of any major incident, and ownership as Onset directs, with a written incident report within 24 hours

● Act as the on-site steward of the property, working with 111 Congress property management on building systems, security, maintenance and capital projects

**Operations, Facilities & Compliance**

● Develop and implement operating standards, policies and procedures for the management team and vendors

● Keep every area (dining areas, courtyard, bars, restrooms, back of house and storage) clean, stocked and in good repair through daily opening and closing checklists, a scheduled cleaning program and the preventive maintenance program

● Oversee porter and cleaning staff or contractors, including an hourly restroom check during service

● Maintain compliance with Austin Public Health, the Austin Fire Department, the City of Austin, the Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) and OSHA requirements, and keep managers current on any changes

● Oversee emergency procedures, security and incident reporting

● Make sure catering and private events are booked, communicated and executed to standard, working with the Director of Catering & Private Events

**Human Resources**

● Hire, train, coach, evaluate and, where needed, discipline all members of the Fareground team, within the approved budget and Onset’s HR policies

● Set the tone for an equitable and positive work environment: listen to the team, respond with appropriate action, and give accurate information

● Lead conflict resolution, corrective action and coaching, and make sure the rest of the management team follows the same standards

● Make sure performance reviews are completed on time and that all staff meet the uniform and grooming standards in the employee handbook

**Marketing & Revenue**

● Approve Fareground’s annual marketing plan and programming calendar with Onset Hospitality, and direct the Marketing & Activation Coordinator and the local PR firm in delivering it

● Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities and issues

● Make sure the calendar of activations, cultural events, pop-ups, DJs and live performances is booked and executed to standard

● Support the Director of Catering & Private Events in growing catering, private event and sponsorship revenue, and approve event pricing under Onset’s approval process

**Performance Measures**

● Track and report key measures to Onset Hospitality, including revenue and controllable profit against budget, labor cost and beverage cost as a percentage of sales, guest review scores and response time, staff retention, health inspection results, zero TABC violations, and vendor sales growth

**Required Skills**

● Ability to lead a management team, delegate effectively and handle many priorities at once

● Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in English, verbally and in writing, with staff, vendors, ownership and the public; Spanish is a plus

● Ability to speak knowledgeably about Fareground’s food, beverage and overall concept

● Ability to model and coach the highest standards of hospitality and service

● Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to read a P&L and act on it

● Strong problem-solving abilities, and the ability to maintain composure under pressure

● Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality, discretion and personal integrity

● Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals

● Positive, respectful attitude and the ability to listen with empathy

**General Requirements**

● 21+ years of age

● Certified Food Protection Manager and TABC seller-server certification, or the ability to obtain both within 30 days of hire

● Proof of eligibility to work in the United States

● High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business or a related field preferred

**Technical Knowledge**

● Minimum of seven to ten (7–10) years of hospitality experience, including at least three (3) years as a general manager or equivalent senior leader in a high-volume food hall, multi-concept or bar-led operation

● Experience managing vendor, tenant or partner relationships in a food hall or similar multi-operator setting preferred

Title: Back of House Manager at Warren Street Hotel
Description:
Are you passionate about providing exceptional customer experiences in a luxury setting? Firmdale Hotels invites you to become a key player in our highly successful team at Warren Street Hotel, where elegance meets outstanding service.

Firmdale Hotels is a collection of award-winning, luxury boutique hotels and restaurants, renowned for their unique design and exceptional service. Each property offers a distinctively stylish experience, reflecting our commitment to excellence and innovation in hospitality.

**Title:** Back of House Manager (Hotel Receiving/Purchasing)

**Location:** Warren Street Hotel

**Position Type:** Full Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** General Manager and Purchasing Manager

**Position Summary**

The Back of House Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the hotel's Back of House department, including inventory and stock control, receiving, food and beverage cost control, linen and operating supplies, minibar operations, and departmental administration.

This position plays a key role in maintaining accurate inventory levels, controlling costs, minimizing waste and loss, ensuring timely replenishment, and maintaining organized and efficient Back of House operations.

The Back of House Manager works closely with Food & Beverage, Culinary, Housekeeping, Finance, Engineering, Purchasing, and other hotel departments to ensure operational needs are anticipated and appropriately supported.

The role also provides direct supervision and leadership to Back of House team members, including the Back of House Assistant Manager, Stock Persons, and Minibar Attendants, and is responsible for maintaining departmental standards, accountability, productivity, and compliance with hotel policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

Inventory & Stock Control

* Manage and monitor inventory across Food & Beverage, Culinary, Housekeeping, linen, minibar, operating equipment, maintenance supplies, and other hotel consumables
* Maintain appropriate par levels based on hotel occupancy, business levels, historical consumption, events, and operational needs
* Ensure timely ordering and replenishment of stock to prevent shortages while minimizing excessive inventory
* Receive, inspect, verify, and properly document deliveries against purchase orders and invoices
* Ensure goods received meet required quantity, quality, condition, and hotel standards
* Maintain accurate inventory records using established inventory management systems and departmental controls
* Conduct and oversee daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic physical inventory counts
* Reconcile physical inventory against system records and investigate variances
* Identify and investigate discrepancies, shortages, damages, losses, expired products, and unusual inventory activity
* Ensure proper storage, labeling, organization, security, and stock rotation, including FIFO procedures where applicable
* Maintain Back of House storage areas in a clean, organized, safe, and operationally efficient condition
* Monitor slow-moving and excess inventory and work with department leaders to reduce unnecessary purchasing and waste.

Food & Beverage Cost Control

* Support the monitoring and management of food and beverage costs in partnership with Culinary, Food & Beverage, and Finance
* Review inventory usage, purchasing, transfers, waste, and variances to identify opportunities for improved cost control
* Monitor food and beverage inventory levels against consumption and business volume
* Assist with monthly food and beverage inventories and preparation of supporting reports
* Investigate significant or unusual cost variances and communicate findings to hotel leadership and Finance
* Monitor waste, breakage, spoilage, complimentary usage, and other areas that may impact food and beverage costs
* Support hotel initiatives designed to reduce waste, loss, over-ordering, and pilferage
* Maintain accurate documentation for inventory transfers and departmental usage.

Minibar Operations

* Oversee the daily operation of the Minibar team and ensure guestroom minibars are stocked, maintained, and serviced according to hotel standards
* Ensure minibar inventory is accurately controlled, replenished, issued, and accounted for
* Monitor minibar consumption, charges, stock variances, expired products, and losses
* Establish and maintain appropriate minibar par levels
* Coordinate with Housekeeping, Front Office, and Finance regarding minibar operations, discrepancies, guest charges, and operational concerns
* Ensure Minibar Attendants are properly trained and consistently follow established procedures.

Linen, Housekeeping & Operating Supplies

* Monitor and maintain appropriate inventory levels for linen, housekeeping supplies, guest supplies, and operating equipment managed through Back of House
* Work closely with Housekeeping and Food & Beverage leadership to forecast linen and supply requirements based on occupancy and operational needs
* Assist with regular linen inventories and reconciliation of discrepancies
* Monitor damaged, discarded, missing, or excessive-use items and identify opportunities to reduce replacement costs
* Maintain accurate records for issuance, transfers, and movement of hotel supplies.

Receiving & Storage

* Ensure all deliveries are received and processed accurately and in accordance with hotel purchasing and receiving procedures
* Verify quantities, pricing, purchase orders, invoices, and product condition as required
* Ensure refrigerated, frozen, perishable, and other sensitive items are stored promptly and appropriately
* Maintain receiving and storage areas according to sanitation, safety, and organizational standards
* Coordinate with Purchasing, Finance, Culinary, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, and other departments regarding deliveries, shortages, substitutions, and discrepancies
* Maintain appropriate controls over access to inventory and storage areas.

Financial Controls & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain accurate inventory, consumption, cost, variance, loss, and stock reports for hotel leadership and Finance
* Review inventory activity for unusual trends or discrepancies and investigate concerns promptly
* Maintain accurate documentation supporting purchases, transfers, write-offs, wastage, and inventory adjustments
* Participate in month-end inventory and financial closing processes as required
* Support budget preparation and forecasting by providing historical usage, cost, and inventory information
* Maintain appropriate financial controls and ensure compliance with Firmdale Hotels policies and procedures

Department Leadership & Team Management

* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction to Back of House employees, including the Back of House Assistant Manager, Stock Persons and Minibar Attendants
* Establish daily priorities, assign duties, monitor completion, and ensure departmental standards are consistently maintained
* Prepare and manage departmental schedules and staffing based on hotel business levels and operational requirements
* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, productivity, performance, and adherence to hotel policies
* Review employee timecards, missed punches, overtime, and other timekeeping matters for accuracy
* Provide coaching, training, feedback, and performance management in partnership with Human Resources and hotel leadership
* Support recruitment, onboarding, orientation, and training of new Back of House employees
* Maintain appropriate departmental documentation and employee records
* Promote a professional, respectful, accountable, and collaborative work environment
* Address operational and employee concerns promptly and escalate significant matters to Human Resources and/or hotel leadership as appropriate.

Interdepartmental Collaboration

* Partner closely with Culinary, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, Front Office, Engineering, Finance, Purchasing, and other departments
* Communicate shortages, supply concerns, cost issues, delivery challenges, inventory discrepancies, and operational risks promptly
* Work with department heads to forecast operational requirements and ensure appropriate stock levels
* Attend hotel operational and leadership meetings as required
* Support hotel-wide projects, events, inventories, audits, and operational initiatives
* Act as a resource to department leaders regarding inventory availability, product usage, cost control, and Back of House procedures

Compliance, Safety & Loss Prevention

* Ensure compliance with hotel policies, purchasing procedures, financial controls, sanitation standards, and applicable health and safety requirements
* Maintain appropriate security and control over hotel inventory, storage rooms, and high-value products
* Identify and report suspected loss, theft, misuse, unusual inventory activity, or policy violations to hotel leadership
* Ensure accurate documentation and transparency in all purchasing, receiving, inventory, transfer, and adjustment processes
* Maintain confidentiality when handling financial, payroll, employee, and operational information
* Support internal and external audits and maintain records in an audit-ready condition.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years relevant experience in hotel operations, inventory management, stock control, purchasing, receiving, cost control, or a related hospitality function preferred
* Luxury hotel or hospitality experience required
* Previous supervisory or management experience required
* Experience with Food & Beverage inventory and food-cost control strongly preferred
* Experience overseeing minibar, receiving, storeroom, or hotel supply operations preferred
* Strong numerical, analytical, organizational, and administrative skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and inventory management systems
* Experience with scheduling, timekeeping, payroll processes, and employee supervision preferred

* Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions while collaborating effectively with hotel leadership and department heads.

**Core Competencies**

Inventory Management • Food & Beverage Cost Control • Financial Accuracy • Leadership & Supervision • Minibar Operations • Receiving & Stock Control • Loss Prevention • Analytical Thinking • Organization • Problem Solving • Communication • Integrity & Accountability • Interdepartmental Collaboration

**Working Conditions**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

Are you willing to dive deep to develop those solutions and deliver results? As a retail intern in one of those categories, you will learn how Amazon handles its e-commerce retail business. Working alongside a vendor manager to help provide a suite of services designed to support Amazon's most strategic brands within one of our retail categories. Your priority will be to work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow brands and improve their performance.

As an intern, you’ll gain a deep understanding of Amazon's display advertising products as well as our technical and operational capabilities. You’ll learn when and how we can create custom opportunities, and you’ll help our account managers create compelling presentations to delight our clients.

* As an intern, you will be responsible for helping our account managers to deliver new business growth across Amazon’s third party merchants.
* Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered by advertising or merchant services
* Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence
* Learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio and the Amazon culture
* Identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools

* Develop the analytical and problem-solving skills that our people are known for

* Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027. You should be available for 3 to 6 months, full time (40h/week).

As an intern, you will be matched to a mentor.  
In addition to learning about an impactful project, you will have the  
opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional  
development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other  
interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship,  
we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.  
  
About the team  
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.  

* Competitive pay
* Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
* Networking opportunities with fellow interns
* Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
* Mentorship and career development

  
If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies  
  
Internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time.

------------------------

* Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor's or Master's Degree with a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028
* Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English
* Available to commence an internship between January and December 2027. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available for 3-6 months, full time (40h/week).

Title: Director - Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Operations (RD 4)
Description:
Lead the development and implementation of health, safety, environmental and worker welfare governance across City Operations, translating enterprise requirements into operational standards, contractual requirements and assurance activities for City Operations-managed assets and services. Oversee compliance, audits, incident learning and corrective action, support the City Command Unit during incidents, and ensure operational readiness and safe transition of assets into live operations.

**Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Governance**

* Lead the development and implementation of City Operations health, safety and worker welfare governance, translating Strategic Delivery Unit (SDU) policies, standards and guidelines and applicable legal requirements into operational procedures.
* Establish City Operations minimum requirements and contractual schedules for health, safety and worker welfare, ensuring service providers and contractors understand the standards against which their performance will be assured.
* Maintain and improve the health, safety and worker welfare framework as the city asset base, services and workforce expand.
* Define induction, training and competency requirements for City Operations employees and relevant service providers.

**Operational Compliance and Assurance**

* Direct the risk-based assurance programme across City Operations-managed assets, public realm and operational services, covering compliance reviews, inspections, audits and follow-up activities.
* Monitor contractor, operator and service-provider compliance, directing corrective action through the relevant contract and service owners.
* Track performance through incident data, risk registers, permit-to-work compliance, regulatory reporting, leading indicators and corrective-action status.
* Report material risks, non-conformances, trends and overdue actions to leadership, escalating issues affecting people, public safety, compliance or Qiddiya’s reputation.
* Stop unsafe work within the City Operations remit where required and coordinate formal corrective action through the accountable contract holder.

**Worker Welfare Operations**

* Lead oversight of worker welfare conditions for employees and contracted workforces within the City Operations remit, recognising the public-facing nature of operational workers.
* Establish and monitor welfare requirements covering working conditions, welfare facilities, access to support and applicable Saudi labour and welfare requirements.
* Coordinate with workplace, accommodation, contractor and service-provider teams to address welfare risks and escalate unresolved issues.
* Build internal worker welfare capability through recruitment, development and knowledge transfer.

**Environmental Compliance**

* Oversee environmental compliance across City Operations-managed assets, public spaces and service arrangements, focusing on prevention of harm and compliance with approved environmental management plans.
* Establish requirements for pollution prevention and control, including oil and chemical storage, waste handling, noise and nuisance.
* Monitor contractors and service providers against environmental requirements, ensuring incidents, non-conformances and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Coordinate environmental reporting and relevant Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) inputs while maintaining the distinction between environmental compliance and broader

sustainability ownership.

**Incident Management and Operational Resilience**

* Provide health, safety, environmental and worker welfare subject-matter expertise to the City Command Unit during incidents, crises and emergency exercises.
* Support the Gold, Silver and Bronze response structure by advising on technical risks, immediate controls, regulatory requirements and recovery actions.
* Develop, maintain and test relevant crisis playbooks in alignment with City Command Unit and Operational Resilience requirements.
* Lead or oversee post-incident and near-miss investigations within the remit, ensuring root causes, lessons learned and preventive actions are embedded.

**Asset Readiness and Handover**

* Define health, safety, environmental and worker welfare requirements for new assets and services entering City Operations, engaging with delivery teams from design through handover.
* Lead readiness reviews from the agreed pre-handover period, validating operational requirements, documentation, controls and service arrangements before go-live.
* Provide functional sign-off and readiness input for handover and takeover processes, escalating unresolved risks through stage-gate and governance forums.
* Work with City Assets Management and delivery teams to transfer defects, risks, warranties, procedures and assurance findings into live operations.

**Stakeholder and Regulatory Coordination**

* Act as the City Operations focal point for health, safety, environmental and worker welfare matters with SDU, City Assets Management, delivery teams, operational functions and central QIC stakeholders.
* Coordinate with contract holders and service providers to embed requirements into scopes of work, mobilization plans, procedures and performance reviews.
* Support engagement with relevant regulators, authorities and emergency-response stakeholders, ensuring submissions, observations and actions are coordinated and closed out.
* Maintain constructive relationships while preserving the professional judgement required to challenge unsafe or non-compliant practices.

**Capability, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead development of the Health, Safety and Worker Welfare team in line with the phased asset handover plan.
* Establish dashboards and management information combining lagging and leading indicators to identify emerging risks and guide improvement.
* Review assurance findings, incident trends and operational feedback to improve standards, contracts, procedures and service-provider performance.
* Promote a proactive culture while ensuring accountability remains with the teams and providers delivering the work.

 **Requirements**

**Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Health and Safety, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Environmental Management, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred:** Master’s degree in Health and Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional certifications or memberships with recognized health and safety, environmental, worker welfare, emergency management or related professional institutes are preferred; Chartered or equivalent professional standing is preferred.

A minimum of 10-12 years of experience in health and safety, occupational health and safety, environmental compliance, worker welfare, operational assurance or related fields is required, including relevant experience in a leadership role.

Demonstrated experience leading health, safety and worker welfare governance and assurance across complex operational, infrastructure, development or asset environments, including establishing standards and contractual requirements; overseeing contractor compliance; leading audits, inspections, investigations and corrective actions; supporting asset readiness and handover; advising on incident and crisis response; and coordinating with delivery teams, asset owners, regulators and public authorities. Experience across the asset lifecycle and in the Middle East is preferred.

Title: Safety Manager

**LOCATION:** Woodruff, SC

The Safety Manager is to lead workplace safety within our warehouse operations. This position partners with operations leadership and employees to identify hazards, prevent injuries, strengthen safety practices, and maintain compliance with applicable requirements. The safety manager is comfortable spending time on the warehouse floor, coaching employees and supervisors, and following corrective actions through completion. * Lead and continuously improve the facility’s safety programs, policies, and procedures.

* Monitor safety performance, analyze incident trends, and communicate improvement priorities to leadership.

* Support emergency preparedness, evacuation drills, fire prevention, and contractor safety.

* Coordinate with Human Resources and operations on incident follow-up, workers’ compensation matters, and return-to-work activities.

* Provides information to top management on accidents, causes, and costs and recommends long-range accident reduction and cost containment objectives.

* Acts as company representative in dealing with government agencies on safety and health matters.

* Stays abreast of current policies, regulations, and industrial processes, and ensures compliance with safety and environmental regulatory agencies.

* Experience conducting incident investigations, safety inspections, employee training, and corrective action follow-up.
