* Sound judgment and the ability to address unsafe conditions promptly and professionally.

* Strong organizational skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

* Ability to work across shifts as needed to support training, investigations, and operational needs.

Assign leads and set **individual performance expectations within management’s targets**. Review calls, messages, output and conversion, maintain sales standards and recommend staffing or performance actions.

**Expert and Firm Acquisition and Onboarding**

**Provider funnel** Lead → Contacted → Interested → Registration Started → Registered → Verified → Client-Ready → Available → Bookable

· Acquire suitable UAE experts and firms by profession, service and category. Prioritise approved commercial needs and gaps in verified, available, bookable supply. Continue building general supply, including firms that can activate multiple experts and services, and expand beyond minimum readiness thresholds as demand grows.

· Turn supply gaps into sourcing requirements for Commercial, Operations and IT, including the Xpertyy Scraper. Recover incomplete registrations through direct follow-up. Explain Xpertyy’s value, handle objections and help resolve gaps in documents, profiles, services, pricing, availability or verification. Track time to Client-Ready, reduce abandonment and escalate product or process barriers.

**Customer Acquisition and Sales**

**Customer funnel** Lead or Enquiry → Qualified Need → Expert Match → Booking → Payment → Completed Transaction → Repeat Activity

· Run B2B and B2C sales for services ready for market testing, aligned with Product Marketing campaigns. Qualify needs, use **Human Concierge** for assisted matching and help close key or high-value deals. Diagnose drop-offs and build follow-up and repeat-business practices.

**Lead Generation and Conversion Testing**

· Build a mix of cold calling, direct outreach, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Xpertyy Scraper and approved sourcing tools, existing CRM lists, professional directories, events, exhibitions, associations, networks, referrals, warm introductions, approved partnerships and inbound enquiries. Use compliant channels.

· Track each source through qualification, contact, interest and conversion to **Client-Ready status or paid transaction**. Compare channels, messages, services and lead sources. Use recurring objections and journey data to fix friction, reduce or stop weak approaches and scale those that convert.

**Freshsales CRM Ownership**

· Own day-to-day CRM quality. Maintain accurate stages, sources, ownership, notes and activity history. Prevent and resolve duplicates, prioritise Hot/Warm/Cold leads, monitor pipeline ageing and require a **next action and date for every active lead**. Record specific lost or not-interested reasons where available, plus incomplete registration and customer drop-off reasons. Report reliable conversion data to management.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

· **Commercial & Operations Lead.** Align on commercial direction and priorities, escalate blockers and report results.

· **Product Marketing.** Align on target audiences, positioning, campaigns and approved messaging. Sales owns scripts, outreach sequences, objection handling, follow-up, channel testing and conversion recommendations. Product Marketing owns brand positioning, marketing and campaign strategy, creative direction, advertising and brand content. Share customer and provider feedback backed by evidence.

· **Product.** Address readiness, onboarding friction and product requirements affecting conversion.

· **IT.** Coordinate Freshsales, automation, integrations, data sourcing, Xpertyy Scraper and other technical tools.

· **Finance.** Review pricing, transaction information, unit economics and financial performance.

· **PMO.** Track major actions, blockers, dependencies and deadlines. Bring proposed solutions and follow through.

Qualifications and Experience

· **Mandatory.** Strong practical experience in sales, business development, acquisition or commercial operations. Demonstrated experience building or materially improving a sales process, team or function and managing or coaching sales resources. Hands-on outbound prospecting, qualification, negotiation, follow-up and closing. Strong CRM and pipeline management, including using funnel data to improve conversion. Fluent spoken and written Arabic and English, strong UAE business knowledge and the ability to take ownership independently in a startup.

· **Strongly preferred.** Experience in SaaS, digital or two-sided marketplaces, technology platforms, professional-services marketplaces, recruitment or staffing platforms, B2B digital businesses or other technology-enabled services. UAE or MENA acquisition, Freshsales or comparable CRM, B2B and B2C acquisition, LinkedIn or prospecting tools, data-driven sourcing, sales automation and outsourced call centres are advantageous. A bachelor’s degree in business, sales, marketing or a related field is preferred. Strong practical experience can compensate for a different academic background.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Prioritise **commercial conversion and outcomes**. Use activity and pipeline measures to identify where conversion can improve.

· **Expert and firm supply.** New Client-Ready providers and new available or bookable providers. Conversion from interest to registration, registration start to completion, and completion to Verified or Client-Ready. Time from lead creation to Client-Ready, priority supply gaps closed and cost per Client-Ready provider where measurable.

· **Leads and CRM.** Qualified lead conversion and overall conversion by source or channel, active pipeline ageing, percentage of active leads with a valid next action and date, follow-up completion, quality of lost reasons, CRM accuracy and duplicate control.

· **Customers and transactions.** Qualified enquiries, enquiry-to-booking and booking-to-paid conversion, completed transactions, sales-generated gross merchandise value (GMV) and revenue, repeat customer activity and drop-off reasons.

· **Team performance.** Productivity and conversion by team member, lead response and follow-up, coaching and performance improvement, and sales process efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**

A hands-on builder who can create structure in an early-stage marketplace, step in to close and manage people as the team grows. Use evidence to diagnose conversion failures, propose practical fixes and improve processes continuously. Take accountability for results and build a function that relies increasingly on repeatable processes as Xpertyy grows.

Pay: AED12,000.00 - AED15,000.00 per month

Title: Regional Sales Manager - Cross Border Trading & Imported Building Material
Description:
***About Us***
--------------

Backed by top regional and global VCs, **BRKZ is Saudi Arabia's fastest-growing construction-tech startup**. Our web platform, mobile apps and WhatsApp channels give contractors instant access to 7,000+ building-material SKUs from 1,100+ vetted suppliers, with quotes in minutes and buy-now-pay-later financing built in. In just two years we have on-boarded 850+ contracting companies, supported giga-projects such as **NEOM** and **King Salman Park**, and scaled RFQs to $350 million while keeping positive unit economics.

You can read more about BRKZ's latest news on Forbes, TechCrunch & Wamda.

  

**Job Summary:**
----------------

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven **Regional Sales Manager – Cross-Border (X-Border)** to lead and scale our international sales operations for imported building materials with extended lead times. The ideal candidate will combine deep regional market expertise with strong commercial leadership, excelling at navigating cross-border trade dynamics, managing client expectations around shipping durations, and structuring advance payment terms. This role requires a proactive leader who can build high-performing regional channels, align closely with Procurement and Logistics teams, and drive revenue growth across key international markets.

**What You will do (Responsibilities) :**
-----------------------------------------

* **Regional Expansion:** Identify, develop, and execute go-to-market strategies to capture new business opportunities across target cross-border territories in the construction and building materials sector.
* **Channel & Key Account Leadership:** Establish, manage, and scale strategic partnerships with major regional retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and contractors.
* **Cross-Border Advisory:** Educate regional partners on the value proposition of imported materials, international lead times, Incoterms, and cross-border logistical considerations.
* **End-to-End Supply Chain Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, and Customs/Logistics teams to ensure smooth cross-border transit, accurate shipment tracking, and on-time project delivery.
* **Commercial Proposals & Tenders:** Oversee the preparation and presentation of commercial quotations, regional proposals, product specifications, and samples to high-value accounts.
* **High-Stakes Negotiation:** Negotiate multi-tier pricing, volume commitments, and advance payment terms (including LCs/TT) to maximize regional profitability and market competitiveness.
* **Regional Demand Forecasting:** Partner with Procurement to analyze regional demand signals, optimize inventory allocation, and manage stock levels across markets.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor regional economic shifts, regulatory/tariff changes, competitor activities, and global pricing fluctuations to adjust commercial strategy proactively.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the senior point of escalation to resolve complex cross-border customer inquiries, customs delays, or order-related issues efficiently.
* **Executive Reporting:** Track regional sales pipelines, prepare comprehensive market feedback reports, and present actionable territory insights and growth forecasts to senior leadership.

  

**Who You are (Qualifications & Experience) :**
-----------------------------------------------

  

* **Experience:** Minimum 5–8+ years of B2B sales and regional management experience in building materials, construction supplies, or international trade.

* **Lead-Time Mastery:** Proven track record of managing extended shipping lead times and aligning client expectations on large-scale or complex orders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated success in high-value B2B negotiations, structuring advance payment terms, and managing multi-country distributor networks.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides), alongside CRM and pipeline reporting tools.
* **Leadership & Autonomy:** Entrepreneurial, target-driven, and capable of operating independently to build out new territories from the ground up.
* **Mobility:** Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the region for key client meetings, trade shows, and site visits.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Great opportunity to be part of a start-up with a lot of responsibility and independence early on and where you will have an impact on the entire business
* Attractive compensation package (Competitive base salary + commission structure)
* Product first mindset
* The best idea wins; we are all ears when it comes to ways to do things better
* Exciting stock options
* Career growth opportunities within a fast-growing company.

If you are passionate about **sales, construction materials, and international trade**, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team!

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Head Coach (Store Manager)
Description:
Rally House is where fans celebrate the teams, traditions, and communities they love. Every day is an opportunity to create memorable experiences that bring fans closer to the moments and teams they care about most. Behind it all is a team fueled by energy, passion, and hometown pride. As we continue to grow, we're looking for team members who are excited to help shape the future of Rally House, deliver exceptional experiences, and make every fan feel right at home.

**Job Description**

The Head Coach acts as the Store Manager and is responsible for leading the overall performance and culture of the store. This role builds and develops a strong team, ensures consistent execution of operational, merchandising, and service standards, and drives sales and profitability. The Head Coach creates clarity, commitment, and fosters an environment of engagement, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Competencies**

* **Drive for Results:** Holds self to high standards and pushes through challenges to deliver results.
* **Customer Centric:** Models, coaches, and inspires an exceptional customer experience. Builds community connections to strengthen the brand.
* **Builds High Performance Teams:** Builds an engaged, motivated team. Coaches and develops team members. Retains talent and ensures bench strength.
* **Problem Solving:** Is solution oriented, sees problems as opportunities. Looks beyond the obvious and doesn’t stop at the first answers. Keeps the goal in mind and is not easily deterred.
* **Decision Quality:** Considers options carefully. Balances data and judgment to make sound day-to-day decisions.
* **Communicates Effectively:** Gives direct, complete, and actionable feedback. Listens intently. Allows ideas to be shared.

**Responsibilities**

**People**

* Attract, hire, develop, and retain top talent
* Create a culture of engagement, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Build a succession pipeline through intentional development plans
* Lead performance management, accountability, and recognition

**Operations**

* Set priorities and ensure execution of all operational standards
* Serve as the subject matter expert for all store operations
* Validate process execution through inspection and coaching
* Ensure compliance with all policies, safety standards, and controls

**Merchandising**

* Own store presentation and sales-driving visual execution
* Ensure fixtures, flow, and product placement maximize performance
* Partner with leadership to adapt merchandising to local market needs
* Hold the team accountable to cleanliness and organization standards

**Service**

* Champion the customer experience and service culture
* Evaluate the store environment through the customer perspective daily
* Ensure consistent delivery of the Party service model
* Address systemic service gaps and coach leaders to sustain excellence

**Results**

* Own store sales performance, payroll, and expense control
* Lead execution of high-volume events and hot markets
* Analyze results, set goals, and drive sustained performance improvement
* Build a results-driven culture through clarity, focus, and accountability

**Skills and Knowledge**

Ability to analyze performance, identify opportunities, and drive improvement, Advanced leadership and coaching skills with the ability to build high-performing teams, Deep understanding of store operations, service standards, and execution, Enthusiastic attitude with a passion for sports and retail

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in retail
* 2+ years of store management and leadership experience
* Associates or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Availability to work 40 hours per week with open availability including daytime, nights, weekends, holidays, and featured local sports events

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods of time
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
* Ability to bend, reach, and climb ladders

**Pay Range**

$24.40 - $35.35

STORE MANAGER

**Title:** Store Manager

  

**Reports To:** District Manager

  

**Reporting to this Position:** Assistant Store Manager, Jewelry Consultant, Sales Support and Inventory Control

**Position Summary:**

Reporting to the District Manager (DM), the Store Manager (SM) will lead the day-to-day operations of a single store to achieve all sales, profitability, customer satisfaction, inventory control, brand representation, and team member growth and development to maximize the results of the store. Through personal selling, leadership, and coaching, the SM will champion a People First store environment that promotes diversity and inclusion, the development of life-time relationships with customers and the delivery of a best-in-class customer experience.

**Vision and Purpose:**

Communicates performance expectations and ensures all team members understand the impact of their performance on company success. Coaches and develops the store staff to instill understanding of brand image and to ensure consistent representation of the brand in customer interactions and execution of store visuals and marketing. Supports and communicates the strategic relevance of corporate initiatives and executes corporate plans to produce desired results. Asks questions to ensure full understanding of strategy and process and ensures staff understands how the goals will be achieved. Demonstrates the highest level of professionalism to customers and team members by displaying integrity and honesty at all times, and by conducting himself/herself in a manner that will influence and earn the respect of team members and management. Displays a positive and enthusiastic attitude so as to inspire and motive others to achieve and attain goals.

**Customer Obsession:**

Responsible for ensuring team members, and self, deliver an exceptional customer experience every time through training, customer outreach, communication and clear expectations. Empowers team members to respond to and resolve customer issues within established parameters and drives a high level of customer service through follow-up and customer outreach

Compiles and follows up on customer requests.

**Critical Thinking & Innovative Action:**

Attains sales projections and sales quotas as set by the Company and develops strategies to maximizes both personal and team members sales potential while achieving goals. Observes operations to identify successes and opportunities for improvement. Recognizes strengths and identifies root cause of operational problems. Coaches the store staff to address and correct. Reviews and analyzes reports. Identifies trends, opportunities and available resources and develops plans to address issues. Keeps management informed of the marketing, merchandising, and payment programs of the competitors within the area and advises management new or changing merchandise and services needs and excesses. Implements initiatives that will change behaviors to produce results. Works with Signet SMs in the same mall or general vicinity to foster an environment of open communication, collaboration, efficient use of resources, and accomplishment of shared objectives. Demonstrates an ability to motivate, persuade, and influence the actions of others.

**Employee Experience:**

Demonstrates a commitment to the Company’s People First vision. Responsible for the selection and development of talent to drive store growth. Provides a compelling onboarding experience and ongoing coaching and development in the areas of operations, sales techniques, customer service, product knowledge, inventory control and visual merchandising. Communicates performance expectations, sets actionable goals for self and others and monitors progress and performance against desired behaviors. Maintains open communication with team members and management, encouraging participation and idea sharing. Maintain accuracy of team member data in system records to ensure team members receive eligible Total Rewards.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:**

Responsible for establishing a positive, professional work atmosphere in which team members are able to bring their full self to work and want to do their best. Ensure all team members, guests and vendors are treated with respect and valued for their contribution. Demonstrates the ability to communicate, understand, and empathize with others.

**Performance Excellence:**

Responds promptly and accurately to all management directives, requests for merchandise transfers, inventories, and request for information. Maintains the neatness and cleanliness of the location to represent the banner. Responsible for compliance with Company policies and practices. Conducts himself/herself in a manner that will merit the goodwill and respect of customers and fellow employees. Achieve outstanding sales performance and increase profit margins by controlling discounting, expenses, payroll, and repair departments. Work a schedule based on the right time to effectively run your business including a combination of both opening and closing shifts, weekday and weekends dependent on operating hours, sales requirements, customer traffic, proper store coverage and time to coach, train and develop your team. Typical hours should aim for a five-day, 40-hour work week during non-peak hours. Hours will increase during peak selling periods.

* Performs additional duties and projects as assigned.
* Consistent regular scheduled attendance is considered an essential function of this job.

**Work Schedule:**

* During non-peak periods, managers should aim for a five-day, 40-hour work week.
* Schedule based on the right time to effectively run your business.
* A combination of both opening and closing shifts should be scheduled throughout the week, keeping in mind:Operating hours, sales requirements, customer traffic, proper store coverage and time to coach, train and develop your team.

NOTE: Hours will increase during peak selling periods.

**Position Qualifications:**

* Education Required: Minimum of 2 years of college preferred
* Required or Acceptable Job-Related Experience: at least 3 years of retail sales experience, **OR** 2 years retail sales experience plus a minimum of 1-year retail management experience.
* Preference will be given to candidates with specialty retail or jewelry experience
* Years of Job-Related Experience Required: at least 3 years of retail sales experience, **OR** 2 years retail sales experience plus a minimum of 1-year retail management experience.
* Preference will be given to candidates with specialty retail or jewelry experience.
* Preference will be given to candidates that are Diamond Council of America (DCA) certified.
* Technical/Other Skills Required: Advanced Communication skillset, both written and verbal.
* Proficient with computers, with advanced proficiency in MS Office and other related business, technology, and communication tools.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build effective employee and customer relationships.
* Advanced presentation skills to provide effective team member training and excellent customer presentations.
* Strong problem solving and conflict management skills to support internal and external customers.
* Ability to present themselves in a professional manner while communicating via email, social media, video conference, telephonic and text.
* Ability to plan and organize tasks to meet deadlines and expectations.
* Ability to work independently without immediate supervision.
* Ability to effectively set priorities, develop a plan to meet goals and expectations and to effectively delegate to others for the success of the team.
* Ability to understand and thoroughly explain detailed information.
* Reliable and dependable.

Additional Language(s) Required: Bilingual skills are a plus.

**Physical Demands:**

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and comprehend others. This job regularly requires the employee to stand, to reach with hands and arms, and to move between display cases to handle and/or feel merchandise. The employee is also required to sit, stoop, bend, kneel or crouch as needed. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. This job requires visual acuity sufficient to discern differences in quality of gemstones with or without the aid of a jeweler’s loupe. Standard workweek regularly includes weekends, evenings, holiday, and extended hours. Travel to training sessions and business meetings including air travel and overnight travel may be required.

Base pay, $24.04 – $32.60 plus commission on sales. Final pay rate shall be determined and is based on experience and qualifications.

Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.

In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

Title: Sr. Manager Warehouse and Distribution
Description:
OVERVIEW

The Senior Manager, Warehouse & Logistics leads the safe, accurate and efficient movement of products through Perfect Sports Canada Inc.’s Aurora distribution facility. This hands-on role is accountable for inventory integrity, EDI order fulfillment, logistics coordination, warehouse systems and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Warehouse Manager, Sales, Finance, manufacturing partners and Quality, the Senior Manager translates business priorities into practical operating plans, supports daily execution and resolves issues on the warehouse floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead receiving, storage, replenishment, picking, packing and shipping across the 50,000 sq. ft. distribution facility, including its eight dock doors; participate directly when workload or operational issues require support.

* Coordinate daily priorities with the Warehouse Manager to align people, equipment and space with order volumes, inbound deliveries and customer commitments. Provide clear handovers and timely escalation of constraints.

* Manage inbound deliveries from manufacturing partners and outbound Canadian, international and intercompany U.S. shipments; coordinate carriers, third-party logistics providers and delivery appointments.

* Monitor EDI orders through the Minotaur ERP system from receipt to dispatch. Resolve inventory, allocation and transaction exceptions with the appropriate teams and confirm orders progress within required timelines.

* Ensure fulfillment meets customer routing guides, pallet and carton specifications, labels, shipping notices and documentation requirements; investigate chargebacks and recurring service failures.

* Maintain accurate inventory quantities, locations, lot numbers and expiry dates in the ERP system; lead cycle counts, physical counts, variance investigations and approved inventory adjustments.

* Apply first-expiry-first-out or first-in-first-out controls as appropriate. Monitor aging, short-dated, damaged and slow-moving stock and recommend timely action to management.

* Coordinate replenishment and product availability with Sales, Finance and manufacturing partners. Flag shortages and excess stock early and support demand and capacity planning.

* Ensure receiving checks identify quantity discrepancies, damage and documentation gaps; record exceptions before carrier departure where practical and coordinate resolution.

* Coordinate freight bookings, bills of lading, packing lists, export and customs documentation with carriers, brokers and internal teams; verify accuracy and resolve shipment delays or claims.

* Work with Quality and the designated Quality Assurance Person to execute applicable GMP, CFIA and Health Canada procedures. Maintain lot traceability, segregation, storage conditions, sanitation and allergen controls where applicable.

* Maintain effective controls for quarantined, returned, recalled and rejected products. Support traceability exercises, audits and corrective actions; obtain Quality authorization before releasing held stock.

* Ensure product transfers, write-offs and disposal follow documented approvals. Verify the approved product list, quantities and disposition before arranging transport or destruction and retain supporting records.

* Enforce safe practices for racking, docks, pedestrian traffic, loading, cargo securement and material handling equipment. Coordinate inspections, maintenance and corrective action with responsible parties.

* Verify operator training and authorization before equipment use; operate equipment only when trained and authorized. Address unsafe conditions promptly and report incidents and near misses.

* Coordinate company delivery van inspections, maintenance records, safe loading and driver procedures with designated staff, escalating defects or compliance concerns before use.

* Coach and develop warehouse staff in collaboration with the Warehouse Manager and HR. **Reinforce respectful communication,** clear expectations, training completion and consistent accountability.

* Plan staffing and equipment needs against workload and budget. Obtain required management approval before temporary labour bookings, overtime commitments, freight exceptions or other spending; coordinate approved arrangements with the Warehouse Manager.

* Develop and maintain practical SOPs and operational reporting. Track service, inventory, productivity, safety and cost performance; investigate root causes and implement measurable improvements.

* Work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, Quality and manufacturing partners to resolve operational issues, communicate risks and close assigned actions on time.

Title: IT Technician
Description:
Job Purpose

The IT Technician will provide technical support and ensure the smooth operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT systems and equipment. The role involves supporting staff and users by maintaining IT infrastructure, resolving technical issues, and ensuring the effective use of technology across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

**1. IT Infrastructure & System Maintenance**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, projectors, and other IT equipment.
* Assist in maintaining networks, servers, Wi-Fi connectivity, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor the performance of IT systems and report technical issues requiring further attention.
* Ensure all IT equipment and software are properly maintained and updated.
* Support the installation and configuration of operating systems and software applications.

**2. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide timely technical support to employees and users.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
* Respond to IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved within appropriate timelines.
* Assist users with email configuration, Microsoft Office applications, printers, and other business-related software.
* Maintain records of technical issues, solutions, and support requests.

**3. Network & System Administration**

* Assist in monitoring and maintaining LAN, WAN, and wireless network infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity and internet access issues.
* Support user account creation, access management, and password resets.
* Assist with server maintenance, system updates, and software installations.
* Monitor network performance and report potential security or operational concerns.

**4. IT Security & Data Protection**

* Ensure computers and other IT devices are protected with appropriate antivirus and security software.
* Assist in implementing IT security policies and procedures.
* Support regular data backups and recovery procedures.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and data protection requirements.
* Report suspicious activities, security incidents, and potential vulnerabilities to the IT Manager.

**5. Technology & User Support**

* Provide technical assistance for business applications, digital platforms, and communication systems.
* Troubleshoot audio-visual equipment, projectors, interactive screens, and other devices.
* Assist in setting up IT equipment for meetings, presentations, and corporate events.
* Guide users in the effective use of IT systems and applications.

**6. IT Asset & Inventory Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of computers, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.
* Assist with the installation, configuration, and distribution of IT equipment.
* Monitor equipment conditions and coordinate repairs or replacements.
* Ensure proper documentation of IT assets, licenses, and software installations.

Qualifications & Experience

* MBA - IT/ Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant discipline is required.
* Minimum of **4 years of relevant IT technical support or IT operations experience**.
* Practical experience in hardware and software troubleshooting, network support, and IT infrastructure maintenance.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications, operating systems, and business software.

Key Skills

* IT hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Network installation, maintenance, and administration.
* Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic server administration and user account management.
* Cybersecurity awareness and data protection.
* Technical documentation and IT asset management.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Supportive and dynamic work environment.

Job Type: Full-time

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* IT: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

Title: Chef De Partie – Mexican Cuisine

Title: Materials Management Associate (Part-time regular)
Description:
Located in the metropolitan area of Sacramento, the Adventist Health corporate headquarters have been based in Roseville, California, for more than 40 years. In 2019, we unveiled our WELL-certified campus - a rejuvenating place for associates systemwide to collaborate, innovate and connect.
  
  
Adventist Health Roseville and shared service teams have access to enjoy a welcoming space designed to promote well-being and inspire your best work.

Job Summary:

Stocks and maintains inventory within the healthcare facility. Ensures that essential medical supplies and equipment are readily available to support patient care and hospital operations.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required
* Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred

* Ensures that received items meet quality and safety standards. Verifies that products are properly stored and labeled. Collaborates with leadership to address any quality issues. Maintains accurate records of all inventory transactions, including receipts, issues, and returns. Generates reports to analyze inventory levels and consumption patterns. Assists with data entry into the hospital's materials management software.
* Communicates with suppliers to place orders, track deliveries, and resolve issues. Collaborates with the disaster preparedness team to ensure the availability of essential supplies in case of emergencies. Maintains a contingency stock of critical items for unexpected situations.
* Ensures compliance with all relevant regulations and standards, including infection control protocols. Implements safety measures in handling, storing, and distributing hazardous materials. Supports product recall requirements to insure patient safety.
* Trains hospital staff on proper inventory management practices. Stays updated on industry best practices and participates in relevant training as needed.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Title: Sr. Safety Advisor
Description:
Date: Nov 12, 2026

Location:
Toronto, ON, CA

Operating Sector: Primarily Major Civils

**Position Title:** **Sr. Safety Advisor**
==========================================

**Who We Are**

The ONxpress Civils Contractor General Partnership, a partnership between FCC Canada Limited and Aecon Infrastructure Management Inc., is a multidisciplinary Civils Joint Venture (CJV) team with global expertise in delivering innovative solutions for both railway and civil construction projects. Working under Alliance agreements with Metrolinx, the team is helping to modernize railway construction across the GO Transit network.

  

An Alliance framework, which is relatively new in Canada, is a collaborative partnership between the owner and contractor, who work together with a best-for-project mindset. By streamlining decision making, the Alliance helps ensure that high-quality work is delivered, certified, and transferred in a progressive, transparent, and risk-managed manner.

  

The Alliance operates with a core focus on safety, efficiency, and sustainability, while fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and rights-holders and contributing positively to local communities as a good neighbour. Through this collaborative approach, the Alliance is helping drive the modernization of key sections of the rail network as part of the GO Expansion Program.

  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a progressive and modern way of working, we want to hear from you.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Risk Assessment and Management:** Conducting comprehensive risk assessments of construction sites to identify potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks to ensure the safety of workers and visitors.

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensuring that all construction activities comply with relevant health and safety regulations, codes, and standards set forth by local authorities and regulatory bodies.

* **Training and Education:** Providing training sessions and educational materials to construction workers and site managers on safety protocols, procedures, and best practices to prevent accidents and injuries.

* **Incident Investigation and Reporting:** Investigating accidents, incidents, and near misses on construction sites, determining root causes, and implementing corrective actions to prevent similar occurrences in the future. They also ensure that all incidents are accurately documented and reported as per regulatory requirements.

* **Safety Inspections and Audits:** Conducting regular inspections and audits of construction sites to assess compliance with safety standards, identify potential hazards, and recommend corrective actions to improve safety performance.

* **Safety Planning and Implementation:** Collaborating with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to develop comprehensive health and safety plans for construction projects. They oversee the implementation of these plans, monitor progress, and make adjustments as necessary to ensure ongoing safety throughout the project lifecycle.

* **Mentorship:** Provide mentorship and has the ability to coach and support team members.

  

**What You Bring**

* 3-7 years of experience working in a construction Health and Safety position.

* Diploma or Degree in Occupational Health and Safety or related field.

* Completed or working towards a National Construction Safety Officer (NCSO) certification is considered an asset.

* A valid G-class driver's license is a must.

* Experience working on rail construction projects is an asset.

* Strong knowledge of the Health and Safety Act, and legislation.

* Ability to effectively present information one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients and other employees of the organization

* Ability to respond to unanticipated events to ensure excellence in customer care.

* Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.

* Familiar with construction terminology.

* Strong team player who collaborates effectively with others

  

Expected compensation for this role is between **$90,000.00-115,000.00** annually. Base salaries are determined according to multiple factors including skills, experience and potential impact on the role. Internal and external competitiveness are also taken into consideration. In addition to base salary ONxpress also offers a comprehensive medical and dental program, RRSP with company matching and the potential to participate in our discretionary, performance based bonus program.

  

This role is a backfill position.

  

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent hiring practices, ONxpress may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and reviewing candidates. These tools are applied responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws and ONxpress’ AI Usage Policy. All final decisions are made by qualified ONxpress team members.

  

Connect with us! Learn more about our project here and follow us on LinkedIn for frequent updates.

  

This position is with ONxpress Civils (“CJV” aka the Design & Construction team); the project segment responsible for the modernization and modification of the key area network, including countless innovations in the way the regional rail infrastructure is built.

  

We value diversity and encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of whether they meet 100% of the qualifications listed. If you believe you have the skills and passion to excel in this role, we welcome your application and the opportunity to consider you for the position.

  

We are an Equal Employer. Should you need any accommodation through the recruitment process, please contact cjv-talentacquisition@onxpress.com.

Title: Chef de service - Données et Intelligence artificielle - Responsable technique - Intégration des systèmes et solutions
Description:
**Appartenir à Air Canada, c’est appartenir à un symbole canadien, Air Canada récemment élue meilleur transporteur aérien en Amérique du Nord. Faites décoller votre carrière en vous joignant à notre équipe novatrice et diversifiée à l’avant-garde du transport aérien de passagers.**
La personne qui occupe le poste de chef de service – Données et Intelligence artificielle dirige l’intégration technique, le déploiement et les capacités de préparation à la production requises pour opérationnaliser des produits, des modèles et des agents d’IA, ainsi que des pipelines de données de soutien dans l’ensemble des environnements d’entreprise d’Air Canada. Elle veille à ce que les solutions d’IA passent d’une architecture et d’une conception technique approuvées à des phases de développement, de tests et de production de manière sécurisée, contrôlée, reproductible et de plus en plus automatisée. Elle dirige les intégrateurs de systèmes d’IA et les spécialistes – Déploiement, établit des modèles d’intégration et de déploiement réutilisables, et travaille avec les équipes de l’ingénierie de l’IA, de l’ingénierie des données, l’ingénierie des plateformes, de l’Architecture, de la Cybersécurité, des opérations infonuagiques et des Opérations de données pour obtenir des résultats de production durables. La personne qui occupe ce poste doit trouver un équilibre entre la rapidité d’ingénierie et la gouvernance d’entreprise, la stabilité opérationnelle, la traçabilité et les contrôles fondés sur les risques.
  
  
**Le poste peut-être basé à Montréal ou Toronto.**
**Responsabilités**

* Diriger l’intégration des systèmes d’IA et gérer les spécialistes responsables de la transition des solutions d’IA de conceptions approuvées vers les environnements de l’entreprise.
* S’assurer que les produits, les modèles, les agents et les API d’IA et les pipelines de données de soutien sont correctement intégrés aux plateformes d’entreprise et aux systèmes en amont et en aval.
* Superviser le déploiement et la configuration des charges de travail liées à l’IA dans l’ensemble des environnements de développement, de mise à l’essai et de production.
* Piloter l’infrastructure en tant que code, les pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, les modèles relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), notamment la promotion des applications et des modèles et la gestion des versions, des replis et de l’environnement.
* Mettre en place des modèles d’intégration, des composants de déploiement, des gabarits et des processus d’automatisation réutilisables afin de réduire les tâches d’ingénierie propres à la solution et d’accélérer l’adoption.
* Collaborer avec les chefs des Produits – Intelligence artificielle, les scientifiques des données, les ingénieurs – Intelligence artificielle, les architectes de solutions, les architectes informatiques de l’entreprise, la Cybersécurité, les opérations infonuagiques, l’ingénierie des plateformes et les Opérations de données pour traduire les conceptions en versions prêtes pour la production.
* Définir et appliquer des critères de préparation à la production, notamment en ce qui concerne la surveillance, la journalisation, les alertes, les guides d’exploitation, la documentation de soutien, les responsabilités opérationnelles et les procédures de récupération.
* S’assurer que les intégrations et les déploiements répondent aux exigences en matière d’architecture, de cybersécurité, d’infrastructure, de gouvernance des données, de protection des renseignements personnels et d’exploitation.
* Mettre en œuvre des contrôles fondés sur les risques et comprenant les points d’approbation humaine appropriés pour les solutions concernant des données sensibles, des modèles d’IA, des agents autonomes ou des décisions d’affaires importantes.
* Diriger la validation technique, la préparation de la mise en service, la vérification après le déploiement et la transition ordonnée vers un soutien opérationnel stable.
* Définir et assurer le suivi des mesures de la réussite des déploiements, de la qualité des intégrations, de l’automatisation, de la fiabilité, des remaniements et de la préparation opérationnelle.
* Déterminer les problèmes récurrents en matière d’intégration et de déploiement et améliorer les pratiques d’ingénierie, les normes et les outils réutilisables en amont.
* Gérer la demande, les priorités, la capacité, les dépendances et les engagements en matière de prestation pour la fonction d’intégration des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle.
* Diriger, encadrer et perfectionner une équipe technique à haut rendement, établir des responsabilités claires et soutenir l’avancement professionnel.
* Assurer le leadership lors de mises en œuvre complexes ou à haut risque et agir à titre de personne-ressource pour les recours hiérarchiques en ce qui concerne les problèmes d’intégration et de déploiement.
* Gérer les relations avec les partenaires technologiques et les fournisseurs externes qui complètent les capacités de prestation internes.
* Maintenir ses connaissances à jour sur les pratiques d’ingénierie liées à l’IA, à l’infonuagique, à l’intégration, au déploiement et à la production, et évaluer leur applicabilité à Air Canada.

**Qualifications**

* Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologie de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de travail équivalente.
* Au moins sept ans d’expérience en technologies à différents échelons, dont au moins trois ans à un poste de direction d’équipes techniques au sein d’un environnement d’entreprise vaste et complexe.
* Expérience avérée de l’intégration des systèmes, de l’ingénierie infonuagique, de l’ingénierie des plateformes, du développement et de l’exploitation, de la distribution de logiciels ou des activités de production.
* Excellente compréhension des pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, du contrôle des sources à l’aide de Git, des stratégies d’embranchement, des tests automatisés, de l’infrastructure en tant que code, des pipelines de déploiement et du déploiement dans différents environnements.
* Connaissance pratique des écosystèmes de données et d’IA modernes, notamment Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure DevOps ou GitHub, des plateformes d’orchestration et des outils de déploiement de l’IA et de l’apprentissage automatique.
* Compréhension des concepts relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), au déploiement des modèles et des applications, à la gestion des versions, à l’observabilité et à la gestion du cycle de vie de la production.

* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)

Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.

Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.

Title: Senior Barista
Description:
**# Senior Barista – Atom Specialty Coffee, Dubai**

\*\***Company:**\*\* Atom Brew Cafeteria FZE

\*\***Department:**\*\* Café Operations

\*\***Reports to:**\*\* Café Manager

\*\***Location:**\*\* Dubai, UAE

\*\***Employment type:**\*\* Full-time, shift-based

**## About the Role**

The Senior Barista is the most experienced coffee professional on the bar and the Café Manager's right hand on shift. You will deliver consistently excellent coffee and service in line with Atom's recipes and standards, lead and coach the barista team during service, and support the smooth daily running of the café, including opening and closing, stock, equipment care and food safety compliance. When the Café Manager is away, you will act as shift lead.

**## Key Responsibilities**

**### Coffee Quality and Beverage Preparation**

- Prepare espresso-based, filter, cold and signature beverages to Atom's recipes, presentation and timing standards.

- Dial in espresso and brew recipes at the start of each shift and whenever conditions change; record grind, dose, yield and time.

- Carry out daily sensory checks (taste and calibration) and correct quality issues before drinks reach guests.

- Maintain consistent milk texturing and latte art standards across the team.

- Contribute ideas for seasonal and signature drinks and support menu tastings and launches.

**### Team Leadership and Training**

- Lead the bar during service: allocate stations, manage the drink queue and keep ticket times within standard.

- Train, coach and assess baristas and new joiners on recipes, workflow, equipment and service standards, including support during onboarding.

- Act as shift lead when the Café Manager is absent, escalating issues promptly and handing over clearly at shift change.

- Give the Café Manager regular feedback on team performance, training needs and rota requirements.

- Model Atom's Code of Conduct, punctuality, grooming and uniform standards.

**### Guest Experience**

- Greet and engage guests warmly, share product knowledge and recommend beverages confidently.

- Handle guest feedback and complaints professionally, resolving them on the spot where possible and informing the Café Manager.

- Know menu allergens and dietary information and never guess; check before advising guests.

**### Operations, Stock and Equipment**

- Complete opening and closing procedures and checklists, including bar set-up, cash-up support and handover notes.

- Monitor coffee, milk, syrups and consumables; carry out stock counts, receive deliveries, rotate stock (FIFO) and flag shortages and wastage.

- Clean and maintain espresso machines, grinders and brewers daily (backflushing, burr checks, descaling schedule) and report faults immediately.

- Operate the POS accurately and follow cash handling procedures; discounts, voids and complimentary items only with manager approval.

**### Food Safety, Hygiene and Health & Safety**

- Follow Dubai Municipality food safety requirements and the café's HACCP procedures at all times.

- Keep temperature logs for fridges and chillers, and ensure all items are correctly labelled, dated and stored.

- Maintain a clean-as-you-go bar and ensure the team follows hand-washing, hygiene and safe-working practices.

- Report any accident, near miss, pest sighting or food safety concern to the Café Manager at once.

**## Requirements**

**### Experience and Education**

- Minimum 3 years' barista experience in a specialty coffee or high-volume café, including at least 1 year in a senior, lead or trainer role.

- High school diploma or equivalent; a hospitality qualification is an advantage.

- UAE or GCC café experience preferred.

**### Technical Skills**

- Expert espresso extraction and dial-in skills, with a solid understanding of grind, dose, yield, ratio and brew time.

- Advanced milk texturing and consistent latte art (heart, tulip and rosetta as a minimum).

- Confident with manual brew methods (V60, Chemex, AeroPress, batch brew) and cold brew preparation.

- Good sensory skills: able to identify and correct under- and over-extraction and describe flavour clearly.

- Working knowledge of coffee origins, processing methods and roast profiles.

- Basic equipment maintenance and troubleshooting for espresso machines and grinders.

- Comfortable using POS systems, digital checklists and HR or rota systems.

**### Leadership and Personal Attributes**

- Proven ability to train, motivate and lead a small team during busy service.

- Calm, organised and decisive under pressure, with strong attention to detail.

- Warm, guest-focused personality with excellent communication skills.

- Fluent spoken and written English; Arabic or other languages are an advantage.

- Reliable, punctual and committed to high standards of grooming and hygiene.

- Flexible to work early mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays according to the rota.

**## Working Conditions**

- Shift-based, hands-on role on the café floor.

- Extended periods of standing, lifting stock of up to 15 kg, and working with hot liquids and equipment.

- Official Atom uniform to be worn and kept clean throughout working hours.

**## Package**

Competitive, commensurate with experience.

**## How to Apply**

Email your CV to \*\*operations@atomshot.ae\*\* with the subject line \*\***"Atom – Senior Barista"**\*\*.

Title: Advisor, HR Shared Services Centre
Description:
**The Baycrest Corporate Centre for Geriatric Care**

  

has an exciting opportunity for a

  

**Advisor, HR Shared Services Centre**

**Human Resources**

  

**Posting Number:** 10361

**Position Type:** Temporary Full Time (12 months)

**Bi-Weekly Hours:** 70 Hours

**Union:** Non-Union

**Date Posted:** November 10, 2026

**Internal Posting Closing Date:** November 19, 2026

  

**About Us**

  

The Baycrest Corporate Centre for Geriatric Care (BCCGC) serves as the corporate head office for the Baycrest Seniors Care family of companies, supporting our hospital, long-term care home, research centre, education programs and residential living communities. As the administrative and organizational hub of a system fully dedicated to aging and brain health, BCCGC brings people, our shared values and system-wide services together to strengthen care and experiences for older adults.

  

Grounded in the values of being inclusive, collaborative, ambitious, respectful and excellent, BCCGC fosters an environment where teams thrive and collaboration drives success. From enterprise planning to day-to-day operational support, BCCGC helps ensure the Baycrest vision — a world where every older person lives with purpose, fulfilment and dignity — comes to life.

  

**Job Summary**

  

Reporting to the Manager, Talent Acquisition and HR Shared Services Centre, the Advisor, HR Shared Services Centre plays a key role within the Human Resources team. This position is responsible for delivering a range of HR programs and services, including benefits administration, leave of absence management, onboarding, transfers, and terminations. The Advisor also supports employees and leaders with day-to-day HR inquiries and manages internal recruitment processes for unionized roles.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* HR Shared Services Operations

o Makes accurate and timely employee changes on the HRIS, such as status updates and personal information changes. Manages maternity/parental leave of absence requests, terminations, employee transfers and contract extensions.

o Drafts and prepares HR-related letters and communications, including offer letters, termination letters, employment letters and transfer letters.

o Enters new hires into HRIS and finalizes employee file.

o Facilitates new hire orientation ensuring a smooth transition for new hires.

o Administers employee benefits programs, including enrollments, changes, and terminations.

o Administers the defined benefit pension plan (HOOPP), including enrollments, retirements, maternity/parental leaves, inter-company transfers, and status changes.

o Serves as a centre of excellence for HR-related inquiries, providing guidance on questions from employees and managers related to benefits, HR policies, and other HR services; collaborates with internal HR teams to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent responses.

o Training/knowledge sharing with hiring managers and employees on various HR related inquiries/processes.

o Communicates effectively with both employees and managers to provide clear and accurate information, ensuring a positive experience in all interactions.

o Back-up for HR Assistant providing front desk coverage relief.

* Reporting and Documentation

o Ensures that all employee files are updated and accurate, including personal information, employment history, and compliance documents. Regularly audit records to ensure completeness and adherence to company policies and legal requirements.

o Prepares and maintains detailed records and reports related to HR Programs, benefits administration, and recruitment activities.

o Assists in generating reports for HR metrics and performance evaluation.

o Ensures accurate documentation of all HR processes and communications.

o Processes corrections/changes required in Empath after ad hoc audits.

* Process Improvement and Compliance

o Identifies opportunities to enhance HR Programs and Procedures.

o Participates in ad hoc project work related to HR Shared Services initiatives identified.

o Implements improvements to streamline HR operations and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.

o Ensures all HR activities adhere to legal and organizational standards.

  

**Who You Are**

  

* Committed to delivering an exceptional employee experience with accuracy, consistency, and care.

* Communicate clearly and empathetically, translating complex HR processes into accessible guidance.

* Service-oriented and inclusive, respecting the diverse needs of Baycrest’s workforce.

* Collaborative and relationship-focused, building trust across HR, leaders, union partners, and stakeholders.

* Organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Proactive, take ownership, and seek opportunities to improve processes and HR service delivery.

* Open to learning, embracing change, and supporting Baycrest’s commitment to excellence and innovation.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent.

* Certified Human Resources Leader (CHRL) is an asset.

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in HR administration, benefits management, or a related field.

* Experience with recruitment processes is an asset.

* Experience in a unionized setting is required.

* Experience working in healthcare and research organizations is an asset.

* Strong understanding of HR Programs and Procedures, including benefits administration and recruitment processes.

* Understands collective agreements and internal policies impacting recruitment, benefits, and employee lifecycle management.

* Proficiency in drafting official HR communications and documents.

* Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Strong working knowledge of HR Information Systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, Empath), including accurate data entry, audits, and reporting.

* Comfortable navigating multiple systems and adapting to new technologies quickly.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and other relevant office tools.

  

**Compensation**

  

At Baycrest, we take pride in ensuring our compensation structure is internally equitable and compliant with pay equity legislation. We believe compensation should be transparent, equitable, and reflective of your experience and growth. Our salary ranges are structured to support progression, from learning the role to demonstrating full proficiency.

  

The salary range for this position is $59,116 to $73,895 per year.

  

Your placement within the target hiring range will depend on your job-related knowledge, skills, abilities, and relevant education and experience, as well as considerations such as market conditions and internal equity. The starting salary will be determined using these factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization.

Title: Workplace Ambassador I
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The role of the **Workplace Ambassador** will collaborate with various partners to ensure a high-quality seamless workplace experience is provided consistently for all employees. These partners include facilities and workplace experience teams, client employees, BGIS facilities and project teams, food service operators and fitness center operators. In this role, there is a unique opportunity to influence how employees work, and directly impact their workday. You will work with a team of professionals delivering workplace services including hospitality, reception, event space coordination, space occupancy and mail/package deliveries. In this role, you will be empowered to make decisions that are aligned with the organization’s workplace standards to ensure that the space continues to meet the needs of all employees. This role will support the key differentiator of the organization – it’s people, by enabling a culture of high-performance teams.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support**

* Face and go to person for the workplace strategy program in the office environment.
* Greet visitors, new hires and existing employees to explain the office space and how to work effectively in the space, how to utilize meeting rooms & access reservation system.
* Conduct periodic workstation reviews. Work with building property management and corporate Facilities Management, manage mail receipt and distribution, parking validations and guest access.
* Manage office supplies, relationship with offsite storage (Iron Mountain) security access cards (including reports and audits by security). Enforce clean desk policy. Rounds to ensure supplies in place – morning and evening.

**Technology Assistance**

* Program subject matter expert, provide problem solving solutions for administrative problems. Manage drop off for technologies requiring service. Escalation point of contact for office and technology issues.
* Provide basic how - to tech support and escalation process for all WTP toolkit technologies (wireless network, soft tokens, print release, AVAYA phone system, AV equipment, video conferencing, Smart Boards, etc.). Administer triage for meeting room technology – i.e. reset, reboot meeting room panels and lobby touch screens and/or manage escalations.
* Learn HR technology tools and provide HR and communications support (i.e. Yammer). Assist with minor event planning and meeting space set up. Provide local amenities maps.
* Manage the office sundry equipment for term use (mouse, power cords, power bars, spare laptops and desktops, monitor cables, network cables, head - sets, docking stations, keyboards, privacy filters, etc.). Manage locker / file cabinet inventory assignment and associated key control, name plates, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

* University degree with 1-3 years’ of job-related experience.
* Service oriented, able to be customer-facing and can-do attitude.
* Able to exercise sound judgement, make decisions, provide direction.
* Comfortable dealing with issues and people. Strong communication skills.
* Strong computer skills, including MS suite of software.
* Self-starter, able to work independently as well as in a team.
* Pro-active, approachable, and solution-based.
* Ability to multi-task.
* Accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure.
Strong organization skills.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* None required

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $44,303 - $52,121 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role. |
