At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

  

BWXT is currently seeking an Access Control Officer for its Ordnance Tennessee location in Jonesbourough, TN

As an access control officer, one is responsible for monitoring and controlling access to various areas of the facility, ensuring only authorized personnel are allowed entry. This involves tasks such as checking IDs, conducting security screenings, and verifying work badges. In addition, ACO may be required to train new employees on alarm systems and visitor access procedures, as well as maintain and control access to different cleared locations in government contractor facilities. ACO will play a crucial role in assisting EH&S with emergency evacuation situations.

Job Description / Duties:

* Responsible for facility access, physical security, including supervisor of contract guard service.
* Assist security manager with investigating security violations and incidents.
* Verify visitors have proper Identification required for access to certain areas of the facility.
* Experience using various types of visitor management systems.
* Train contracted guard force to BWXT security procedures
* Greet employees and visitors to the facility.
* Approve visitor request and conduct back ground screening
* Create ID badges for employees and contractors and assign appropriate accesses based on need-to-know principles
* Perform routine interior and exterior camera scans utilizing CCTV to identify unusual occurrences.
* Maintain alertness and notify proper authority of indications of trespassing fire and emergency.
* Oversee writing of daily activity reports (DAR) and incident reports (IR).
* Support Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Program.
* Oversee key inventory process

* A high school diploma or equivalent is required.
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience working in physical security and/or personnel security required.
* Proof of US Citizenship required
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance, whichever is required.

* Advanced degree preferred
* Security professional certification a plus
* Active DOD or DOE security clearance.

Title: Concierge
Description:
**Come join our growing team!**

If you are looking for a rewarding role with opportunities for growth at a company that values integrity, innovation, and teamwork, look no further! Barkan Management Company is a leading property management firm serving over 200 residential communities across 8 states, with regional offices in Boston and Washington D.C.

  

Founded in 1964, we have over 50 years of experience in real estate, specializing in community association and multi-family management, encompassing market rate and affordable housing. Our team of over 800 talented professionals shares a commitment to delivering unparalleled service, maintaining the highest quality standards, and exceeding client expectations. Join us as we continue to redefine the standards of excellence in property management!

  

**Who we need:**

We are looking for a motivated, experienced, hands-on Overnight Concierge who will maintain a secure environment for the residents; ensuring that all residents and visitors are properly greeted and screened, supervise and direct the page, and provide residents with personal services in an efficient, responsive, and professional manner.

**What you’ll do:**

* Maintain complete knowledge of rules, regulations, and policies
* Welcome/greet all residents and guests to the property in a professional manner reflecting a willing attitude to accommodate.
* Announce all guests to units.
* Become knowledgeable with building service providers, i.e., limousines, taxis, cleaners, pet services, food delivery, and the like.
* Ensure that the front lobby is always well maintained; weather mats installed during inclement weather and removed immediately following; chipped paint addressed immediately, proper lighting, panel, and desk polished, and the like.
* Receive calls from residents for personal services and coordinate the same with the Page. Ensure that all requests are met in a timely manner.
* Supervise the activities of Page staff assigned to a daily shift, check for proper uniform and attendance. Make sure that all services are provided in a friendly courteous, professional manner.
* Ensure that the front desk is always covered.
* Accept deliveries in accordance with approved policy, mail, and dry cleaning, and maintain logs associated with each task.
* Receive calls from residents for maintenance or service and forward them to the appropriate person during routine business hours. For after-hour service requests, assess if the issue can wait until the next business day and login work order on Building Link. If appropriate notify maintenance on call to assist.
* Maintain strict adherence to key control policy, requiring that all visitors needing a key to be authorized to enter the unit. Log in all key requests.
* Ensure that all contractors entering the front lobby are properly badged observing the policy that tools are not allowed through the front door.
* Enforce the building rules and regulations as provided by the Board of Managers. Ensure that all contractors have security badges before entering the building.
* Carefully monitor all security and life safety systems and report problems to building security as well as the General Manager.
* Welcome new residents and assist with coordinating the delivery of newspapers, cable TV, peapod delivery laundry services, etc.
* Provide information about local activities and events throughout the city.
* Introduce new services and opportunities that may be of interest to owners and residents.
* Document all resident requests, complaints, or problems immediately and notify designated department/personnel for resolving the issue.
* Complete incident reports as needed.
* Perform duties as requested by Head Concierge and or Property Manager.
* Maintain a current listing of vendors including babysitting, housekeeping, pet care, florist, dry cleaning, restaurants, ticket agencies, theater, and the like.
* Ensure personal appearance is always immaculate; uniform clean crisp and shoes are polished.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Possess a wealth of knowledge about the area in which the property is located (i.e. Restaurants, transportation, events, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience in service and hospitality.
* Excellent communication skills
* Take pride in their appearance, their service role, and their commitment to services excellence.
* Have outstanding communication Skills – from professional writing to eloquence of speech and body language.
* Be able to demonstrate a proven history of reliability to a set work schedule.

Title: Senior FP&A Analyst
Description:
### **About Behavox**

Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.

At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.

Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.

Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.

### **About the Role**

The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.

The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.

This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **Financial Model & Accounting Foundations** — Understands the architecture of integrated three-statement and operating models and the accounting that underpins them, including SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment. Understands how the company's budgets are built and how to integrate them accurately into the core financial model.

* **Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics** — Understands bottom-up short-term forecasting, driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that reveal business performance. Connects movements in those metrics to their underlying drivers and the operating levers that can change them.

* **Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration** — Understands acquisition valuation, purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and consolidation mechanics sufficiently to evaluate targets and integrate completed acquisitions into the financial model.

* **Business & Commercial Acumen** — Understands in depth how the business and its functions generate revenue and incur costs, including the underlying revenue drivers, cost structure, and operating levers. Applies this knowledge to identify inconsistencies and challenge financial results and assumptions.

* **Financial Systems & AI Tooling** — Understands Google Sheets, Excel, AI, and automation capabilities sufficiently to determine how they should be applied to financial modeling and analysis. Distinguishes where automation can improve speed and control from where financial judgment and manual validation must remain.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model using robust architecture, accounting logic, scenario and sensitivity layers, and integrated budgets, owning the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption to provide reliable forecasts and analysis for company planning and decision-making.

* **Acquisition Modeling & Integration** — Builds valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models by independently evaluating targets, supporting due diligence, and consolidating closed deals to provide a complete financial view of acquisition implications and the combined business.

* **Business-Review Reporting** — Drives the financial substance of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews with the broader FP&A team by translating model outputs and performance drivers into a clear narrative that enables senior management, the board, and investors to understand results and their implications.

* **Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering** — Diagnoses financial and SaaS metric movements by identifying operating drivers, pressure-testing assumptions, and modeling relevant levers and downside cases to give decision-makers evidence-based recommendations they can act on.

* **AI-Enabled Productivity** — Applies AI and spreadsheet automation to recurring financial workflows by automating appropriate work and strengthening data validation while retaining judgment over what remains manual to reduce cycle time without compromising financial integrity.

### **What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.
* A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.
* A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long-term value creation.
* Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid role (1 day in office).
* A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance.

### **About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

### **Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

Title: Systems Administrator
Description:
**Systems Administrator**
=========================

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Title** - Systems Administrator

**Department** - Client Support Services

**Type** - Full-time, permanent, salaried

**Reports to** - CTO

**Location** - Downtown Toronto office, with occasional client site work

As a Systems Administrator at Business Cloud, you are responsible for the security, availability, and recoverability of the systems our clients depend on across a portfolio of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace environments. You remediate security findings, keep servers and network infrastructure patched and supported, verify that backups can be restored, and maintain consistent configuration across cloud tenants, identity, and endpoint management platforms.

Much of this work is proactive and does not start with a ticket. You find configuration drift, unresolved findings, and maintenance gaps through routine review, and you close them through direct work, automation, or coordination with other teams. Support handles frontline user issues; you own system-level problems and outages.

Your work falls into three areas:

* **Reactive**: Responding to security alerts and system-level escalations
* **Maintenance**: Carrying out recurring maintenance such as patching, backup verification, and monitoring review
* **Improvement**: Delivering small non-billable changes, cleanup, and automation that make environments easier to manage

Most work is performed remotely from our downtown Toronto office, with occasional on-site work for servers and network equipment. The role is client-facing. Some maintenance windows fall outside standard business hours.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Security and Incident Response**: Triage and remediate security findings and alerts from managed detection and response, Microsoft Defender, and endpoint security tools. Lead technical containment, eradication, and recovery during security incidents, preserving evidence and documenting findings and follow-up actions.
* **Backup and Business Continuity**: Administer backup and continuity platforms, verify coverage and job health, and resolve problems. Perform and document testing, confirm restore readiness before major changes, and escalate continuity risks that cannot be resolved technically.
* **Server Administration and Lifecycle**: Administer physical and virtual servers, including domain controllers, Hyper-V and VMware, directory synchronization, and remote and break-glass access. Coordinate patching and maintenance, validate service health, and plan upgrades.
* **Network, DNS, and Certificates**: Administer firewalls, switches, wireless, and VPN infrastructure across different environments, including firmware and alert response. Manage DNS zones, mail authentication records, and certificate renewals.
* **Cloud Platforms and Identity**: Administer client cloud environments, primarily Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, along with Azure and related services, keeping tenant configuration, identity, and access policies consistent and secure. Manage privileged and emergency access through a documented, controlled process.
* **Endpoint Management Platforms**: Administer endpoint management platforms such as Intune and our RMM to keep managed devices patched, compliant, and protected.
* **Health and Documentation**: Monitor for configuration drift and correct it. Conduct proactive environment reviews and cleanup efforts. Own small non-billable changes. Maintain current documentation of systems, configurations, and their relevant procedures.
* **Reporting and Automation**: Maintain and leverage reporting to automate repetitive checks and administrative tasks.
* Other duties as required.

**How do we define success for your role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Security findings and alerts are triaged promptly and tracked to resolution, with an owner and status for anything left open.
* Patching runs on a predictable schedule, and servers or devices that are behind or nearing end of support are known and documented, not discovered during an incident.
* Backups are monitored, failures are resolved quickly, and restore tests are performed and recorded on a regular schedule.
* Monitoring alerts have an owner and are acted on, and certificates and domains are renewed before they expire.
* Client environments move steadily toward our standards, with drift found through routine review and exceptions documented.
* Documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up your work.
* Recurring manual checks are progressively replaced with reporting and automation.
* You contribute to an inclusive, engaging work environment and continue developing your expertise.

**Your Experience and Education**
---------------------------------

* 3+ years of systems administration experience, preferably supporting multiple clients or sites.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Hyper-V or VMware.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, or equivalent depth in Google Workspace.
* Experience with endpoint management through Intune or a remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform.
* Working knowledge of networking, including firewalls, VLANs, VPN, and wireless.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, patching, and responding to security alerts.
* Experience administering backup systems and troubleshooting backup failures.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or a similar scripting language.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to clients.
* Availability for occasional after-hours maintenance.
* Post-secondary education in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience at an MSP.
* Experience administering both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
* Experience with managed detection and response tools or incident response.
* Experience with cloud-managed network platforms such as Meraki or UniFi.
* Experience managing macOS and mobile devices.
* Experience performing restore tests or disaster recovery exercises.
* Experience building reporting or automation to replace manual checks.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk and Hudu, and with client-managed products such as password managers, VoIP, and phishing awareness tools.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 or Azure Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, or networking certifications.
* A valid driver's licence and access to a vehicle.

**Why Business Cloud?**
-----------------------

Business Cloud is a rapidly growing managed technology service provider focused on delivering cloud-first business technology solutions to small and medium-sized organizations across Canada. As a proud partner of Google Cloud and Microsoft, we take full ownership of our clients' technology environments to ensure reliability, security, and efficiency.

Our core values reflect our commitment to growth and service:

* Growth and Development
* Ownership and Leadership
* Respect, Empathy, and Customer First
* Prevention and Proactivity

Our team's backgrounds and experiences vary, but effective communication, continual learning, and a passion for customer service are the common components of our success. If you believe you are the ideal candidate for this position, please apply and tell us why Business Cloud is the right fit for you.

**How can I stand out in my application?**
------------------------------------------

Please consider attaching a tailored cover letter. We view this as an opportunity to tell us why you are the right fit for the position and our organization.

Are you a hands-on technologist who wants to own it all, from fixing a laptop at someone's desk to hunting threats across a modern cloud security stack?

Join **UNICEF Canada** - one of Canada's most respected and historic charities - is looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to play a key role in managing, securing and evolving our technology environment. This is a dynamic, hands-on position where you'll take ownership of the full spectrum of IT operations, including day-to-day help desk and desk-side support, Microsoft 365, cloud services, servers, networks and cybersecurity. You'll be directly involved in supporting staff with their everyday technology needs while also tackling complex technical challenges, strengthening our cybersecurity posture and driving improvements across our IT environment. Your work will help keep our staff, volunteers and partners connected, secure and productive in support of children around the world.

**Position Details**

**Position Title**

Senior Systems Administrator

**Employment Type:**

Permanent, Full-time

**Reports to:**

Deputy Director, IT

**Direct Reports:**

0

**Salary Range:**

$70,500 to $85,500 per year with benefits and 3 weeks paid vacation

**Work Location:**

Toronto

**Work Environment:**

UNICEF Canada currently operates under a Fixed- Hybrid model that requires team members to attend t he office at least 2 days/week (Tuesday & Wednesday).

***Why UNICEF & UNICEF Canada?***

**UNICEF** **is the world’s farthest-reaching humanitarian organization for children**. Across 190 countries and territories, and in the world’s toughest places, we provide and advocate for education, health and nutrition services. We protect children from violence and abuse. Bring clean water and sanitation to those in need. Keep them safe from climate change and disease. Serve as the world’s largest provider of vaccines. Before, during and after emergencies, we’re on the ground with life-saving help and hope. The needs of children around the world continue to increase and the role of UNICEF is more important than ever.

**UNICEF Canada** **is one of 32 National Committees located in high-income countries around the world**. Our team exists to fundraise for UNICEF’s highest priorities, and to work neutrally with governments and the private sector in Canada and internationally to advance the rights and well-being of children and youth.

**As UNICEF Canada launches a** **bold new Strategic Plan in 2026**, **be part of this next phase of impact!**

  

**The Opportunity**

This is a hands-on, end-to-end IT role. UNICEF Canada does not have a separate help desk or Tier 1 function, so the Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for all levels of technical support. The role also leads day-to-day security operations, including hardening our Microsoft 365 environment, managing endpoint protection, and responding to alerts from our managed detection and response provider.

On any given day you might:

  

* Get a new staff member's laptop, accounts and MFA set up and walk them through it in person
* Troubleshoot a Teams, printer or VPN issue at someone's desk or over a remote session
* Triage a security alert from our MDR provider and contain a compromised account
* Tighten a Conditional Access policy or roll out an Intune configuration
* Patch servers, check backups and plan a firewall change

Cybersecurity is the center of gravity of the role. UNICEF Canada handles donor and payment data, and we're a target for phishing, business email compromise and fraud. You'll run the day-to-day security operations that protect that trust, working closely with the Deputy Director, IT, and our security partners.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Cybersecurity operations and compliance (35%)**

* Run day-to-day security operations across our stack: Sophos endpoint protection (EDR), Field Effect Covalence managed detection and response (MDR), Barracuda email security, Microsoft Defender and Password management.
* Act as the first internal responder to alerts from Field Effect, Sophos and Defender: triage, investigate, contain and remediate, escalating to the Deputy Director, IT as needed.
* Own identity security in Microsoft Entra ID: MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access, sign-in risk policies and regular access reviews.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft security and compliance tools, including Defender for Office 365, Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, retention and audit.
* Track and improve our Microsoft Secure Score and endpoint compliance, and drive vulnerability and patch management to agreed timelines.
* Maintain incident response, ransomware and business continuity playbooks, and take part in tabletop exercises and full restore tests.
* Run our security awareness program, including KeepNet phishing simulations, targeted training and follow-up with staff.
* Support audits, external assessments and alignment with NIST CSF 2.0, privacy law (PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25), and payment security requirements (PCI DSS).
* Review new vendors, apps and AI tools for security and privacy risk before they're adopted.

### **End-user and desk-side support (25%)**

* Provide all tiers of technical support (Tier 1 through 3) to staff and volunteers, in person, by phone, Teams and remote session.
* Own the IT ticket queue end to end: logging, prioritizing, resolving and closing requests, and spotting recurring issues to fix at the root.
* Manage the device lifecycle for laptops, mobile devices, printers and peripherals: procurement, imaging or Autopilot enrolment, deployment, repair and secure disposal.
* Run onboarding and offboarding: accounts, licenses, devices, access and secure removal of access on departure.
* Support executives and leadership with responsive, discreet, and white-glove service.
* Set up and support meeting rooms, AV and Teams Rooms for in-office and hybrid meetings.
* Write clear how-to guides and train staff on Microsoft 365 and other core tools.

### **Microsoft 365 and cloud administration (20%)**

* Administer Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Power Platform.
* Manage devices and apps through Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including hybrid identity with on-premises Active Directory where it remains.
* Manage Azure resources and cloud services, keeping cost, security and performance in check.
* Support the integration and security of business platforms, including Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Raiser's Edge NXT and our fundraising and payment platforms.
* Use scripting and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Power Automate) to cut manual work and improve consistency.
* Stay current on Microsoft 365 updates and roll out new features thoughtfully.

### **Infrastructure, network and backup (20%)**

* Manage our network: firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi and VPN at head office and regional sites.
* Maintain remaining on-premises and virtual servers (Windows Server, Hyper-V), including patching, monitoring and capacity planning.
* Manage backup and recovery for Microsoft 365, cloud and on-premises systems, and test restores regularly.
* Manage telephony and collaboration infrastructure, including Teams Phone and VoIP.
* Document systems, configurations, network diagrams and procedures, and keep them current.
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects and perform off-hours maintenance when needed to minimize disruption.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** A two-year post-secondary diploma or degree in IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* **Experience:** 5+ years in IT, with at least 3 years as a systems administrator in a generalist role that included hands-on end-user support.
* **Cybersecurity:** Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR and responding to security incidents, plus a working knowledge of phishing, BEC, ransomware and account-compromise response.
* **Microsoft 365 and Entra ID:** 3+ years administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Defender, Conditional Access, MFA and Intune.
* **End-user support:** A strong service mindset and proven experience supporting staff at every level, including executives, in person and remotely.
* **Networking:** Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, Wi-Fi and firewall configuration.
* **Servers and backup:** Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, Hyper-V, and backup and recovery tools.
* **Scripting:** Comfort with PowerShell, or the drive to build it quickly.
* **Communication:** The ability to explain technical and security risks in plain language to non-technical staff and leaders.
* **Ownership:** You work well independently, manage competing priorities, and follow through from ticket to project.
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to travel occasionally within Canada and do off-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

**An Employer of Choice: What We Offer**

Title: Telecom OSS Architect / Designer
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a
**Telecom OSS Architect / Designer**
, you will be a senior technical authority within our Connectivity & Network Engineering practice, leading the architecture and design of complex OSS solutions for major telecoms clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, working closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendor partners to define and implement best-in-class OSS ecosystems.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Leading end-to-end OSS architecture and design across Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management domains — defining solution blueprints, integration frameworks, and technical roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and industry best practices such as TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID).
* Driving the design and implementation of Network Inventory solutions, including physical, logical, and service inventory modelling, ensuring accurate and real-time representation of network assets across multi-vendor, multi-technology environments (2G/3G/4G/5G, Fixed, IP/MPLS).
* Architecting Performance and Fault Management solutions, overseeing the design of KPI frameworks, threshold management, alarm correlation, and root cause analysis capabilities — enabling proactive network operations and minimising service impact for telecoms operators.
* Engaging directly with senior client stakeholders to gather and translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed technical specifications, solution architectures, and HLD/LLD documentation, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Leading and governing OSS integration design, defining interfaces and APIs between OSS platforms and adjacent systems including BSS, NMS, EMS, and emerging cloud-native network management platforms — ensuring seamless data flows and operational continuity across the network operations ecosystem.
* Providing technical leadership and mentoring to a team of OSS engineers and designers, conducting design reviews, driving quality assurance of technical deliverables, and ensuring architectural consistency and compliance with agreed standards across project workstreams.
* Supporting pre-sales and solutioning activities, contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and solution demonstrations — bringing deep domain expertise to help shape and win new opportunities across the KSA and wider Middle East telecoms market.

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Telecom OSS Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capability and a collaborative approach.
  
  
Technical Skills & Experience:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on OSS architecture, design, and delivery — including proven expertise in at least two of the following domains: Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management systems, ideally in large-scale, multi-vendor operator environments.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of OSS platforms and tools, such as IBM Tivoli Netcool, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson ENM/ENIQ, Huawei iMAC/U2000, Comarch OSS, or similar — combined with strong understanding of OSS/BSS integration patterns, mediation layers, and data modelling techniques for telecoms network domains.
* Strong grounding in TM Forum standards and frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID/ODA) and familiarity with relevant industry standards including 3GPP, ETSI, IETF, and TMN — with the ability to apply these frameworks pragmatically in real-world solution design and architecture.
* Solid experience with integration technologies and APIs including REST/SOAP web services, TMF Open APIs, OSS/J, XML/JSON data formats, and middleware platforms — with the ability to architect robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between OSS components and broader network management ecosystems.
* Proficiency in producing high-quality architecture and design artefacts, including Solution Architecture Documents, HLDs, LLDs, interface control documents, data flow diagrams, and operational runbooks — with experience presenting these at both technical and executive levels.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**
**Dedicated Innovation Labs**
– We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics such as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum. As a Telecom OSS Architect at Capgemini Engineering, you will be at the heart of this innovation — shaping the next generation of network operations for some of the world's leading operators.
  
  
**Career Acceleration Programs**
– From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise. With 12+ years of experience, you'll have access to programmes designed specifically to take senior engineers to the next level.
  
  
**Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services**
– Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleash their R&D potential to develop the smart products and services of tomorrow — and you will play a central role in that mission in the KSA market.
  
  
**Engineering Horizons**
– A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes centre stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet — building your professional network and visibility on a truly global stage.
  
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Firewall and Security Administration

Network Administration

Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Solution Stack

IT Service Management and Operational Control

Projects and Continuous Improvement

* Experience managing incidents, changes, and requests in an IT service management environment, with strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer service skills.

  + Experience with Aruba Central, ClearPass, Global Secure Access, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Defender, or Sentinel, and with supporting multiple offices and managed service partners.
  + Microsoft certification (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert), networking or security certification (Palo Alto, HPE Aruba, Juniper, Cisco CNA, CompTIA Network+), or ITIL Foundation.

Title: Principal, Security, Cyber & Resilience Consulting
Description:
This is a senior, high-profile opportunity for an accomplished consulting leader to build and grow an integrated security, cyber and resilience consulting practice in the Middle East. The role combines the commercial ownership, client impact and intellectual challenge of a leading professional services environment with the opportunity to shape strategy, develop new propositions, mobilise multidisciplinary teams and lead complex assignments from boardroom advice through implementation.

Working in close partnership with relevant Consulting leaders, local leadership and specialists across Control Risks, the successful candidate will originate, win and lead engagements across physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience. A key part of the role will be connecting these disciplines, recognising where physical, digital and operational risks converge and bringing together the right expertise to address clients' most significant risk and resilience challenges.

The role does not require equal technical depth across every discipline. The successful candidate is expected to bring recognised expertise in at least one core area, together with sufficient breadth across the wider portfolio to engage credibly with senior clients, identify and shape opportunities, lead integrated engagements and know when specialist expertise is required.

**Requirements**
**What You'll Do:**

Practice Management & Project

* Recommend a clear direction for the Middle East security, cyber and resilience consulting practice, identifying priority markets, propositions and client needs and creating the conditions for consultants and specialists across disciplines to contribute their best work.
* Advise senior clients on complex physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience challenges, translating technical and operational risks into practical recommendations for executive decisionmakers.
* Shape and implement our business strategy with the key EMEA Consulting Partners, translating shared priorities into a focused market, capability and delivery plan. Ensure that cyber and digital risk form a meaningful part of the practice's growth agenda alongside established security, crisis and resilience capabilities.
* Lead complex, multidisciplinary risk and resilience engagements, bringing together the right combination of physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity, intelligence and industry expertise. Act as the senior client adviser and engagement leader, providing direction and challenge while enabling specialist workstream leaders to own technical delivery and contribute to key decisions.
* Accountability to Advisory & Risk Consulting leadership as required for leading the delivery of the full range of engagements across ME from bid to close out, ensuring profitability and quality standards are met.
* Demonstrate strong consulting and technical judgement in the management and delivery of complex client engagements, providing effective challenge to specialist teams and ensuring that technical findings are translated into clear business implications and actionable recommendations.
* Act as senior sponsor or engagement leader for significant cyber and digital risk assignments, working with specialist teams to shape the approach, challenge findings and ensure recommendations address the client's wider operational, resilience and business priorities.

Business Development and Account Management

* Grow priority accounts with account managers, local leadership and subject-matter experts, developing trusted relationships with senior business, security, risk and technology decisionmakers and converting client challenges into integrated consulting opportunities.
* Own a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with accountability for profitable conversion across the security, cyber and resilience portfolio.
* Develop the regional market for cyber and digital risk consulting, particularly where technology risk intersects with operational resilience, crisis preparedness, third-party risk, physical security and executive decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to extend established physical security, crisis and resilience relationships into cyber and digital risk work, and equally use cyber-led relationships to introduce clients to broader security and resilience capabilities.
* Building and expanding on an existing strong personal network of relationships with potential work providers and the key influencers within target corporates.
* Continuously seeking to build Control Risks' presence in the marketplace.
* Increasing visibility and credibility for the practice through driving repeat engagements with existing clients, new engagements with prospective clients or referrals from other Control Risks service lines.
* Displaying an ability to take experience from engagements and consider whether the approach or issues are replicable with other clients. Building a plan to target those clients.

Brand and Reputation

* Be a visible external representative of Control Risks' physical security, cyber and resilience consulting capabilities across the Middle East, strengthening the firm's credibility with clients, partners and market influencers
* Position Control Risks as a trusted adviser to organisations managing increasingly interconnected physical, digital and operational risks, from strategic risk assessment and preparedness through transformation, crisis response and recovery.
* Build trusted relationships with decisionmakers and senior colleagues across the regional and global business, inviting challenge, sharing insight and creating opportunities to pursue and deliver work together.

Practice Development

* Ensure regional service delivery standards are implemented and maintained.
* Attract, develop and retain a high-performing consulting team, combining clear expectations with coaching, constructive challenge and visible support for colleagues' growth.
* As part of the EMEA leadership team, contribute to the development of the regional and global strategy and plans.
* Coach, mentor and provide real-time feedback to team members, strengthening technical capability, consulting skills and commercial judgement.
* Work with regional and global specialists to strengthen the Middle East proposition, ensuring that the practice can access appropriate technical capability, methodologies and specialist delivery capacity as client demand develops.

**Who You Are:**

* At least 10 years' experience in a Big Four, leading management consultancy, specialist risk consultancy or other top-tier professional-services environment, with a strong track record in cyber and digital risk, physical security, crisis and resilience, or closely related risk transformation work.
* Recognised depth and credibility in at least one of these disciplines, together with demonstrable experience working across adjacent areas and leading multidisciplinary client engagements.
* Deep understanding of the ME operating environment.
* Demonstrated success in leading consultative sales conversations, shaping ambiguous client needs into compelling scopes and mobilising colleagues to convert opportunities into profitable work.
* An established market network and external profile that support credible senior-level engagement and business development, with the ability to develop relationships beyond their primary area of technical expertise.
* Strong understanding of how physical security, resilience, crisis preparedness, business continuity, third-party risk intersects with cyber and digital risk and with and executive decision-making.
* The role does not require technical practitioner-level expertise across every physical security, crisis, cyber and resilience discipline. Candidates should bring depth in at least one of these areas, combined with sufficient breadth and consulting judgement to shape integrated client solutions, provide senior oversight, challenge technical outputs and mobilise specialist expertise effectively.
* Knowledge of leading practice in resilience, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity and decision-making under pressure. Knowledge of data-driven approaches and the impact of AI on resilience.
* Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, combining rigorous analysis with practical, commercially relevant recommendations and drawing on specialist input where it improves the outcome.
* Experience operating in regulated or critical infrastructure environments or advising clients on complex technology and operational resilience challenges.
* Ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively.
* Business-level proficiency in English.

PREFERRED:

* Master's degree.
* Fluent Arabic speaking and writing.

Title: Senior Information Security Officer (Qatarization)
Description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Senior Information Security Officer is responsible for establishing and maintaining a corporate-wide information security management program to ensure that information assets are adequately protected. This position is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and reporting on information security risks in a manner that meets compliance and regulatory requirements, and aligns with and supports the risk posture of the enterprise.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Information Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)**

* Facilitate information security governance through the implementation of a hierarchical governance program, including the support of all necessary reporting requirements and metrics for the Bank Operational Risk – Information Security Steering Committee or any corresponding advisory board requirements.
* Develop, maintain and publish up-to-date information security policies, standards, and guidelines. Oversee the approval, training, and dissemination of security policies and practices.
* Create, communicate and implement a risk-based process for vendor risk management, including the assessment and treatment for risks that may result from partners, consultants, and other service providers.
* Create and manage information security and risk management awareness training programs for all employees, contractors, and approved system users.
* Work directly with the business units to facilitate IT risk assessment and risk management processes and work with stakeholders throughout the enterprise on identifying acceptable levels of residual risk.
* Provide regular reporting on the current status of the information security program to enterprise risk teams, senior business leaders, and the board of directors as part of a strategic enterprise risk management program.
* Define and facilitate the information security risk assessment process, including the reporting and oversight of treatment efforts to address negative findings.
* Facilitate a metrics and reporting framework to measure the efficiency and effectiveness of the program, facilitate appropriate resource allocation, and increase the maturity of the security.
* Understand and interact with related disciplines through committees to ensure the consistent application of policies and standards across all technology projects, systems and services, including, but not limited to, privacy, risk management, compliance, and business continuity management.
* Understand the requirements of data security governance and ensure to develop and implement the process requirements for both data classification and data privacy in the bank covering all bank stakeholders

**Department and project advisory**

* Provide strategic risk guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls.
* Coordinate information security and risk management projects with resources from the IT organization and business unit teams.

**Operational Support**

* Coordinate measures and report on the technical aspects of security management.
* Manage outsourced vendors that provide information security functions for compliance with contracted service-level agreements.
* Manage and coordinate operational components of incident management, including detection, response, and reporting.
* Maintain a knowledge base comprising a technical reference library, security advisories and alerts, information on security trends and practices, and laws and regulations.
* Manage the day-to-day activities of threat and vulnerability management, identify risk tolerances, recommend treatment plans and communicate information about residual risk.
* Ensure audit trails, system logs, and other monitoring data sources are reviewed periodically and comply with policies and audit requirements.
* Design, coordinate and oversee security-testing procedures to verify the security of systems, networks, and applications, and manage the remediation of identified risks.
* Provide advisory and keep up to date on Information security threats, technologies and techniques, and ensure the threat landscape is understood and raised with the concerned departments for remediation.
* Provide Advisory and consultation to IT and IT Security to ensure that security is factored into the evaluation, selection, installation and configuration of hardware, applications and software
* Research, evaluate, design, test, recommend or plan the implementation of new or updated information security hardware or software, and analyse its impact on the existing environment; provide technical and managerial expertise for the administration of security tools.

**Relationship building and influencing**

* Build relationships with key stakeholders and peers to ensure information security has an appropriate focus.
* Influence key stakeholders and peers to ensure security is effective.

**Legal, Compliance and Regulatory obligations**

* Update the Information Security Steering members with any new regulations and compliance requirements related to the Information Security of the Bank.
* Conduct gap analysis and ensuring the Bank is in compliance with Information Security regulations and Law.
* Liaise among the information security team and corporate compliance, audit, legal, and HR management teams as required.
* Liaise with external agencies, such as law enforcement and other advisory bodies as necessary, to ensure that the organization maintains a strong security posture.
* Manage security issues and participate in problem and change management forums. Ensuring timely reporting and adequate participation in the investigation for IS &IT security incidents, with QCB, Q-CERT, NCSA, and/or Law Enforcement agencies as applicable.
* Abide by Bank’s Information Security Policies and Procedures and ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of bank’s data and information under employee’s custody.

**Policies and Procedures**

* Develop, maintain and ensure implementation of Information Security Policies and Procedures for the Bank.
* Perform all work in accordance with departmental and bank-wide policies, processes, procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner while delivering a high quality and cost effective service to customers.
* Suggest improvements to policies, procedures, principles and standards for operational improvements or due to changes in best practices and/or regulation.
* Monitoring, reviewing and ensuring the implementation of the Information Security Policies and Procedures across the Bank.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer science or Information/Cyber Security. A higher related degree is an advantage.
* Must have at least one of the following Professional qualifications (ISC2 CISSP, SANS GIAC or ISACA CISA/CISM or higher)

**Experience:**

* 5- 7 years of relevant experience in Information Security
* Experience in the banking sector is preferred

**Job-Specific Skills (Generic / Technical):**

* Knowledge of the banking sector in Qatar and the region. (preferred)
* Experience with common information security management frameworks, such as International Standards Organization (ISO) 2700x, PCI DSS, The IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL), and Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology (COBIT) frameworks.
* Proficiency in performing risk, business impact, control, and vulnerability assessments, and in defining treatment strategies.
* Good working knowledge of regulatory and industry security specifications e.g. payment card industry (PCI, MasterCard, Visa) and regulatory bodies (financial service and central bank authorities).
* Preferably knowledge of local laws and regulations (State of Qatar, Qatar Central Bank, SWIFT, NAPS).
* Preferably banking experience or knowledge of banking operations especially around payments and alternative /electronic channels.
* Exhibit excellent analytical skills, the ability to manage multiple projects under strict timelines, as well as the ability to work well in a demanding, dynamic environment and meet overall objectives.
* Project management skills: financial/budget management, scheduling, and resource management.
* Ability to lead/ support and motivate cross-functional, interdisciplinary teams to achieve tactical and strategic goals.
* Experience in system technology security testing (vulnerability scanning and penetration testing) and local vulnerability scanning tools usage such as Nessus, Nexpose and/or Qualys.
* Familiarity in application technology security testing (white box, black box, and code review)
* Strong analytical skills to analyse security requirements and relate them to appropriate security controls.
* Solid knowledge and experience of information technology hardware and software.
* Good knowledge around IT Security solutions such as (Firewall, WAF, NAC, IPS and SIEM)
* Good knowledge in conducting information security risk assessment (GRC tools use is recommended)
* Good working knowledge on running phishing campaign using tools such as PhishMe (Cofense) or similar tools.
* Knowledge of and experience in developing and documenting security architecture and plans, including strategic, tactical, and project plans.
* Creative, logical thinking and able to influence all parties (senior and junior).
* Good communication and presentational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Planning and organising skills.
* English & Arabic lanugage required.

Title: Principal, AI Data Centres
Description:
**THE ROLE: FROM PARTNERSHIP TO CAPACITY IN SERVICE**
Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you lead Echelon’s infrastructure partnerships and the business built on them: the partners Echelon builds with, the customer programmes it delivers with them, the capability it develops alongside them and the investment cases behind new capacity. You decide where Echelon advises and where it builds with its partners, and you make each of those positions pay, working with the CRO’s account teams, Finance and Legal. You build the team from its first hires and lead it, and you set the model by which Echelon and its partners work together.
  
  

* Anchor the partnerships: Long-term relationships with the operators and suppliers whose designs and standards Echelon builds on, run with a shared plan, clear commitments and governance that holds both sides to them.
* Win at programme scale: Large capacity programmes won with our partners and structured across their whole life rather than one site at a time, on terms that reward Echelon for the value it adds.
* Widen the pipeline: The next customers that need capacity, from AI providers and hyperscalers to national programmes and large enterprises, and the next partners that extend what Echelon can deliver.
* Build the team and the model: The team you hire and lead, and the operating model around it: what Echelon does itself, what its partners do and what it buys, the cost and the governance, and the moment capability should come in-house.
* Hold the standard: Quality gates, operating procedures and liability lines, agreed with our partners, that bring every site Echelon touches up to the benchmark of the best operators.
* Grow the capability: An Echelon team that learns alongside its partners and grows from engineering and build management into network, security and facility operations.
* Build the investment case: The business cases behind new capacity, from demand, power and the chip-generation ramp to capital structure, offtake and returns, built to hold up in front of customers, partners and investors.

**WHERE WE ALIGN**
AI AND TECHNOLOGY FIRST
  
  

* Infrastructure record: You have built or led data centre, cloud or power programmes, for an operator, a developer, a hyperscaler or the firms that advise them. What you have delivered counts for more than the years.
* Partnership leadership: You have led partnerships between companies of different size and culture, and kept both sides committed from signature to delivery.
* Commercial and financial depth: You structure deals and read a project model: capital and operating cost, revenue share, offtake and returns hold no mystery for you.
* AI infrastructure depth: You understand what AI workloads change: power density, liquid cooling, the pace of chip generations, and their effect on design, cost and schedule.
* Team builder: You have hired and led teams of specialists, built a capability from its first hire and its first project, and set standards that hold as it scales.

STRONG ADVANTAGE
  
  

* Hyperscale and AI campuses: Exposure to campuses of 100 MW and above, from site and power to handover and operations.
* Licensed operating models: Experience of licensed or franchised models, where one company’s design and operating standard is delivered by another.
* Capital partners: Exposure to infrastructure investors, project finance or joint ventures.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

**OUR VALUES**

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

**THE SEAT**

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: The Chief Executive Officer
* Travel: Regular time with customers and on sites, and some with our partners’ teams in the United States.
* Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**How We Work**
You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour: You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organisation: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you plan, model and decide, and you understand from the inside what AI asks of the infrastructure that runs it.
* Where you are: A senior infrastructure builder and partnership leader, ready to build a team and a business, and at ease at the negotiating table, on site and in front of an investment committee.

Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI
Description:
**Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI**

**Company:** Ekshvaku Tech Innovations LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Office-Based  
**Experience:** 5–9 Years (Including 2+ Years of Hands-On Generative AI/LLM Development)

**About ETI**

Ekshvaku Tech Innovations (ETI) is a technology solutions and consulting company operating across the UAE and India, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, healthcare technology, insurance technology, and digital transformation.

We develop intelligent, scalable, and production-ready technology solutions for businesses across multiple industries, with a growing focus on healthcare AI, enterprise automation, and Agentic AI.

We are expanding our AI engineering capabilities and seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer who can independently design, develop, and deploy sophisticated AI-powered applications.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong Senior AI/ML Engineer with demonstrated experience building production-grade Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong software engineering fundamentals, applied machine learning expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into reliable AI systems.

This is not a research-only or prompt-engineering position.

**We are looking for an engineer who can take complete technical ownership of AI solutions, from architecture and development to deployment, optimization, monitoring, and continuous improvement.**

The selected candidate will work closely with our technical leadership and engineering teams on AI initiatives across healthcare, insurance, and enterprise technology.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Generative AI & LLM Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy applications powered by Large Language Models.
* Build solutions using commercial and open-source models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and similar technologies.
* Implement advanced prompting strategies, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration.
* Develop and optimize LLM-powered APIs and backend services.
* Evaluate model performance, accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.

**2. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, tool usage, and executing multi-step workflows.
* Build multi-agent systems with appropriate orchestration, state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Work with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop intelligent workflow automation integrating AI models with enterprise systems and APIs.
* Implement appropriate safeguards for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI workflows.

**3. RAG & Knowledge Systems**

* Architect and develop production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions.
* Implement document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing.
* Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, or pgvector.
* Implement semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and context optimization.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and response quality.
* Improve the accuracy and reliability of AI responses while minimizing hallucinations.

**4. Applied Machine Learning**

* Develop and integrate machine learning and NLP models for classification, information extraction, summarization, prediction, and decision support.
* Work with Python-based ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face.
* Perform model evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and experimentation where appropriate.
* Apply sound statistical and machine learning principles to real-world business problems.

**5. Healthcare AI & Domain Applications**

* Contribute to the development of AI-powered clinical workflows, healthcare automation, and intelligent decision-support applications.
* Build systems capable of processing clinical documents, structured records, and medical terminology.
* Work with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR, where applicable.
* Implement clinical accuracy evaluation, evidence-grounded responses, safety guardrails, and auditability.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive healthcare information and support HIPAA-aligned technical controls.
* Collaborate with domain specialists to improve clinical relevance and workflow reliability.

**6. Backend Engineering & System Integration**

* Develop scalable Python-based backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Design and integrate REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, databases, and external services.
* Build reliable integrations between AI systems and existing enterprise applications.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including modular architecture, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across AI models, application services, and infrastructure.

**7. Cloud Deployment, MLOps & LLMOps**

* Deploy AI applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and performance optimization.
* Develop automated testing and evaluation pipelines for AI applications.
* Optimize infrastructure costs, model inference latency, and overall system reliability.

**8. Technical Ownership & Collaboration**

* Independently lead technical implementation of assigned AI initiatives.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, backend engineers, QA teams, DevOps engineers, and project managers.
* Review code, mentor junior engineers, and establish engineering best practices.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure knowledge sharing across the AI engineering team.
* Engage in technical discussions and demonstrations with customers when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Programming & Backend**

* Advanced Python programming.
* FastAPI or equivalent backend frameworks.
* REST API development and asynchronous programming.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals.

**Generative AI & LLMs**

* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs and open-source models.
* Prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and model evaluation.
* Experience implementing production LLM applications.

**RAG & Search**

* Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines.
* Document processing, hybrid search, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* Experience evaluating retrieval quality and reducing hallucinations.

**Agentic AI**

* Practical experience with agent frameworks or custom agent orchestration.
* Tool calling, workflow state management, multi-step execution, and human oversight.

**Machine Learning**

* Strong understanding of ML fundamentals and NLP.
* Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.

**Cloud & Deployment**

* Experience with at least one major cloud platform.
* Docker, CI/CD, production deployment, logging, and monitoring.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5–9 years of relevant software engineering and AI/ML experience.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience delivering Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
