Title: Security Supervisor
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Under minimal supervision, acts as Security Supervisor oversees security staff and promotes a safe and secure environment of IVHD. Provides leadership and ensures compliance with quality service goals, services standards as well as following policies/procedures to ensure the effective and efficient operations of the security management program. Participates in departmental budget planning and monitoring. Required to manage the scheduling day-to-day work activity and conduct timely evaluations. Maintains daily document reviews to ensure all incident reports and daily activity reports are completed, thorough and grammatically correct. Oversight of employee/department equipment to ensure it is serviceable and well maintained. Ensures monthly/annual training compliance and attendance are within department/hospital standards and issues appropriate disciplinary action as needed.

Provides on the job training to new security personnel. Assists with presentations of various security training programs, as needed. Demonstrates familiarity with the job functions of Security and provides support as needed.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Manages the daily operation of security staff.
* Reviews and approves all requests for leave. Prepares schedules to provide appropriate coverage within budget constraints.
* Works independently handling a wide variety of security related incidents taking appropriate steps as needed.
* Participates in the development and updating of standards, policies, and procedures
* Prepares or reviews written reports on security related incidents including fire, crime, hazardous conditions and emergency situations to ensure compliance and departmental documentation requirements.
* Questions witnesses and principals in documentation incidents reported on IVHD property. Performs preliminary investigations pertaining to any felony, misdemeanor, or incidents of injury.
* Provides liaison with Law Enforcement personnel and outside contract security
* Develops and maintains effective patrol strategies based on department activity data and locations of criminal activity.
* Contributes management support in the departmental budget process and long term range planning, organizing and directing security operations.
* Prepares and conducts annual performance evaluations, including communicating the employee performance results and required improvements.
* Performs corrective or disciplinary action in consultation with Human Resources.
* Conducts and assures staff attendance to staff and mandatory meetings/functions.

Performs job duties of a Security Guard:

* Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program and safety standards.
* Patrols hospital buildings and premises to prevent fire, theft, vandalism and intruders.
* Monitors conduct of visitors on hospital premises; makes contact with unauthorized persons for questioning as needed.
* Reports safety and/or fire hazards or security violations.
* Responds to inquiries for advice or assistance from hospital personnel, students and visitors; assists in providing restraints of patients as needed.
* Escorts personnel to parking lots and hospital buildings.
* Participates in investigations; maintains records and prepares incident reports and other documents pertinent to security activities.
* Secures and/or unlocks offices and facilities.
* Secures patient valuables or lost and found articles; maintains logs of items received.
* Controls parking and traffic flow; enforces parking regulations.
* Assists with care and maintenance of department equipment and supplies.
* Maintains department records, reports and files as required.
* Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, current literature, in-service meetings and workshops.
* Attends meetings as required.
* Maintains physical fitness requirements.
* Performs other job related duties as assigned or requested.

**ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES BELOW:**

**ESSENTIAL MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**MANAGEMENT**

* Must possess direct understanding of IVHD’s goals and metrics.
* Seek data, develop plans, improve processes, and measure outcomes to continually improve quality, service and patient safety; this includes management of IVHD’s resources such as productivity and staffing, equipment, supplies and budgets.
* Understand how all parts of the organization function and work proactively to grow the business and ensure IVHD’s sustained fiscal viability.

**ACCOUNTABILITY**

* Set specific and realistic objectives and tactics.
* Prioritize work, stay focused on goals and push forward to bring plans to timely closure.
* Consider relevant stakeholders and probable consequences, take action and be decisive.
* Hold yourself and staff accountable to deliver results and follow through on commitments.
* Take responsibility, address issues, and make changes when improvement is needed.
* Champion and support system-wide initiatives.

**TEAMWORK**

* Engage staff in an inspiring vision and explain how work assignments help accomplish IVHD’s Mission.
* Create an inclusive and positive environment in which staff members feel respected, cared for, valued and energized.
* Delegate effectively, provide requisite authority and encourage individuals to collaborate.
* Network, negotiate, and build cooperative relationships with others across the system and surrounding communities.

**COMMUNICATION**

* Keep staff informed and continually up-to-date on all relevant, work related information.
* Anticipate needs and perspectives and adapt communication as necessary.
* Logically and clearly present key points.
* Ask for and consider input on ideas, decisions and plans.
* Actively listen to ensure understanding and convey empathy, and demonstrate a willingness to consider various perspectives.
* Address conflict as it arises, with honesty, curiosity and courage, assuming the positive intentions of others.

**LEADERSHIP**

* Management sets the standard for excellence in performance. In order to do so, you must be at the work site during hours of operation. Salaried/Exempt management is responsible 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. On occasions, you will be called upon to fill in for other managers or for staff who are absent from work. In those cases there will be NO additional compensation for hours worked beyond what may be a typical work period.
* You are expected to behave ethically and morally at all times.

**TIMEKEEPING**

* Management is directly responsible for overseeing the attendance and timekeeping of their staff. This responsibility cannot be delegated.

**EVALUATING PERFORMANCE**

* Evaluate the performance of your staff on an on-going basis. This is not simply an annual event.
* Employees should be informed immediately if they are “under -performing” at any time.

**COACHING**

* Celebrate, recognize and reward individual and team success that model IVHD’s values.
* Provide regular learning opportunities to develop individual talents, and increase team effectiveness.
* Invest time and collect and provide balanced and meaningful feedback on performance; encourage personal and professional growth.
* Employees who are behaving inappropriately at work or are under performing in the technical aspects of their jobs should be coached immediately and told what they need to do to get back to standard and remain employed.

**FINANCE**

* One of the most important management tasks is the creation and adherence to an annual budget. Your performance in this regard is a large part of your overall responsibility and critical to your longevity with the Medical Center. You are reminded that you are responsible for public funds. They must be managed wisely and prudently at all times.
* Mismanagement of public funds carries with it the harshest of penalties, including termination. A pattern of over spending your operating budget is one example of mismanagement. Our Medical Center is challenged with operating on a very thin margin, so it is imperative that both income and spending are managed exceptionally well. Nothing less can be tolerated by our Board of Directors or our public.

**OVERALL EXPECTATION**

* Management is expected to represent all of the values of IVHD’s to their staff and customers therefore all essential job functions/responsibilities must be performed at a higher standard.
* Failure to perform one or all of these, may lead to demotion or termination from employment.

**ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES BELOW:**

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

* Consistently demonstrates high level of professionalism, communication, and compassion with regard to human dignity. Model high standard of conduct, honesty and integrity in all situations.
* Demonstrates professional behavior through compassionate care, self-control, respect for confidentiality and the establishment of trust in all situations.
* Adheres to professional standards of behavior and communication in the workplace and actively avoids creating or participating in situations that could be considered harassment or unfair to others.
* Understands the elements of cultural diversity and applies sensitivity in communicating and working with others.

**SERVICE QUALITY**

* Demonstrates exemplary customer relations; actively promotes improvement to the working environment through conscientious, sensitive treatment of patients, customers, clients, and other team members.
* Interacts with all customers appropriately; follows through on requests, concerns or complaints. Practices service recovery.
* Keeps patient informed concerning their plan of care, treatments, tests medications and pain management (if applicable).
* Provides physicians or other hospital staff with required information and changes in patient status when calling or responding to inquiries (if applicable).

**SAFETY**

* Performs required job skills in a safe, accurate, professional manner meeting department performance guidelines.
* Adheres to all Environment of Care (EOC), workplace safety and injury prevention standards.
* Knows emergency codes and appropriate response.

**QUALITY IMPROVEMENT**

* Measures outcomes so that results consistently meet or exceed established guidelines for quality.
* Active and productive participant in quality improvement activities of department and/or hospital.
* Maintains a dedication to excellence. Meets quality standards for job. Work is accurate and complete.
* Knows and applies Focused-PDCA (Plan, Do, Check, Act) methodology.
* Actively participates in reducing errors, eliminating waste and assuring patient safety.

**FLEXIBILITY/ADAPTABILITY**

* Seeks opportunities to expand participation outside the normal job function.
* Willingly provides assistance and performs other duties as required.
* Actively engage in new initiatives, learn and adopt new work methods and embrace change in a positive productive manner.

**SELF DEVELOPMENT**

Title: Purchase Officer
Description:
**Position: Purchase Officer**

**Department:** Procurement / Purchasing  
**Industry:** Restaurants & Food & Beverage (F&B)  
**Location:** Qatar  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and well-connected **Purchase Officer** with a strong background in the restaurant and food & beverage industry in Qatar.

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 3 years of purchasing experience within the local market, with established relationships and contacts among food suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and other relevant vendors.

The candidate should have excellent knowledge of local market prices, product availability, sourcing, supplier negotiations, and procurement procedures to ensure the timely and cost-effective supply of food ingredients, packaging materials, restaurant equipment, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify, source, and purchase food ingredients, beverages, packaging materials, kitchen equipment, and other restaurant operational supplies.
* Maintain strong relationships and communication channels with local suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers in Qatar.
* Develop and maintain an updated supplier database, including contact details, product categories, prices, and payment terms.
* Negotiate competitive prices, payment terms, discounts, and delivery conditions with suppliers.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new suppliers and evaluate market prices and product quality.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials according to restaurant operational requirements.
* Coordinate with restaurant managers, chefs, and operations teams to understand purchasing requirements and maintain sufficient stock levels.
* Compare quotations from different suppliers and recommend the most cost-effective purchasing options without compromising quality.
* Monitor supplier performance regarding product quality, pricing, delivery schedules, and service reliability.
* Ensure all purchased products meet the required quality, food safety, and company standards.
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, quotations, invoices, delivery notes, and other procurement documentation.
* Monitor market price fluctuations and identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs.
* Handle urgent purchasing requirements and resolve supply-related issues efficiently.
* Ensure all procurement activities follow company policies and approved purchasing procedures.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Minimum **3 years of experience** as a Purchase Officer or Purchasing Executive within the restaurant, hotel, catering, or F&B industry.
* Strong knowledge of the Qatar local market and its purchasing channels.
* Must have established contacts and professional relationships with local food suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and vendors.
* Good knowledge of food products, fresh and frozen items, meat, poultry, seafood, vegetables, dry goods, and restaurant consumables.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and supplier management skills.
* Ability to compare quotations, analyze prices, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Good knowledge of procurement procedures, inventory requirements, and purchase documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and purchasing or ERP systems.
* Good command of English; Arabic is an added advantage.
* **Valid Qatar Driving License is mandatory.**
* Must be familiar with local supplier locations, wholesale markets, and distribution channels across Qatar.

Essential Requirements

The following requirements are mandatory:

* Previous purchasing experience specifically within the restaurant or F&B industry.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in the Qatar local market.
* Existing supplier contacts and established relationships with local vendors.
* Valid Qatar Driving License.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, trustworthy, well-organized, and commercially aware, with the ability to independently manage purchasing activities and maintain a strong network of reliable suppliers in Qatar.

Title: Production Technician
Description:
**Title:** Production Technician

**About Prysmian**

Draka EHC, a brand of Prysmian, is a global manufacturer and supplier dedicated to sustainability and developing innovative products, technical services, and integrated solutions for the vertical transportation industry. We take pride in being a premier employer in Oshawa, Ontario.

Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video, and data transmission for the telecommunication sector.

We are 30,000 employees, across 50+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us.

**Work Location:** Oshawa, Ontario

* Eligible for benefits starting on your first day.
* 3 weeks’ vacation to start.
* Gain share bonus (potential)
3 paid sick/personal days.  

**Position Summary**

Working as a member of the team the Production Technician is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of various manufacturing and distribution processes to meet the company and customer’s expectations for quality and delivery of products.

This job can involve working on a variety of processes and therefore is split into three levels for training and job grading purposes. A Production Technician will start as a level one and work up to a level three.

**Salary:** $21.00 (hourly)

**Responsibilities:**

* Operates complex machinery for manufacturing and joining plastic handrails. Performs maintenance, changes dies/extruders, and splices handrails to precise tolerances using hand tools.
* Operates machinery to manufacture rubber handrails, assembles, splices, reworks defects, and adjusts molding equipment for style changes.
* Sets up and operates Elevator Cut Line machinery. Retrieves and prepares cable, scans "Inventory Label" and "Cut Label" for accuracy, pulls cable through the "clock," attaches it to the reel, cuts to length, and wraps for shipping and identify parcel with a "Cut ticket"
* Operates and sets up machines to slit, cut, extrude, join, or pre-assemble rubber materials. Adjusts equipment and changes dies for different styles and sizes.
* Operates and sets up the bending machine and router to prepare brush holders and other parts.
* Ensures inventory accuracy by labeling and tracking material discrepancies.
* Keeps the workplace clean and organized to ensure efficient processes and defect-free products.
* Handles special projects in the manufacturing areas as needed.
* Packages finished parts according to approved methods and standards.
* Health, Safety, and Integrated Management System: Maintains a safe and healthy environment by adhering to company Health & Safety policies, complies with current legislation, follows Draka EHC’s IMS procedures to reduce environmental impact, and ensures quality service by upholding Draka EHC standards and ISO procedures.
* Inspection & Testing: Measures products with analog and digital gauges, visually inspects them against established standards, places suspected non-conforming products on hold, and maintains SPC graphs to adjust processes based on negative trends.
* Reports & Administration & Other Related Duties: Maintains quality records in compliance with established standards, completes final inspection, inventory accuracy, and productivity reports, and prepares Certificates of Quality as required.
* Training: May be asked to train other employees as requested by the Production Supervisor.
Team Effort: Collaborates with team members to support efforts, achieve team goals, and continuously improve processes and products.  

**Knowledge and skill requirements** :

* Completion of high school.
* 3 years of experience in production processes using complex machinery is considered an asset.
* High degree of hand-eye coordination required, with the ability to consistently handle over 35 kg and stand for extended periods.
* Proven experience in inspection and testing within an ISO 9000-accredited manufacturing company.
* Solid working knowledge of Quality Concepts, Basic SPC, blueprint reading, and inspection.
Proficient in ERP software, Microsoft Word, and email communication.

Title: Case Management & Resident Support Specialist
Description:
**Company:** Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC)

**Location:** Toronto, Ontario

**Job Type:** Part-time

**Schedule:** 20 hours per week

**Work Arrangement:** On-site

**Reports To:** Program Manager

About the Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre

The Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC) is a nonprofit organization supporting newcomers and refugees through transitional housing, employment assistance, community programs, and services that promote stability, inclusion, and independence.

Our approach emphasizes compassionate, culturally sensitive, and practical support that empowers individuals to overcome barriers, access essential resources, and achieve greater self-sufficiency.

Position Overview

RCHC is seeking a compassionate, experienced, and highly organized **Case Management & Resident Support Specialist** to provide individualized assistance to newcomers, refugees, and residents experiencing complex personal and social circumstances.

The successful candidate will conduct needs assessments, develop individualized support plans, coordinate access to community resources, and monitor client progress toward greater stability and independence.

This position requires strong interpersonal skills, sound professional judgment, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to maintain professional boundaries while providing respectful and practical support.

The primary focus of this role is case management, resident support, and service coordination rather than clinical therapy.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Client Intake, Assessment, and Case Planning**

* Conduct initial client intake meetings and comprehensive needs assessments.
* Identify individual strengths, challenges, risks, and support requirements.
* Assess barriers related to housing, employment, settlement, personal well-being, and independent living.
* Develop individualized case management plans with clear objectives, timelines, and follow-up activities.
* Monitor client progress and adjust support plans according to changing circumstances.
* Identify situations requiring specialized intervention or additional professional services.

**2. Resident Support and Client Engagement**

* Establish positive, respectful, and professional relationships with residents and clients.
* Provide practical guidance and support to individuals navigating personal, housing, settlement, and social challenges.
* Encourage problem-solving, personal responsibility, self-sufficiency, and independence.
* Communicate program expectations, available resources, and client responsibilities clearly.
* Follow up on missed appointments, outstanding actions, and resident concerns.
* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries while demonstrating empathy and cultural sensitivity.

**3. Crisis Support and Risk Management**

* Recognize signs of distress, vulnerability, crisis, or potential safety concerns.
* Respond appropriately to urgent situations in accordance with organizational procedures and professional responsibilities.
* Facilitate access to emergency services or specialized professionals when necessary.
* Support appropriate de-escalation, safety planning, and referrals within the scope of the position.
* Document incidents, actions taken, and required follow-up accurately and promptly.
* Escalate complex or high-risk situations to appropriate personnel.

**4. Service Coordination, Referrals, and Advocacy**

* Connect clients with relevant community services, including:
* Housing and shelter services
* Employment and training programs
* Settlement and immigration-related support services
* Healthcare and mental health resources
* Legal and financial assistance
* Government and community programs
* Assist clients in navigating service applications and accessing available resources.
* Establish and maintain relationships with community organizations and service providers.
* Advocate for clients when appropriate to help address barriers to accessing services.
* Coordinate referrals and follow up to confirm access to required support.
* Collaborate with external service providers while respecting confidentiality and consent requirements.

**5. Case Documentation and Confidentiality**

* Maintain accurate, timely, and organized case management records.
* Prepare and update intake assessments, individualized support plans, referrals, case notes, and progress reports.
* Document client interactions, incidents, decisions, and follow-up activities objectively and professionally.
* Protect confidential and sensitive information in accordance with organizational policies and applicable privacy requirements.
* Obtain and document client consent when information sharing is required.
* Ensure case records are properly maintained and accessible only to authorized personnel.

**6. Team Collaboration and Program Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Program Manager, Employment Services, HR, and other RCHC team members.
* Participate in case conferences, team meetings, and client progress reviews.
* Communicate emerging concerns, service gaps, and recommendations to appropriate colleagues.
* Coordinate support for clients with complex or overlapping needs.
* Provide regular updates on case progress, client outcomes, and outstanding follow-up actions.
* Contribute to the improvement of case management procedures and resident-support services.

**7. Community Engagement and Program Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date information on community resources and referral services.
* Identify emerging client needs and barriers to accessing support.
* Support relationships with community organizations and service providers.
* Recommend improvements to case management practices and service coordination.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen housing stability, settlement, well-being, and independent living.

Qualifications and Experience

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant education, training, or demonstrated professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Social work or case management
* Community and social services
* Housing, shelter, or settlement services
* Counselling or crisis support
* Community outreach or client advocacy
* Pastoral care, chaplaincy, or community leadership involving direct support to individuals and families
* Experience supporting individuals facing complex personal or social circumstances.
* Ability to conduct needs assessments and develop practical action plans.
* Knowledge of community resources, government programs, and referral processes.
* Strong interpersonal communication, active listening, and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent documentation, organizational, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to exercise professional judgment and maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Commitment to culturally sensitive and inclusive client support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Social Work (BSW), Master of Social Work (MSW), or relevant education in counselling, social services, or a related field.
* Registration with the Ontario College of Social Workers and Social Service Workers (OCSWSSW), or another applicable professional regulator, where relevant.
* Experience in transitional housing, settlement programs, shelters, or community-based organizations.
* Experience supporting newcomers, refugees, and individuals navigating major life transitions.
* Experience with crisis intervention, client advocacy, and coordinated service delivery.

Candidates from diverse professional backgrounds are encouraged to apply where they can demonstrate the practical case management skills and professional judgment required for this position.

Professional credentials must be accurately represented. Any regulated activities must remain within the individual's authorized scope of practice.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Compassion, empathy, and active listening.
* Strong professional ethics and appropriate boundaries.
* Cultural sensitivity and respect for diverse backgrounds.
* Effective crisis response and sound judgment.
* Excellent case documentation and recordkeeping.
* Accountability, initiative, and consistent follow-through.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Effective collaboration with colleagues and community partners.
* The ability to communicate expectations respectfully and confidently.
* A commitment to promoting client dignity, stability, and independence.

Working Environment

* Part-time, on-site position based in Toronto, Ontario.
* 20 hours per week.
* Regular collaboration with the Program Manager and RCHC team.
* Direct interaction with residents, clients, and community service providers.
* Responsibilities requiring confidentiality, professional judgment, and consistent follow-through.

Why Join RCHC?

* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of newcomers and refugees.
* Support individuals as they work toward housing stability, successful settlement, and independence.
* Collaborate with dedicated professionals and community organizations.
* Contribute to individualized case planning and coordinated support services.
* Work in an environment that values compassion, accountability, and professional judgment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

* An updated résumé highlighting relevant education, training, and professional experience.
* A brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role and experience supporting individuals with complex needs.

**Application Method:** Apply directly through Indeed.

Equity and Accessibility

RCHC is committed to maintaining an inclusive, equitable, and accessible recruitment process.

We welcome applications from qualified candidates of diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.

Applicants requiring accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to communicate their needs so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Description:
**Reference Number:** R2876001

**Position Title:** Patient Support Specialist

**Department:** Patient Support Services Specialty Care Canada

**Location:** Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

**About Sanofi**

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

  
  

**About the Job**

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

  

The Specialist, Patient Support Process is a influential team member with the experience to help drive innovation within Sanofi Canada's Patient Support Services. This individual reports directly to the Head, Patient Support Services, and is a member of the Sanofi PSS team.

The individual is responsible for identifying gaps and developing short- and long-term process improvements across Sanofi Specialty Care and General Medicines Canada patient programs. Working alongside the Patient Program Leads, this individual helps ensure each program delivers consistent, high-quality, and compliant support, while enhancing the experience of both patients and healthcare professionals at every touchpoint.

The Specialist, Patient Support Process is accountable for developing and implementing best practices that bring consistency across the patient programs offered in our portfolio. This includes introducing digital tools to evolve PSS operations, ensuring compliance with local and global processes, and supporting audit readiness and response requirements.

**Main responsibilities:**

**Process Improvement**

* Identify gaps across PSS programs and strategically design and implement process improvements
* Implement best practices and ensure consistency across programs
* Apply process improvement methods to strengthen the PSS experience at key touchpoints across the patient journey
* Pinpoint where patients may fall out of a program and design workflow changes to address them
* Own the end-to-end delivery of process improvement initiatives

**Digital Enablement**

* Bring in digital tools and capabilities to evolve PSS operations
* Support the rollout of new indications and PSS initiatives, including new digital capabilities, by tracking and communicating project status

**Program Oversight**

* Maintain visibility across PSS programs to flag common challenges and opportunities for more consistent ways of working

* Apply sound vendor management practices to support strong, well-coordinated partnerships

* Present findings and recommendations clearly to partners, grounded in a solid understanding of program operations

**Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Ensure compliance with local and global PSS processes
* Support audit readiness and response requirements

**Strategic Support**

* Contribute to shaping strategies with stakeholders to help deliver shared milestones

**About You**

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Strong patient focus, passion, and results orientation
* Bachelor's degree; a relevant master's degree is a plus
* 1-3 years of relevant pharmaceutical experience, including exposure to Patient Support Services
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to improve patient access or create new ways of working; exposure to piloting digital capabilities is an asset
* Strong collaboration, organizational, and operational skills; comfortable working independently and as part of a team
* Demonstrated analytical and leadership potential, with a track record of delivering on project objectives
* Effective communicator, able to present to cross-functional and cross-organizational audiences in a matrix environment
* Adaptable and able to lead through shifting business priorities
* Excellent writing, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Power Automate skills

* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

Title: Senior/Staff Application Support Specialist (Trading & Market Data) - Toronto
Description:
#### **Company Description**

Since its foundation in 2007, Solactive AG has evolved into one of the world’s most important and fastest-growing index providers. From our headquarters in Frankfurt, we power global investment products across ETFs, structured products, and mandates. Our reputation is built on innovation, speed, flexibility, and strong partnerships.  
Service Operations is a multidisciplinary and agile application support function responsible for real‑time system monitoring, technical troubleshooting of complex applications, incident management, and global market checks. The team supports our business, development, and DevOps departments across all mission‑critical environments, ensuring reliable 24/6 operational coverage.

#### **Job Overview**

You'll be the senior technical anchor for our Toronto application support team. You'll lead with hands on expert knowledge and set the bar for technical excellence and direction when things break, own the KPI and Deliverable of the local team, and help colleagues grow. You'll work closely with our Berlin and Hong Kong teams and global stakeholders to keep critical trading and market-data platforms running.

#### **Your Tasks**

**Production Support & Incident Management**

* Provide L2/L3 support for business-critical trading and market-data applications, and make sure L1 requests are handled effectively.
* Lead major incidents end-to-end: triage, technical coordination, escalation, stakeholder communication and root-cause analysis.
* Own tickets and service requests through to resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Support change, release and deployment activities in line with ITIL practices.

**Technical Support & Platform Stability**

* Troubleshoot issues across market connectivity, APIs, databases, data feeds and distributed Linux-based systems.
* Analyse logs and system behaviour, write and optimise SQL, and execute controlled database changes.
* Identify recurring issues and drive permanent fixes with development and infrastructure teams.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted relationships with business users across our offices.
* Communicate clearly and confidently under pressure, to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Technical responsibility & Local Coordination**

* Act as the local technical lead: set daily priorities, coordinate workload and run handovers with other regions.
* Be the go-to escalation point for complex technical issues within the team.
* Coach and mentor junior and mid-level colleagues through pairing, reviews and knowledge sharing.
* Drive operational improvement initiatives from idea to delivery and bring others along with you.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

#### **Your Profile**

**Experience**

* 6+ years in Application, Production or Technical Support within financial markets.
* Experience in market-making, derivatives or multi-asset trading.
* Hands-on experience supporting trading platforms, market-data systems or other real-time financial applications.
* Solid understanding of the trade lifecycle, market connectivity and production operations.
* Some experience guiding others, for example as a shift lead, mentor, incident lead or informal technical lead. Formal people management is not required.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong Linux skills.
* Advanced SQL.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana or similar.
* Good knowledge of APIs, distributed systems, job schedulers and system integrations.
* Strong grasp of Incident, Change and Release Management.
* AI Proficiency

**What we look for in you**

* You stay calm and take charge during an incident.
* You enjoy helping others get better, and people naturally come to you for answers.
* You'd rather fix a problem for good than patch it twice.

**Desirable**

* DevOps, SRE or software development background.
* Python scripting.
* Experience using AI tools or automation to reduce repetitive support work.

#### **Our Offer**

* **Global Team:** Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.
* **FinTech Excellence:** Join our team and delve into the inner workings of a thriving FinTech company.
* **Modern Culture:** Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
* **Responsibility & Connections:** Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside the company.
* **Special Benefits:** Regular staff parties, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space and free beverages.

#### **Your Application**

This role sounds like you? Then we look forward to receiving your application. Please make sure to also upload your CV, a cover letter is not compulsory. If you have any futher questions just drop us an email at careers@solactive.com.

You want to know more about life at Solactive? Visit Work@ Solactive

***Please Note***

*No artificial intelligence (AI) is used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position.*

*Solactive does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process and will never request payment for CV enhancement, interviews, training, equipment, or other recruitment-related services. Please be cautious of fake profiles or fraudulent messages claiming to represent Solactive. If you are unsure whether a communication is legitimate, contact us at* *careers@solactive.com**.*

*Solactive does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any cooperation request must be addressed directly to People & Culture. Costs related to unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles will not be covered by Solactive.*

#### **About us**

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

**Job Location:**

Souq Waqif Boutique Hotel By Tivoli

Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. **Job Description – Captain Waiter**
====================================

  
  

**Hotel:** Tivoli Hotels & Resorts
  
**Department:** Food & Beverage
  
**Position:** Captain Waiter
  
**Reports To:** F&B Supervisor / F&B Manager

  
  

### **Job Summary**

As a Captain Waiter at Tivoli Hotels & Resorts, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the restaurant while delivering exceptional dining experiences to guests. You will supervise and coordinate the activities of the service team, maintain high standards of food and beverage service, and ensure guest satisfaction in accordance with Tivoli brand standards.

**Guest Service & Operations**

* Provide professional, attentive, and personalized food and beverage service to all guests.
* Welcome guests warmly and ensure their dining experience meets the hotel's service standards.
* Take accurate food and beverage orders and provide recommendations based on guest preferences.
* Ensure proper presentation and timely delivery of food and beverages.
* Monitor guest satisfaction throughout the dining experience and respond promptly to requests or concerns.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and escalate unresolved matters to the Restaurant Supervisor or Manager.
* Maintain excellent knowledge of the restaurant menu, daily specials, promotions, and beverage offerings.
* Ensure all service areas are properly prepared before, during, and after restaurant operations.
  

  

**Team Supervision & Coordination**

* Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of waiters and other service team members.
* Allocate service sections and assign duties to ensure efficient restaurant operations.
* Guide and support team members in delivering consistent service standards.
* Assist in training new team members on service procedures, menu knowledge, and guest interaction.
* Monitor team performance and provide constructive feedback when necessary.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and other Food & Beverage departments to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Conduct pre-service briefings when assigned by the Restaurant Supervisor or Manager.
  

  

**Restaurant Standards & Quality Control**

* Ensure restaurant cleanliness, table settings, and service equipment meet Tivoli brand standards.
* Monitor the quality, presentation, and accuracy of food and beverage orders before serving.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and sanitation regulations.
* Maintain proper handling and storage of restaurant equipment and supplies.
* Support inventory control by monitoring service supplies and reporting shortages.
* Ensure proper billing procedures and accurate handling of guest payments in accordance with hotel policies.
* Promote restaurant offerings and upselling opportunities to support departmental revenue objectives.
  

  

**Communication & Teamwork**

* Maintain effective communication with the kitchen, bar, and restaurant management teams.
* Communicate guest preferences, dietary requirements, and special requests accurately.
* Assist in coordinating special events, group bookings, and VIP dining arrangements.
* Support the Restaurant Supervisor and Manager in maintaining efficient daily operations.
* Promote a positive and professional working environment within the Food & Beverage team.

### **Qualifications and Experience**

* Previous experience as a Captain Waiter, Senior Waiter, or similar position within a hotel or upscale restaurant.
* Experience in a luxury hospitality environment is an advantage.
* Good knowledge of food and beverage service procedures and restaurant operations.
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Good command of written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Ability to supervise and motivate a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of Point of Sale (POS) systems and restaurant billing procedures is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Professional appearance, positive attitude, and guest-oriented approach.
* Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

### **Key Competencies**

* Guest service excellence
* Leadership and team supervision
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Time management and organizational skills
* Adaptability and ability to work under pressure
* Food and beverage product knowledge
* Professionalism and cultural awareness

### **General Responsibilities**

* Consistently maintain high standards of guest service in accordance with Tivoli Hotels & Resorts expectations.
* Comply with all hotel policies, procedures, grooming standards, and service guidelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of guest information and hotel operations.
* Follow health, safety, hygiene, and security regulations.
* Participate in departmental meetings, training sessions, and development programs.
* Support the Food & Beverage management team in achieving departmental objectives, guest satisfaction targets, and operational efficiency.
* Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by management to support hotel operations.

Sweeping Corporation of America (SCA) is the nation’s leading street sweeping company, operating in over 20 states and supporting more than 600 municipalities, counties, and government agencies. In this role, you’ll take ownership of assigned routes, drive the street sweeper, and operate specialized equipment to keep streets clean and well-maintained.
  
The job responsibilities below outline the core duties and expectations of a position, providing clarity on how the role supports Company goals. However, not all duties can be listed, and as business needs evolve, responsibilities may shift over time to reflect new priorities, processes, or technologies:
  

* Safety & Inspection: Perform required pre-trip and post-trip inspections of equipment in accordance with company standards. Ensure all safety features are operational before beginning route.
* Execution: Review assigned routes thoroughly prior to departure. Be proactive in asking clarifying questions if the route or expectations are unclear. Complete assigned jobs within the allotted timeframe while maintaining expected quality and attention to detail.
* Equipment Operation: Operate equipment safely and efficiently at all times, following all traffic laws, company safety procedures, and site-specific protocols. Exercise additional caution during inclement weather or challenging site conditions.
* Material Handling: Handle materials safely and securely; Apply correct procedures for material types and disposal sites.
* Reporting: Report any equipment issues, malfunctions, near misses, crashes, or injuries within 30 minutes or as soon as safely possible. Immediately escalate opportunities, work issues, or safety concerns to management.
* Professional Communication: Maintain a professional attitude and appearance while representing the company on job sites or in public areas. Communicate effectively with team members, supervisors, and clients when needed.
* Compliance & Documentation: Accurately complete required logs, manifests, and forms.
* Adaptability & Problem Solving: Respond appropriately to changes and challenges; identify and solve issues timely.
* Regular & Predictable Attendance: The ability to consistently report to work on time and as scheduled, with minimal unexcused absences. This includes being present and prepared to work throughout assigned shifts, and reliably adhering to start times, breaks, and end times.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**  
Minimum job qualifications define the essential skills, experience, and abilities needed to succeed in the role. They set the baseline for hiring but may evolve as the job and business requirements change:
  

* Education: High School or GED
* Experience: 1 year DOT driving experience preferred
* License: Driver’s License
* Age: Must be at least 21 years of age
* Compliance: Must maintain an acceptable driving record and successfully pass a motor vehicle record (MVR) check, background check, and drug screening in accordance with Company policy and applicable law.

**Skills & Competencies:**  
Skills and competencies define the abilities and behaviors essential for success in the role. They guide performance expectations and may evolve as the role, team, or business priorities change:
  

* Safety & Compliance Focus: Ability to follow safety procedures, conduct inspections, operate equipment responsibly, and comply with all traffic, site, and regulatory requirements.
* Operational Execution & Reliability: Strong ability to plan routes, complete work efficiently and accurately, adapt to changing conditions, and maintain consistent, dependable attendance.
* Communication & Issue Reporting: Effectively communicate with supervisors and teammates, represent the Company professionally, and promptly report equipment issues, incidents, or safety concerns.

**Safety is #1:**  
Our safety culture is more than a policy—it’s a mindset. We have a full-time safety team, rigorous training programs, and detailed operating procedures to protect our people and the communities we serve. You’ll be supported from Day One with the tools and knowledge to work confidently and safely.
  
  
**Benefits & Wellness at SCA:**  
We believe great people deserve great perks. When you join SCA, you’re not just keeping the streets clean—you’re paving the way to a better future (with some solid benefits under the hood).
  
  
**Here’s what we’ve got in our hopper:**  

* 401(k) with Match: Plan for the long haul—retirement is another kind of clean sweep.
* Weekly Pay: Consistent weekly pay you can count on, plus on-demand pay so you can access earned wages when you need them.
* Health, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance: Take care of what matters most with benefits designed to support you and your family’s wellbeing and future.
* Short- & Long-Term Disability: If life throws a pothole your way, we help you keep rolling.
* Indemnity Insurance: Extra protection for life’s unexpected detours.
* Paid Time Off & Holidays: Even the best machines need downtime.
* Training Programs: Shift into high gear with learning and career advancement opportunities.
* Team Focus: We show up for our customers and each other, every day.
* A Culture that Cares: People are the heart of everything we do, fostering a culture of respect, safety, and growth
* Rooted in Respect: A company with a name people know & trust - built on relationships, community pride and a people focused approach to leadership.

**Physical Requirements:**  
Physical requirements outline the essential on-the-job demands needed to perform the role safely and effectively.
  

* Work Environment & Exposure: Constant work outdoors with regular exposure to weather, elements, and traffic; occasional exposure to loud noise, dust/debris, and jarring conditions; limited exposure to chemicals.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Syntys is a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for overseeing and optimizing day-to-day operations across headquarters and all markets. The role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure efficient, scalable, and high-quality operations supporting Syntys’ ambitious growth in the data center and digital infrastructure sector.

The COO oversees HQ and Market Operations, IT, Procurement, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Sustainability, ensuring operational excellence, risk management, and effective support for hyperscalers, wholesale colocation providers, and strategic partners. The role plays a critical part in building the operational foundation required to meet world-class standards for reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

**ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Operational Leadership & Excellence**

* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational processes across HQ and Market operations to ensure efficiency, scalability, and service excellence.
* Establish and oversee operational standards, KPIs, and governance frameworks to ensure consistency and alignment across all Syntys locations.
* Ensure operational readiness, service quality, and risk management across all data center operations.
* Collaborate with Country Managers and OpCos to drive operational alignment and excellence in all markets.

**IT & Technology Operations**

* Oversee the Group’s IT function, ensuring robust, secure, and scalable IT infrastructure and services to support business needs.
* Lead the development and implementation of digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, automation, and business resilience.
* Ensure cybersecurity, data protection, and IT risk management are fully integrated into operations.
* Collaborate with other leaders to ensure technology investments support operational and commercial objectives.

**Procurement & Supply Chain Management**

* Lead the Group Procurement function to ensure efficient, transparent, and cost-effective sourcing of goods and services.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies to support operational needs, vendor performance, and supply chain resilience.
* Oversee strategic supplier relationships and contract negotiations to ensure value for money and alignment with project timelines.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards.

**Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Risk Management**

* Establish and enforce EHS standards, policies, and programs to ensure a safe, compliant, and risk-aware working environment across all operations.
* Drive a culture of safety excellence and regulatory compliance across all Syntys sites.
* Lead incident prevention, reporting, and response initiatives to minimize operational disruptions and ensure employee well-being.
* Ensure robust risk management practices are embedded in all operational activities.

**Sustainability & Environmental Responsibility**

* Lead the development and implementation of sustainability strategies that align with Syntys’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) commitments.
* Drive operational initiatives to reduce environmental impact, improve energy efficiency, and promote sustainable power strategies within Syntys operations.
* Collaborate with the CEO, Commercial, and Engineering teams to integrate sustainability into operational and infrastructure planning.
* Represent Syntys in sustainability-related forums and with external stakeholders.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, lead, and develop high-performing operational teams across HQ and Markets, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Set clear performance expectations, KPIs, and development plans for operational leaders and teams.
* Ensure effective succession planning and leadership development within the operations function.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Commercial, Engineering, Finance, HR, and Legal teams to ensure operational alignment with strategic business objectives.
* Support Commercial teams in translating client requirements, especially from hyperscalers, into operational deliverables.
* Collaborate on infrastructure development plans to ensure operational readiness and sustainability integration.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive leadership experience in data center operations, infrastructure, or technology-driven environments.
* Proven experience managing hyperscaler operations, client requirements, and critical infrastructure.
* Strong background in IT operations, procurement, supplier management, and EHS.
* Demonstrated success in leading sustainability initiatives within an operational environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, IT, or a related field (required).
* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or equivalent (preferred).
* Fluent in English; Arabic language capability preferred.

Title: Dean of Students
Description:
### **Job Description**

**Dean of Students**
====================

**Department:** Student Affairs / Pastoral Care
  
**Direct Reports:** As assigned
  
**Location:** School Campus
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Dean of Students is responsible for promoting a safe, positive, inclusive, and supportive school environment in which students can thrive academically, socially, and personally.

The role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership of student wellbeing, behaviour, discipline, attendance, student engagement, and pastoral systems. The Dean works closely with school leadership, teachers, counsellors, parents, and support staff to ensure that student-related matters are managed consistently, fairly, and in accordance with school policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Student Behaviour and Discipline**

* Lead and oversee the school's student behaviour and discipline processes.
* Ensure that behaviour expectations and consequences are applied consistently and fairly.
* Investigate and manage significant student behaviour incidents and disciplinary cases.
* Maintain accurate records of disciplinary incidents, interventions, and outcomes.
* Work with teachers and school leaders to develop appropriate behaviour interventions and support plans.
* Monitor recurring behaviour concerns and identify patterns requiring further intervention.
* Support restorative practices and strategies that promote accountability and positive behaviour.
* Escalate serious or repeated concerns to the appropriate member of the Senior Leadership Team.

### **2. Student Wellbeing and Pastoral Care**

* Promote a positive school culture focused on student wellbeing, belonging, respect, and inclusion.
* Work closely with school counsellors and pastoral staff to identify and support students requiring additional assistance.
* Monitor students who may be experiencing academic, social, behavioural, or personal difficulties.
* Coordinate appropriate interventions and follow-up support.
* Ensure student concerns are appropriately documented, managed, and escalated where required.
* Promote student voice and encourage students to take an active role in the school community.

### **3. Attendance and Student Engagement**

* Monitor student attendance, punctuality, and patterns of absence.
* Work with relevant staff and parents to address persistent attendance or punctuality concerns.
* Identify students who may be disengaged from school and coordinate appropriate interventions.
* Support initiatives designed to improve attendance, participation, and student engagement.

### **4. Safeguarding and Student Protection**

* Work collaboratively with the school's safeguarding team to promote student safety and welfare.
* Follow all school safeguarding policies and procedures.
* Report and escalate safeguarding concerns in accordance with school requirements.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when dealing with sensitive student matters.
* Contribute to safeguarding education, awareness, and prevention initiatives.

### **5. Parent and Community Relations**

* Serve as a key point of contact for parents and guardians regarding significant student behaviour, wellbeing, attendance, and pastoral matters.
* Conduct meetings with parents to discuss concerns, interventions, and student progress.
* Communicate professionally and constructively, particularly when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations.
* Build positive relationships with families and promote partnership between home and school.

### **6. Student Leadership and Activities**

* Support and develop student leadership opportunities.
* Encourage student participation in school activities, events, clubs, and community initiatives.
* Support student councils and other student leadership structures.
* Promote student responsibility, leadership, citizenship, and positive contribution to the school community.

### **7. School Culture and Community**

* Promote the school's values, expectations, and standards of conduct.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen school culture, student belonging, and community spirit.
* Support the organisation and delivery of assemblies, student events, campaigns, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Act as a visible and approachable presence around the school campus.

### **8. Staff Support and Collaboration**

* Provide guidance to teachers and staff regarding student behaviour, pastoral concerns, and appropriate interventions.
* Work collaboratively with Heads of School, Heads of Department, Year Leaders, Counsellors, SEN/SEND staff, and other relevant teams.
* Support staff in implementing consistent behaviour and pastoral expectations.
* Deliver or coordinate staff training related to student behaviour, wellbeing, safeguarding, and pastoral care where appropriate.

### **9. Data, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate student records relating to behaviour, attendance, wellbeing, and interventions.
* Analyse student behaviour and attendance data to identify trends and areas requiring action.
* Prepare reports for school leadership as required.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of student support and behaviour systems.
* Recommend improvements to policies, procedures, and student support programmes.

### **10. Leadership and School Operations**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of school policies relating to students.
* Participate in leadership meetings and relevant school committees.
* Support the Principal and Vice Principal with student-related matters and school-wide initiatives.
* Assist with crisis management and major student incidents when required.
* Undertake other duties reasonably assigned by the Principal or designated member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Social Sciences, Leadership, or a related field.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or leadership qualification is desirable.
* Previous experience in a school-based pastoral, student affairs, behaviour, safeguarding, or leadership role.
* Experience managing complex student behaviour and wellbeing matters.
* Experience working collaboratively with parents, teachers, school leaders, and external professionals.
* Knowledge of safeguarding principles and child protection practices.
* Experience in an international or multicultural school environment is desirable.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of student behaviour, wellbeing, and pastoral care.
* Excellent conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Strong organisational and case-management skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations.
* Strong decision-making and judgement.
* Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural and social backgrounds.
* Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and using student information systems.
* Commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, student wellbeing, and educational excellence.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Integrity and professionalism.
* Empathy and emotional maturity.
* Fairness, consistency, and sound judgement.
* A student-centred approach.
* Resilience and composure.
* Strong accountability and ownership.
* Collaborative and approachable leadership.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trust with students, parents, and colleagues.

**Key Performance Areas**
-------------------------

Performance in the role may be assessed against:

* Effectiveness of student behaviour and discipline systems.
* Student wellbeing and pastoral support.
* Attendance and punctuality improvement.
* Consistency and effectiveness of behaviour interventions.
* Quality and timeliness of student case management and documentation.
* Parent and student engagement.
* Safeguarding compliance.
* Student leadership and engagement initiatives.
* Staff support and collaboration.
* Contribution to a positive and inclusive school culture.

Title: Oshawa Power Control Room Operator
Description:
**CONTROL ROOM OPERATOR**
-------------------------

Oshawa Power Group of Companies is a parent company of fiber optic, district energy and renewable generation businesses, and the local electricity distribution company that supplies electricity to more than 63,000 customers in the city of Oshawa. Located just 45 minutes east of Toronto off the shores of Lake Ontario, Oshawa serves as the economic engine for the Durham Region. Oshawa Power maintains 1000 km of overhead and underground distribution lines within a 150 km2 service territory, operated at 44 and 13.8 kV, supplied by 9 distribution and 3 transmission substations. The organization is committed to the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of electricity through responsible financial management, strategic reinvestment and continuous innovation.

**ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting to the Manager, Distribution Construction, the Control Room Operator is responsible for the safe, reliable and efficient real-time operation and control of the company's electrical distribution and sub-transmission systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.

As a designated Controlling Authority, the position monitors system conditions, authorizes and directs switching, administers work protection, coordinates field response and manages power restoration while protecting employees, contractors, the public and electrical equipment.

**Hourly Rate:** $44.99- $59.23 per our Collective Agreement with **IBEW 636**

**Vacancy Type:** Replacement

**AS THE SUCCESSFUL APPLICANT, YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO BE INVOLVED WITH:**

**System Operations & Monitoring**

* Exercise real-time operational control of the company's distribution, sub-transmission and station systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.
* Monitor SCADA, ADMS, GIS, alarms, voltage, loading, equipment status and other operating information; identify abnormal conditions and take or direct timely corrective action to maintain safe and reliable system operation.
* Authorize and direct the safe operation of switches, breakers, reclosers, intelligent field devices, station equipment and other electrical apparatus.
* Monitor feeder, station, transformer and equipment loading; respect established ratings and operating limits and initiate or recommend corrective action.
* Use automated and self-healing distribution devices to support sectionalizing, fault isolation, load transfer and service restoration.

**Switching & Work Protection**

* Prepare, check, issue and administer switching orders, Orders to Operate, Hold-Offs, work permits and other work protection documents in accordance with the Utility Work Protection Code (UWPC), Electrical Utility Safety Rules (EUSR), and company procedures.
* Control and authorize operational access to electrical plant and equipment in accordance with the UWPC, EUSR, and company procedures.
* Review planned work with field crews, supervisors, contractors and authorized parties to confirm system configuration, isolation requirements, operating sequences and appropriate work protection.
* Direct overhead, underground, station and sub-transmission switching for planned work, system reconfiguration, load transfers, equipment isolation and service restoration.

**Outage & Emergency Response**

* Coordinate planned and unplanned interruptions; dispatch and direct field personnel to investigate trouble, isolate hazards, complete emergency repairs and safely restore service.
* Assess disturbances and establish restoration priorities that protect public and employee safety, safeguard equipment, maintain system integrity and minimize customer impact.
* Respond to emergencies involving downed conductors, damaged equipment, fires, motor-vehicle incidents, public hazards and possible life-safety concerns.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate planned and emergency switching, supply interruptions, load transfers and station operations with Hydro One's control centre.
* Communicate with the IESO, Electrical Safety Authority, emergency services, neighbouring LDCs, contractors, major customers and other authorities as required.
* Provide clear operational direction to field personnel and accurate, timely outage and system information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond professionally to customer inquiries involving outages, partial power, voltage concerns and other distribution-system conditions, and arrange investigation as required.

**Operating Records, Systems & Improvement**

* Maintain accurate operating diagrams, maps, open-point records, equipment status information, switching records, outage records, operating logs and required reports.
* Support investigations of system events, equipment operations, interruptions, power-quality concerns and feeder performance, and assist with corrective actions.
* Assist with the development and continuous improvement of operating procedures, emergency and restoration plans, switching practices and System Control Center processes.

**Training, Safety & Other Requirements**

* Provide instruction and operational support to Apprentice or backup operators and maintain required technical, safety, emergency-response and cybersecurity training.
* Comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, applicable regulations, UWPC, EUSR, company policies and safe work practices.
* Available for emergency response, overtime and call-ins on an as-needed basis in accordance with established schedules and the collective agreement. Rotational shifts may be introduced in the future and would be included in the collective agreement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU HAVE TO OFFER**

**Education:**

* Three-year college diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering Technology or a related electrical discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant utility experience, education and technical training may be considered.
* Successful completion of the MEARIE Operator-in-Training Program and certification as an EDA Journeyperson Electrical Operator is required.
* OACETT certification, or eligibility for certification, as a C.E.T. or C.Tech. is considered an asset.
* Current UWPC certification is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum four years of progressively responsible experience in electrical distribution-system operations, System Control Center operations, utility field operations, protection and control, stations or a directly related electrical utility function.
* Demonstrated experience with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, switching orders, work protection, system isolations, load transfers and service restoration.
* Experience coordinating field crews and external authorities during planned work, outages and emergencies.
* Experience operating 13.8 kV distribution and 44 kV sub-transmission systems, including associated stations and protection schemes, is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of overhead and underground distribution, sub-transmission, transformer stations, protection schemes and associated equipment.
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of the UWPC, electrical isolation, switching and work-protection principles.
* Strong understanding of electrical fundamentals, loading, voltage, equipment ratings, fault response, system restoration and operating contingencies.
* Ability to interpret and maintain single-line diagrams, operating maps, schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings and switching documents.
* Ability to assess complex, changing conditions and make timely, accurate and defensible operating decisions with minimal supervision.
* Advanced problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive during outages and emergencies.
* High accuracy and attention to detail when preparing and administering operating and work-protection documents.
* Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate simultaneous switching, outage, dispatch and communication activities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and unambiguous direction by radio, telephone and electronic systems.
* Ability to direct field activities and establish operational priorities without direct supervisory authority.
* Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, contractors, customers, emergency services, regulators and other utilities.
* Proficiency with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, Microsoft Office and other operational technology systems.
* Strong commitment to safety, system reliability, customer service, teamwork, respect and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work established schedules and maintain the concentration required to safely manage multiple concurrent activities, including rotational shifts if introduced in the future.
* Valid Ontario Class G driver's licence with a driving record satisfactory to the company.
