Title: Associate Administrative Officer (OPAS)
Description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the direction of the Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau/ICAO (D/CDI), the Field Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of programmes in the Capacity Development and Implementation (CDI) Bureau. FOS assists with the identification of priority development requirements across civil aviation and with technical cooperation to recipient States. It carries out resource mobilization with multilateral and bilateral development partners and industry. FOS develops regional and country-specific technical cooperation programmes and projects and executes these programmes and projects in accordance with the policies and contractual modalities of CDI.

The Associate Administrative Officer is a combined finance and administration function that oversees the project office’s administrative and accounting tasks under the CDI Project: FSA2201. The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the CDI Programme Manager overseeing the project, in accordance with the terms of reference set out in this job description. The position is located in the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) of Saudi Arabia, in Riyadh, and works in close coordination with the CDI Field Operations Officer, ICAO Headquarters, GACA, and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to ensure the efficient, compliant and timely delivery of all financial and administrative services required for the successful implementation of the project. The incumbent exercises professional judgement in planning and delivering assigned work, analysing issues and identifying appropriate action within established policies, procedures and responsibilities. Complex or exceptional matters are referred to the supervisor for guidance.

Major duties and Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides accounting and financial support for the effective administration of the project office by reviewing transactions, monitoring resource use and applying established financial procedure, achieving results such as:**

* Collaborate with relevant authorities to prepare the annual manning requirement list and coordinate with ICAO-HQ for budget preparation and submission of the budget report to the GACA Finance Department on a yearly basis.
* Liaise with GACA to ensure proper budget administration, authorization, and project funding, and bring discrepancies or delays to the attention of the supervisor.
* Manage petty cash, process payments towards project office expenses, reconcile monthly expenses, and prepare and submit Electronic Journal Cash Transactions (EJCT) cash book reports to ICAO Finance in Montreal.
* Analyse and monitor petty cash balances against the established threshold stipulated under ICAO financial rules and regulations, identify and address variances, coordinate the timely deposit of excess funds to UNDP, and prepare monthly replenishment requests to ensure the project’s petty cash balance remains consistent.
* Monitor local payments and payment authorizations for ICAO OPAS Experts, vendors, and other project-related expenses through UNDP, ensuring proper fund transfers and timely follow-up.
* Review vendor statements and invoices for completeness and submit them for approval and/or facilitate payment processing and manage the financial aspects of the ICAO experts and support staff members under the project.
* Manage travel claim records of ICAO OPAS Experts, ensuring compliance with ICAO and ICSC standards, monitor unsettled claims, and follow up on payments.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides administrative support to the project office, achieving results such as:**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities, draft and review routine correspondence and letters, coordinate and monitor official email correspondence, and monitor follow-up actions to support timely field-project implementation.
* Organize project documentation, and coordinate the review, finalization and signature of the Management Service Agreement (MSA), the ProDoc, and related records.
* Coordinate the procurement of office supplies, and official operational requirements from local markets, and facilitate the procurement of digital publications for GACA and ICAO OPAS Experts.
* Contribute to the review of project reports, presentations, and financial analysis for the CDI Programme Manager.
* Organize and maintain an orderly e-filing system and documentation of all assigned tasks, correspondence and reports, applying applicable records-management standards; ensuring confidentiality and compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations; such documents to be shared only with the consent of the CDI Programme Manager.

Function 3 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides personnel and contract administration support, achieving results such as:**

* Compile, Analyse and submit key reports such as the Monthly Strength Return, Quarterly Reports, and Annual Reports.
* Coordinate with GACA authorities/Department Heads and ICAO-HQ on critical administrative matters, including contract extensions, staff performance reports, probationary reports, new expert arrivals, and repatriation of OPAS Experts.
* Review, reconcile and submit travel expense claim reports and educational grant claim reports for ICAO experts, and review, verify and submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Home Leave, Family Visit, Lump Sum, and Mission Requests) to ICAOHQ in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate with the travel agency to arrange flight itineraries and issue domestic airline tickets for approved official travel and missions.
* Maintain updated and accurate administrative records, including contract renewal documentation, annual staff performance reports? (SPRs), driving authorization letters, and vehicle insurance records.
* Liaise with UNDP and GACA to facilitate the issuance and renewal of UN/GACA identification cards (IDs), and manage government-related requests such as Visas, IQAMA, Multiple Re-entry Visas, Final Exit Visas, and Driving Licenses through coordination with UNDP, UNRC and GACA.
* Coordinate training requirements for ICAO experts, including liaison with ICAO Global Aviation Training (GAT) Section, and prepare employment-related letters (bank letters, visa request letters, staff arrival letters, etc.).

Function 4 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides coordination, meetings and stakeholder support, achieving results such as:**

* Organize annual, quarterly and urgent meetings for the project office, and prepare draft agendas and minutes of the meetings (MOM) for project records.
* Liaise with GACA, ICAO, UNDP, UNDSS, UNRC and other relevant offices for project coordination, recruitment, and administrative support, and assist in meetings with these stakeholders to address project requirements.
* Facilitate recruitment processes, including coordination with GACA and ICAO for candidate approvals and onboarding, and assist with contract extensions, SPR, and repatriation processes for project staff.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across all stakeholders, inside and outside the project office, for the effective implementation of the project.
* Maintain the confidentiality of all project-related data and ensure compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations.

Function 5 (incl. Expected results)

**Performs any other duties as required for the successful and timely implementation of the programme.**

Impact of The Outcome of the Position

The Associate Administrative Officer ensures effective project administration by managing communications, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. This role directly supports project efficiency, compliance, and the seamless operation of administrative tasks within the ICAO-CDI Project. The position plays a key role in maintaining efficient administrative operations, ensuring compliance with policies, and supporting project coordination, which directly impacts smooth project execution and stakeholder collaboration.

Work Relations and Contacts

The Associate Administrative Officer reports to the GACA Authorities in close coordination with the CDI Programme Manager. The incumbent also coordinates with ICAO experts on administrative matters, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.

COMPETENCIES

**Professionalism** : Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. **About telMAX Inc.:**

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator will support full-cycle recruitment across telMAX, helping us find and hire great people as we grow. This role also supports what happens after the offer is signed, including onboarding, employee file management, and benefits and RRSP administration. This is an ideal opportunity for a recent graduate looking to launch a career in Human Resources. In this highly dynamic position, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in your career and within the organization.

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

Recruitment:

* Post job openings on job boards, social media, and school career portals
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone screens to build shortlists of qualified candidates
* Schedule interviews and coordinate communication between candidates and hiring managers
* Track candidates and keep applicant records up to date in the applicant tracking system
* Help prepare offer letters and employment agreements
* Coordinate reference checks, background checks, and work-eligibility verification
* Support job fairs, campus events, hiring events, and co-op recruitment
* Help keep job descriptions and postings current

Onboarding:

* Coordinate pre-boarding and first-day logistics with hiring managers, IT, and other departments
* Prepare onboarding materials and welcome packages, and help run new hire orientation
* Set up new employee profiles in the HRIS and ensure documentation is complete
* Check in with new hires during their first weeks to support a smooth start

Employee Records:

* Maintain accurate and confidential digital employee files
* Update employee information and changes in the HRIS (ADP Workforce Now)
* Help prepare employment verification letters and other HR documentation

Benefits & RRSP Administration:

* Process benefits and RRSP enrollments, changes, and terminations
* Answer employee questions about benefits and RRSP, escalating more complex matters as needed
* Work with benefits and RRSP providers on routine administration

People and Culture:

* Plan and run culture initiatives such as Lunch & Learns, employee BBQs, celebrations
* Help prepare pulse surveys and analyze results
* Maintain positive relationships with employees and create a comfortable environment within the office

HR Support:

* Assist with offboarding tasks, including exit documentation
* Help prepare recruitment and HR reports, such as open roles and time-to-fill
* Support People Operations projects and other duties as assigned

**What You Bring:**

* A genuine interest in recruitment and Human Resources, and an eagerness to learn
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence speaking to candidates and managers
* Excellent organization and time management, with the ability to juggle multiple open roles and deadlines
* Attention to detail and accuracy, especially with employee data
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)
* A proactive, service-minded attitude

**Experience:**

* This is an entry-level role; new and recent graduates are encouraged to apply
* Co-op, internship, or part-time experience in HR, recruitment, or a customer-facing role is an asset
* Experience with an HRIS or applicant tracking system (e.g., ADP Workforce Now) is an asset

**Education:**

* Recently completed degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Working toward the CHRP designation is an asset

**ImPACT Values**

* Performance & Commitment

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.

* Agility & Collaboration

We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.

* Customer Centricity

In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word-of-mouth and drive company growth.

* Trust & Integrity

We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.

**Why You Should Join telMAX:**

* We are a growing, dynamic organization
* We offer a competitive variable compensation package
* Hybrid positions
* Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
* Health Spending Account (HSA)
* RRSP matching program

**Equity Statement**

telMAX Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace, welcoming applications from all individuals. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), accommodations are available on request for candidates during the selection process as well as throughout employment.

Title: Technician - Digital Delivery - Civil 3D/ Naviswork - Infra/ utilities
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Produce models and drawings to the project's standards. This is the production core of the team and the largest single grade in it. The role carries one accountability of its own on the responsibility matrix: keeping the drawings as the single source of truth for what is extracted from the model in 2D.

**Key responsibilities**

**What the role is accountable for**

* Maintaining the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of the drawings, so that what is issued matches the model it came from.

**Production**

* Model utility networks, corridors and surfaces in Civil 3D within the assigned scope.
* Deliver models and drawings against the team's plan.
* Apply NOC data standardisation and base plan standardisation.
* Keep base plan and title block requirements correct for the milestone stage.
* Produce BIM model geometry and attributes, and export to the formats required.

**Checking**

* Produce cut sheets, bind drawings and run the drawing quality control self-check.
* Apply the discipline model checklist, the 3D check.
* Apply the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check, the 2D check.
* Take part in the final drawing sanity check before the set goes to review.

**Working in the team**

* Fix the clashes assigned, and update the model rather than only the drawing.
* Contribute to quantity take-off where it feeds the bill of quantities.
* Report modelling problems and blockers to the senior technician promptly rather than working around them.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D to a working level: pipe networks, corridors, surfaces and sheet production.
* AutoCAD.
* Awareness of Navisworks and of how clashes are assigned and closed.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360 for filing work in the right place and state.
* Bluebeam Revu for receiving and answering markups.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Diploma in Civil Engineering or Draughtsmanship.
* Three or more years of infrastructure drafting and modelling.
* Civil 3D used on live projects is essential.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Follows a standard precisely.
* Asks early when something is unclear.
* Takes correction on a drawing without taking it personally.

**How performance is measured**

* Output against allocation.
* Turnaround time on markups.
* Checklist compliance when the work is audited.

**Assessment against the team competency framework**

New joiners at this grade are assessed against the team's nine competency areas during onboarding, each rated Not Yet, Basic, Developing or Competent:

* Understanding project deliverables
* Authority standards and catalogues, for Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Saudi Arabia
* Civil 3D design skills, pipe and pressure networks
* Corridor and rainbow corridor modelling
* BIM standards and model management, including data shortcuts
* Design collaboration and the common data environment
* Clash detection and coordination
* Utility compliance verification, depth and cover against authority standards
* Quality assurance and technical awareness

 **Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Description:

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

AECOM Middle East Infrastructure delivers civil and utility infrastructure design across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Digital Delivery / BIM team models and documents wet utilities, dry utilities, MEICA and smart technology networks for these projects, and is responsible for the quality, coordination and timely issue of the information that comes out of them.

**Purpose of the role**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review.

**Key responsibilities**

**Deployment and progress**

* Own the deployment of resource across the group's disciplines, and rebalance it as project demand moves.
* Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group.
* Own the key performance indicators reported for the group, and the progress position on clash and issue resolution.
* Onboard third parties brought in to support the project team.

**Delivery management**

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.
* Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files.
* Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project.
* Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams.
* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

**Validation and issue**

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.
* Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check.
* Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review.
* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

**Clash and interface**

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

**People**

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.
* Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role.
* Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.
* Demonstrable record of delivering to ISO 19650 on live projects; formal certification is an advantage.
* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Holds a standard consistently, including when programme pressure argues against it.
* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

**How performance is measured**

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

Title: 2027 Facilities Coordinator Intern, Reliability Maintenance Engineering
IT Operations Centre Analyst - ITOC
Description:
**Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.**

The IT Operations Analyst ensures a safe and reliable technology environment for Air Canada with focus on troubleshooting and operational tasks to support our critical IT services: core infrastructure, applications and digital. The IT Operations Centre team is constantly engaging with the core IT teams to find ways to proactively monitor the environment and develop skills to handle vital operations and is a key enabler of service automation within the IT portfolio.

This position will be reporting to the Manager, IT Operations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Act as an initial escalation point for the service desk and other Air Canada IT teams as they identify issues regarding our technology environment.
* Effectively escalate service impacting issues to the correct teams and collaborate to ensure the issue is resolved as soon as possible. Preliminary troubleshooting before escalating is required. Proactively respond to alerts by performing correctional tasks to remediate issues and prevent larger issues from occurring.
* Act as a coordinator for the on-duty Major Incident owner including organizing communications and tracking troubleshooting actions in the event of a major incident.
* Provide daily support for the extended IT support teams by performing documented operational procedures that will optimize the systems environment.
* Ensure monitoring tools are tweaked and configured properly to effectively receive proactive alerts.
* Work closely with the IT service management team to identify reoccurring problems within the technical systems and work towards resolution and/or documented procedures to mitigate.
* Work with ITOC BA’s, automation analysts and the extended IT team to expand the ITOC portfolio of services through documenting design, standard operating procedures and other opportunities to provide value.
* Make recommendations for Service Improvement Plans and ensure actions are followed through to completion in a timely manner.
* Work with internal and third-party teams to ensure actions are taken and completed to protect and improve services.
* Provide assistance to cyber defence teams regarding IT certificate management.
* Conduct initial investigations and make proactive decisions in cloud web portals according to IT security procedures.
* Develop knowledge of monitoring tools that will be used to monitor Air Canada's IT infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the IT operations team to investigate and mitigate repetitive incidents in the IT service.

**Qualifications**

* A relevant University degree/technical certification, and/or relevant experience commensurate to the role.
* 3-5 years’ experience in an enterprise IT environment or global NOC.
* At least 3-5 years of experience in the following: IT Monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk , Glassbox etc. IT Major Incidents, ITIL process concepts and execution (Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management),
* ITSM tools and processes, and in an operational technical role under application, infrastructure or network operations support or as a senior team member in a related service.
* Recent Certifications in a related domain such as CCNA, MSCE, AWS, CSP, ITIL, etc.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and in rapidly changing environments or uncertain conditions.
* Ability to work cooperatively with others on a team and to communicate (verbally and in writing) effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrates concern for satisfying one’s external and/or internal customers.
* Anticipates the implications and consequences of situations and takes appropriate action to be prepared for possible contingencies.
* Excellent organizational and troubleshooting skills and a passion for Service Improvement.
* Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.
* This position requires a high level of availability and flexibility as shift work is a requirement as this role. Shift work might include nights, weekends, statutory holidays, and on-call schedule when needed.
* Assets: DevOps, Web and Mobile apps support; Security+ or other security certifications; Linux certifications or experience; Storage knowledge and troubleshooting; CCNA or equivalent networking experience; Certification in ITIL;  
  SolarWinds, Dynatrace, NetScout certification or extensive experience.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees’ unique contributions to our company’s success.

Working closely with clients, vendors, agents, finance teams, and operational personnel, you will be at the heart of maintaining seamless project execution through effective administration, logistics coordination, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement. This role is ideal for an organized and proactive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic marine and offshore environment and thrives on ensuring operational excellence behind the scenes.
  
  
**What does success look like in this position?**  
Success in this role means keeping subcontractor and personnel records accurate, up to date, and readily available to support uninterrupted project operations. You will confidently manage qualifications, medical certificates, visas, training records, and travel arrangements, ensuring that subcontractors are always prepared for mobilization and demobilization activities. You will proactively identify upcoming document expirations and coordinate renewals well in advance, reducing operational delays and ensuring business continuity.
  
You will build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, agents, and internal stakeholders, creating clear communication channels that enable projects to progress smoothly. Success also means efficiently coordinating visas, port passes, travel, accommodation, and logistical arrangements while maintaining cost-effective solutions that support operational objectives.
  
In this position, you will accurately process timesheets, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor documentation through NetSuite, ensuring compliance with company procedures and client requirements. You will maintain reliable filing systems, provide management with real-time workforce availability and compliance data, contribute to monthly ESG reporting requirements, and support HSEQ initiatives through equipment calibration coordination, first aid kit maintenance, and reporting activities. Your attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to operational excellence will directly contribute to the successful delivery of marine services projects.
  
  
**How you make an impact:**  
As our Project Coordinator, you will make a significant impact by ensuring that all subcontractor deployment activities are managed efficiently, compliantly, and without disruption to project delivery. You will serve as a central point of coordination for operational documentation, mobilization logistics, compliance records, and stakeholder communications, helping the Marine Services Department deliver services effectively and maintain high standards of professionalism.
  
Your contribution will strengthen the organization's ability to mobilize qualified personnel quickly and efficiently while reducing operational risks associated with documentation, travel, compliance, and contractor management. Title: Network Engineer-GCGCON
Description:
**Position Summary:**

Under the general direction of Sr Manager, Network Services & Delivery, the Network Engineer is a senior level hands on technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and ongoing operation of the organization’s enterprise network and network security infrastructure. This role supports a multi-site, 24x7 operational environment, requiring a strong focus on availability, resiliency, performance, and security by design.
  
The Network Engineer works in close partnership with IT Security to ensure network designs align with enterprise security architecture, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
  
The Network Engineer acts as the primary network architect for assigned domains, translating business, operational, and security requirements into scalable, resilient, and supportable network solutions. In addition to advanced operational responsibilities, the role provides technical leadership, mentors other network staff, serves as subject matter expert for initiatives, and collaborates with management, IT peers, vendors, and security stakeholders to deliver reliable and secure network services.

Operational Support & Service Reliability

* Assume technical authority and lifecycle accountability for the performance, capacity, and availability of assigned network systems.
* Provide senior-level operational support, including 2nd and 3rd level escalation, and lead resolution of complex network and security-related issues.
* Participate in after-hours on-call rotation, with accountability for ensuring networks are architected to be stable, secure, and recoverable.

Network Architecture & Infrastructure Design :

* Own the network and network-security architecture for assigned domains, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, Internet connectivity, and secure access platforms.
* Design and maintain network solutions supporting a multi-site, 24x7 environment, with emphasis on availability, resiliency, segmentation, and security-by-design.
* Lead requirements gathering, architecture, and technical design for network and security initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and security architecture.
* Act as technical lead and network architect for projects and major changes, providing design authority and implementation guidance.
* serve as the primary technical authority for secure connectivity, network segmentation, perimeter defense, and traffic control platforms.

Security & Risk Management

* Partner closely with the Cybersecurity team to ensure network designs support enterprise security controls, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Assume technical authority and lifecycle accountability for the security posture of assigned network systems.
* Identify and drive architectural and operational improvements that reduce incidents, improve security, and enhance overall service reliability.

Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Lead network and security initiatives from requirements gathering through implementation and operational transition.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance for projects, major changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and service quality.

Standards & Governance:

* Develop and maintain clear network and security architecture documentation, standards, and diagrams.
* Ensure network solutions adhere to enterprise architecture standards, operational best practices, and governance requirements.

**Educational and Functional Requirements:**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in network administration within a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience in network and security architecture, technical design, and enterprise scale implementations within 24x7 operations.
* Post secondary education in Information Technology or equivalent experience.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in:

o Enterprise LAN, WAN, and WLAN architectures
  
o Network security technologies (firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, segmentation, secure access)
  
o Multi-site routing and switching
  
o Internet connectivity and service provider integrations
  

* Proven ability to troubleshoot across network, operating system, and application layers.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA )required, or equivalent experience;
* Cisco Certified Network Professional; Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert;Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer( CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE), or equivalent security focused certifications are considered strong assets.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and security requirements into secure, scalable network architectures.
* Excellent communication skills with a service-oriented mindset.
* Valid Class 5 Driver’s License.

Title: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) - 12 Month Contract

Since 1988, Merrithew has trained more than 100,000 instructors in over 135 countries and developed premium equipment and science-based education trusted by leading studios, rehabilitation centers and fitness professionals.

* Passion – Be present, enthusiastic, energetic, committed to purpose, inspiring
* Boldness – Act with courage, change the norm, never settle for “just ok”
* Customer-Centric – Our Vision is fulfilled through our Trainers, Partners and end-customers.
* Accountability – Act like owners, own the results
* Innovation – Delivering the best, highest-quality products, programs and services

**Position Overview****:**

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) provides strategic advice and hands-on support across the full employee lifecycle. Partnering with leaders, employees and HR colleagues, this role helps Merrithew attract, develop, engage and retain talent while supporting business performance and a positive workplace culture.

Supporting the assigned departments, the HRBP contributes across workforce planning, recruitment, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, total rewards, and HR operations and organizational change. The role balances employee needs with business priorities, promotes consistent people practices and builds managers’ capability to lead effectively.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**1. HR Strategy and Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leaders to translate business priorities into people plans, staffing requirements and organizational capabilities.
* Assess workforce capacity, skills gaps and succession risks, recommending actions to support current and future needs.
* Advise on organizational structure, job design, role clarity and resource allocation.
* Contribute to annual HR planning, headcount budgets and people initiatives.
* Use workforce data to assess progress and adjust priorities.

**2. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define hiring needs, develop job descriptions and establish selection criteria.
* Support recruitment strategies opened positions.
* Coach managers on interviewing, candidate assessment and fair, inclusive hiring practices.
* Support internal mobility, promotions and succession pipelines.
* Collaborate on employment offers, compensation recommendations and hiring approvals.
* Help strengthen the candidate experience and Merrithew’s employer brand.

**3. Onboarding, Employee Transitions and Offboarding**

* Coordinate with managers and internal partners to deliver effective onboarding, orientation and probationary reviews.
* Help new employees understand their roles, performance expectations, workplace practices and Merrithew’s values.
* Support transfers, promotions, contract changes and other employee transitions.
* Guide offboarding activities, including exit interviews, documentation and coordination with payroll and other departments.
* Identify themes from onboarding and exit feedback to improve retention and the employee experience.

**4. Employee Relations**

* Act as a trusted adviser on workplace concerns, policy interpretation and employee relations matters.
* Coach managers on conflict resolution, attendance, corrective action and sensitive employee conversations.
* Conduct timely, impartial and well-documented investigations into workplace complaints.
* Recommend appropriate resolutions and support disciplinary decisions and employment separations in consultation with HR leadership and legal advisers.
* Promote consistent treatment, procedural fairness and respectful workplace behaviour.
* Where applicable, support collective agreement interpretation, grievance management and labour relations activities.

**5. Performance Management**

* Support goal setting, performance reviews, ongoing feedback and performance improvement processes.
* Coach managers to establish clear expectations and address performance concerns promptly.
* Help ensure performance assessments and employment decisions are fair, evidence-based and consistently documented.
* Connect performance outcomes with development, recognition, succession and compensation decisions.
* Monitor completion and effectiveness of performance management activities.

**6. Learning, Leadership Development and Succession**

* Identify employee and leadership development needs through business discussions, performance reviews and skills assessments.
* Partner on training plans, learning resources and development programs.
* Facilitate training on people management, workplace policies and core HR practices.
* Support career development, mentoring, cross-training and internal advancement.
* Coordinate talent reviews and succession planning for critical positions.
* Assess whether learning initiatives improve capability and workplace performance.

**7. Compensation, Benefits and Recognition**

* Support compensation reviews, salary benchmarking, job evaluation and internal equity assessments.
* Advise managers on salary changes, promotions and recognition within approved guidelines and budgets.
* Partner with payroll and benefits providers or internal specialists to resolve employee questions and issues.
* Help communicate compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs, as applicable.
* Support benefits enrolment, changes and program reviews in collaboration with the responsible partners.
* Recommend recognition practices that reinforce contribution, performance and Merrithew’s values.

**8. Employee Engagement, Culture and Inclusion**

* Support engagement surveys, employee listening activities and action planning.
* Coach leaders to respond to feedback and strengthen trust, communication and team effectiveness.
* Promote inclusive practices across hiring, development, advancement and day-to-day management.
* Support employee recognition, wellbeing and community-building initiatives.
* Identify retention risks and recommend practical actions.
* Reinforce Merrithew’s values through leadership behaviours and people programs.

**9. Health, Safety, Wellbeing and Disability Management**

* Partner with operational leaders and health and safety representatives to support safe working practices across office and manufacturing environments.
* Support safety orientation, required training, incident follow-up and corrective actions within the HR function’s responsibilities.
* Coordinate accommodation, disability management and return-to-work processes with employees, managers and relevant providers.
* Support leave administration, attendance management and workplace injury claims processes.
* Promote employee wellbeing and awareness of available support resources.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling medical and accommodation information.

**10. Employment Compliance, Policies and Risk Management**

* Support compliance with applicable employment standards, human rights, accessibility, privacy and occupational health and safety requirements.
* Develop, review and communicate HR policies, procedures and employee guidance.
* Monitor relevant legislative developments and recommend updates with HR leadership or legal advisers.
* Maintain clear documentation of employment decisions and HR processes.
* Support audits, required training and employment-related reporting.
* Identify people risks and escalate complex or sensitive matters appropriately.

**11. HR Operations, Systems and Payroll Partnership**

* Maintain accurate employee information, employment documentation and HR system records.
* Coordinate timely processing of new hires, employee changes, leaves and departures.
* Partner with payroll to validate employee changes, resolve discrepancies and support accurate pay administration.
* Respond to employee inquiries and improve the consistency and responsiveness of HR services.
* Support HR system adoption, data quality, records retention and appropriate access controls.
* Streamline administrative processes and identify opportunities to improve employee self-service.

**12. HR Analytics and Reporting**

* Monitor measures such as headcount, turnover, absenteeism, vacancies, recruitment timelines and training completion.
* Analyze trends to identify workforce challenges and recommend targeted action.
* Prepare clear reports and insights for leaders while protecting employee confidentiality.
* Evaluate the outcomes of HR initiatives and recommend improvements.
* Support accurate workforce reporting and planning.

**13. Organizational Development and Change Management**

* Support organizational growth, restructuring, technology adoption and changes to working practices.
* Assess the people impact of proposed changes and help develop implementation plans.
* Coach leaders on change communication, employee involvement and transition support.
* Help teams improve collaboration, accountability and effectiveness.
* Partner across functions to embed new processes and assess adoption.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Postsecondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ or more years of progressive HR experience, including broad generalist responsibilities and experience advising people managers.
* CHRP or CHRL designation, or progress toward a designation.
* Experience supporting corporate and manufacturing teams is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations, investigations, performance management, recruitment and employee development.
* Working knowledge of compensation, benefits, payroll processes, disability management and workplace health and safety.
* Working knowledge of employment requirements and the ability to coordinate appropriate advice for various jurisdictions.
* Experience using HR systems, reporting tools and workforce data.

Title: Principal Network Developer
Description:
As a Principal Network Development Engineer within NAT, you will serve as a senior technical leader for network acquisition, connectivity delivery, and activation across OCI’s global infrastructure. You will guide the engineering execution of connectivity supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, backbone growth, and strategic network deployments.

You will operate at the intersection of network architecture, telecommunications, optical infrastructure, service providers, data center engineering, deployment, and operations. Your scope will span carrier circuits, dark and lit fiber, DWDM and wavelength services, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects. You will translate complex network designs and business requirements into clear technical specifications, implementation approaches, and acceptance criteria for internal teams and infrastructure partners.

At the Principal level, you will lead engineering decisions across programs and deployments, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and evaluate tradeoffs involving capacity, performance, resiliency, physical route diversity, operational supportability, and delivery constraints. You will partner with architecture and engineering teams to identify implementation gaps early and use delivery and operational experience to influence future designs, technical standards, and supplier requirements.

You will establish the technical requirements for circuit acceptance, fiber and optical validation, turn-up, activation, and production readiness. You will guide teams in evaluating test evidence, resolving deficiencies, and documenting readiness decisions, exceptions, and remediation requirements before operational handoff. As a senior technical escalation point, you will lead the resolution of complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 issues across OCI teams and external providers, drive root cause analysis, and ensure recurring failures result in corrective actions and engineering improvements.

You will work closely with Program Managers to assess technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and recovery options across the delivery portfolio. You will strengthen NAT’s engineering practices through reusable standards, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, acceptance frameworks, accurate infrastructure records, and clear operational handoffs. You will also guide the use of automation, scripting, telemetry, database management tools, and AI-assisted engineering to improve validation, troubleshooting, data quality, and delivery efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and validating outputs.

This role requires deep network engineering expertise, sound technical judgment, and the ability to drive complex outcomes across organizations and external suppliers. You will influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise engineering standards across NAT, with an emphasis on repeatable practices that improve connectivity quality, reliability, and readiness at global scale.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Provide senior technical leadership for complex global connectivity programs supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, and strategic network deployments.
* Own technical outcomes across the lifecycle of carrier circuits, dark fiber, lit fiber, wavelengths, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects.
* Translate high-level network architecture and business requirements into detailed technical delivery requirements and implementation strategies.
* Lead technical design reviews covering topology, physical paths, diversity, demarcation, transport, interfaces, optics, capacity, routing, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Identify design and delivery risks early and drive engineering decisions that prevent downstream deployment and operational issues.
* Define technical acceptance standards and validation requirements for network infrastructure delivered by external providers.
* Lead complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting across fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, routing, and provider networks.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic or high-impact connectivity issues.
* Lead deep-dive root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions across Oracle and supplier engineering organizations.
* Act as a technical authority in supplier engagements, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring services meet OCI engineering, reliability, scalability, and operational requirements.
* Partner with Program Managers to assess technical risk, establish delivery strategy, make tradeoffs, and develop recovery plans for critical infrastructure.
* Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving network architecture, backbone, Internet, optical, capacity, deployment, operations, data center teams, and suppliers.
* Develop technical standards, design patterns, acceptance criteria, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, and engineering best practices that can be applied globally.
* Identify systemic gaps in network acquisition and delivery and lead technical improvements that increase quality, predictability, and operational readiness.
* Influence supplier capabilities, technical roadmaps, testing methodologies, and service offerings based on OCI requirements.
* Lead or contribute to technical evaluation of new carriers, services, hardware, optical technologies, and connectivity solutions.
* Define requirements for automation and tooling that improve network delivery, validation, monitoring, inventory accuracy, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with software and automation teams to ensure engineering requirements are translated into scalable tools and workflows.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution development while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship to NDEs, Program Managers, and partner teams.
* Raise the technical bar for NAT and serve as a trusted technical advisor across the organization.

**Critical Focus Areas**
========================

* Global carrier and service provider networking
* Optical transport, DWDM, dark fiber, lit fiber, and wavelengths
* Internet transit, peering, and inter-domain networking
* Backbone and metro connectivity
* Network architecture and resiliency
* Circuit and fiber acceptance
* Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting
* Supplier technical leadership
* Network readiness and production acceptance
* Root cause analysis and systemic remediation
* Technical standards and engineering governance
* Automation requirements and AI-assisted engineering

**Qualifications**
==================

* Extensive experience designing, building, operating, or delivering large-scale networks within hyperscale cloud, Tier 1 ISP, telecommunications, service provider, or comparable environments.
* Expert-level knowledge in at least one networking domain such as routing, optical transport, Internet, backbone, or data center networking, with strong knowledge across multiple adjacent domains.
* Deep understanding of network architectures and network device behavior.
* Strong knowledge of routing and networking protocols including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, TCP/IP, IPv4, and IPv6.
* Deep experience troubleshooting complex network problems across physical, optical, Ethernet, transport, and routing layers.
* Strong understanding of optical networking, fiber infrastructure, structured cabling, cross-connects, transceivers, and physical network design.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit, inter-domain networking, backbone infrastructure, or large-scale service provider connectivity.
* Experience translating high-level architectures into detailed technical designs and implementation requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineers and cross-functional organizations.
* Experience working directly with supplier engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve infrastructure solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as an escalation point and lead root cause analysis for complex or large-scale network events.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to evaluate tradeoffs involving architecture, resiliency, performance, cost, schedule, and operational complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to engineering and senior leadership audiences.
* Experience with scripting or programming and a strong understanding of software development and network automation concepts.
* Experience defining technical requirements for automation, tooling, monitoring, or operational systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience designing or delivering carrier connectivity at global scale.
* Deep experience with dark fiber, lit fiber, DWDM, optical transport, wavelengths, metro fiber, or long-haul networks.
* Experience with OTDR, optical power testing, fiber characterization, acceptance testing, and complex optical troubleshooting.
* Experience working directly with major telecommunications carriers, ISPs, fiber providers, optical vendors, or colocation providers.
* Experience with network diversity, route engineering, physical path analysis, and resiliency requirements.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit architecture, BGP policy, and inter-domain networking.
* Experience supporting hyperscale AI or GPU infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Broadcom and NVIDIA/Mellanox-based networking platforms.
* Familiarity with YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, telemetry, and model-driven networking.
* Experience influencing supplier technical roadmaps, hardware adoption, testing strategies, or service capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, scripting, and engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across engineering organizations.

Title: Inflight Training Operations Controller
Description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Manager, Crew Planning, the Inflight Training Operations Controller is responsible for the coordination, execution, and oversight of all short-term inflight training activities. This role manages the day-to-day and monthly scheduling of Flight Attendant training programs, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and company training requirements.

Working collaboratively with Inflight Training, Crew Planning, and operational stakeholders, the Controller ensures training activities are effectively scheduled, monitored, and recovered in the event of operational disruptions. The role is critical to maintaining crew qualifications, operational readiness, and compliance with Transport Canada regulations and company standards.

Duties & Responsibilities:

### **Training Operations & Scheduling**

* Execute and manage all short-term (current month and day-of) inflight training schedules.
* Plan, adjust, and optimize training activities within crew management systems.
* Coordinate recovery of disrupted training events, including initial, recurrent, upgrade, and specialized training.
* Schedule and adjust instructor resources to support training delivery requirements.

### **Tracking & Compliance**

* Monitor and track completion of all inflight training to ensure regulatory and company compliance.
* Oversee inflight crew training validity and currency in accordance with Transport Canada regulations and company policies.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate compliance risks, including expiries or missed training.

### **Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Liaise with Inflight Training, Crew Scheduling, and external vendors to support training delivery and recovery efforts.
* Partner with Inflight leadership on training priorities, constraints, and operational impacts.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and changes clearly to inflight crew members.

### **Systems & Administration**

* Maintain accurate training records and scheduling updates within crew management systems.
* Input and validate schedule adjustments and associated pay implications.
* Review and reconcile manual adjustments related to training and crew utilization.

### **Reporting & Monitoring**

* Monitor daily training performance and identify risks to completion or operational readiness.
* Generate and maintain reports on training status, expiries, and recovery plans.
* Provide data-driven insights to support planning and decision-making.

### **Safety & Compliance**

* Actively participate in the Safety Management System (SMS), including reporting hazards and operational irregularities.
* Promote adherence to company safety policies and regulatory requirements.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.
* **Teamwork:** Working collaboratively with others to achieve organizational goals.
* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Crew Scheduling, Crew Planning, Training Coordination, or a related operational role
* Experience in inflight operations or training environments is considered an asset
* Familiarity with aviation regulatory requirements (e.g., Transport Canada Cabin Safety) is preferred
* Experience with crew management systems (e.g., Navblue or similar platforms) is an asset
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
* Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, operational environment
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Effective interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills
* High level of accountability, integrity, and professionalism
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team
* Proactive approach with a focus on continuous improvement
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence

The TTC’s new vision and mission statements also help promote the many environmental, social equity and economic benefits that the TTC provides:

  

**Vision:** Moving Toronto towards a more equitable, sustainable, and prosperous future.

  

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Want to help deliver one of the TTC's most important strategic initiatives? Join the Renewable Energy Programs (REP) team as a Project Controls Coordinator, where you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of a multi-billion-dollar portfolio of electrification, renewable energy, and infrastructure projects that will help power TTC's transition to a zero-emission fleet.

  

This role goes beyond traditional project coordination and administration. You will serve as a strategic integrator, working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, Finance, and stakeholders across the organization to ensure projects remain aligned with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance requirements.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Head of Renewable Energy Programs, you will provide project controls leadership and coordination across a large and complex portfolio of renewable energy, fleet electrification, charging infrastructure, energy storage, solar generation, and facility modernization projects that support TTC's transition to a net-zero fleet.

  

As one of only two Project Controls Coordinators supporting the portfolio, you will serve as a key interface between project teams, finance, project management, and TTC stakeholders, ensuring project controls processes are consistently applied and project performance is effectively monitored throughout the project lifecycle.

  

You will work closely with Senior Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to coordinate planning and scheduling activities, maintain cost controls, manage budgets and forecasts, monitor project performance, and support governance and reporting requirements. Through ongoing analysis and engagement with project delivery teams, you will ensure decision-makers have accurate and timely information regarding project health, risks, costs, schedules, and forecast outcomes.

  

A significant component of the role involves maintaining financial controls within SAP, including budget monitoring, forecasting, internal order management, cost transfers, settlements, accruals, cash flow monitoring, and variance analysis. You will help ensure financial information remains accurate and aligned with approved capital plans, project baselines, and funding commitments.

  

You will coordinate the development, review, and validation of project controls deliverables, including schedules, cost estimates, forecasts, cash flow projections, stage-gate documentation, performance metrics, and management reports. By reviewing project data and performance trends, you will identify budget and schedule variances, investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support recovery planning to maintain project objectives.

  

The successful incumbent will prepare management dashboards, status reports, key performance indicators, and executive reporting materials that provide meaningful insights into project performance and support informed decision-making. You will transform complex project information into actionable recommendations for project teams and leadership.

  

You will also support compliance with rigorous internal governance processes and external funding requirements associated with provincial, federal, and municipal funding programs. This includes coordinating reporting requirements, maintaining data integrity across project controls systems, supporting audits and governance reviews, and helping ensure compliance with funding agreements and reporting obligations.

  

Given the strategic nature of TTC's electrification and renewable energy initiatives, your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of charging infrastructure, power upgrades, energy storage systems, solar projects, and facility electrification projects that support TTC's long-term climate commitments and fleet modernization objectives.

  

Promotes a respectful work and service environment that supports diversity, inclusion, and is free from harassment and discrimination. Provides leadership in the development and implementation of inclusive and accessible policies, programs and/or services for employees and customers in accordance with TTC's commitments and obligations under the Ontario Human Rights Code (OHRC) and Related Orders, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), and TTC's policies.

Founded on a legacy of more than 120 years in banking, Bank OZK is much more than just a company. We’re nationally recognized as an industry leader in financial services. That means we combine exceptional service with innovative technologies to deliver smart solutions to our clients across the country. The foundation for a great career starts with an exceptional team and a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about Bank OZK benefits .
  
  
**Job Purpose & Scope**
Responsible for management of the call center assistant manager(s) and call center support staff. Oversees day-to-day operations within assigned Customer Care Center location(s) and is responsible for monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), implementing process improvements, and conducting effective resource planning. Ensures the call center maintains adherence to company policies, compliance standards, and customer service best practices. Partners cross-functionally to identify and address operational challenges.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Manages staff to include staffing, assigning and delegating work, training, mentoring, and coaching. Conducts performance reviews and fosters a high-performance culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develops objectives for the call centers day-to-day activities.
* Collaborates with peers to build effective relationships and ensure all Customer Care Centers are in alignment.
* Monitors day-to-day operations of call center staff to ensure calls and resolution of customer issues are handled according to established policies and procedures, and that objectives are met.
* Provides ongoing support, coaching, and feedback to agents to improve performance, customer service skills, and adherence to policies and procedures through reoccurring side-by-side call monitoring.
* Leads monthly touch base meetings with agents and assistant managers to discuss performance, provide feedback and observations, and explore career interests and development goals.
* Tracks agent availability and prepares regular individual reviews to keep agents on track and within compliance of the availability policy.
* Creates and nurtures effective work relationships with supervised staff to motivate, coach, and retain staff.
* Guides call center assistant manager(s) in effective leadership practices.
* Organizes and plans implementation of strategic initiatives provided by senior call center management.
* Resolves complex and/or highly sensitive customer complaints and conducts requisite follow up with the appropriate party as appropriate.
* Conducts resource planning by monitoring KPIs, staffing levels, and coordinating staff scheduling to meet business needs.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Comprehensive knowledge of online banking software and Customer Care policies and procedures.
* General knowledge of card systems and imaging systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing with senior leaders, including presenting to groups of various sizes.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver clear, constructive feedback and effective coaching to support employee learning and performance.
* Ability to utilize discretion and sound judgment in decision making and maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to demonstrate excellent customer service, critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently without close supervision.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks with exacting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to demonstrate effective leadership skills and manage the work performance of others.
* Ability to develop and motivate staff to achieve team goals.
* Ability to develop, interpret and provide staff guidance on bank policies and procedures while maintaining strict confidentiality and bank secrecy.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, and travel as needed for work.
* Skill in using computer and Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

**Basic Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree preferred.
* 5+ years of work experience in a call center, customer service and/or retail banking environment required.
* 1+ year of management or supervisory experience required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate degree preferred.
* 2+ years of work experience with core banking software (e.g., Fiserv Premier) and the applicable interfaces to a core banking software platform preferred.

Operate customary equipment and technology used in a business environment, with or without accommodation.

* Strong knowledge of Mastercard’s products, data assets, and ecosystem partnerships, and how these capabilities create competitive advantage and drive client value in KSA

* Deep knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills; proven ability to guide project teams to structure and resolve ambiguous client challenges.
* Demonstrated success in owning and developing relationships with mid- to executive-level client contacts, inspiring confidence in Mastercard as a trusted partner.

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer-centric financial super-app on earth. * Overseeing and assessing customer service staff activities, and providing them with regular performance-related feedback.

Title: E-Key Account Executive
Description:
**Description**
---------------

Online Executive

The Estée Lauder Companies | Dubai, UAE

Department: Online

Reports to: Senior E-Key Account Manager

Employment: Full-time

**About the Role**

The Estée Lauder Companies is looking for an Online Executive to manage the day-to-day online business across assigned online platforms.

Reporting to the Senior E-Key Account Manager, you will take direct ownership of retailer account management and end-to-end execution, translating brand and retailer priorities into commercial plans, accurate forecasts, successful launches and engaging online experiences.

This role combines commercial thinking with hands-on delivery, working across brands, retail partners and internal teams to drive performance and ensure strong execution.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Commercial Performance

* Manage day-to-day relationships with Ounass and Bloomingdale’s, coordinating trading plans, retailer communication and follow-up actions.
* Maintain customer plans, activation calendars, sales trackers and performance scorecards.
* Analyse sales and account performance to identify growth opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and investment recommendations.
* Coordinate brand and retailer priorities across commercial initiatives, paid media, launches and promotional activity.
* Escalate strategic decisions, investment requirements and significant business risks to the Senior E-Key Account Manager.

Forecasting, Orders & Availability

* Own forecasts for existing products and new launches, aligning assumptions with brands, Demand Planning and retail partners.
* Track purchase orders from receipt and confirmation through advance shipping notices, invoicing, delivery and closure.
* Monitor stock availability, order fulfilment, allocations and delivery risks with Supply Chain and Customer Service.
* Resolve open orders and operational issues, ensuring timely follow-through and clear communication.

Digital Merchandising, Launches & Activations

* Coordinate product listing creation, product detail page enrichment and content completeness with Accenture.
* Manage launch requirements, including creative assets, samples, gifts with purchase, SKU lists and promotions.
* Coordinate launch readiness and platform go-lives with brands and retail partners.
* Check live product pages, merchandising and campaigns for accuracy, quality and alignment with agreed plans.
* Track and resolve listing issues, credit notes, returns to vendor and other operational exceptions.

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Build effective partnerships with Ounass, Bloomingdale’s, brand teams, Media, Finance, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Customer Service and Accenture.
* Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, timelines, responsibilities and outstanding actions.
* Take ownership of issues from identification through to resolution.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What You Will Bring**

* 3–5 years of experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, brand management or account management.
* Experience managing retailer accounts and coordinating the full order-to-delivery process.
* Working knowledge of forecasting, fulfilment, digital merchandising and media activation.
* Strong analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to turn performance data into practical actions.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple launches, orders and commercial priorities.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
* A proactive approach and a clear sense of accountability for delivery.
